Medical, vision, and dental insurance to help you with those coughs or cavities (too many waffles...). 401K program so you can still spend money later in life. Extra cash incentives for being healthy and fit (we actually give you money to track your sleep!). Unlimited vacation policy. If you need time off just take it; we trust you! Bi-weekly catered lunches to catch up with your teammates. Free snacks and coffee, including a huge breakfast selection (10 types of cereal anyone?) Nap pods, for those days when you stayed out a little too late... A full gifted bed set when you join (mattress, sheets, pillows, the works)! If you dream about this stuff this job is probably right for you. We look forward to learning more about you, but if you’re feeling sleepy, take a nap before applying!

text:
Google Benefits Specialist, Wellness
Note: By applying to this position your application is automatically submitted to the following locations: Mountain View, CA, USA; Boulder, CO, USA; New York, NY, USA At Google, we don't shy away from big, crazy ideas-and that's not just in our products. We aim to foster the healthiest workforce on the planet and our Benefits team is behind the wheel, driving these efforts. From retirement planning to financial literacy courses to healthy living campaigns, our Benefits team runs programs that are designed to keep our global Googlers healthy and happy. With more than 60 offices across the world, you're able to swiftly maneuver through the complexity of serving different legal and cultural practices, while also finding creative opportunities for giving our Googlers equitable support. You'll build an understanding of what "wellness' truly means to each Googler, and implement innovative programs as the population of Googlers grows in size and diversity. You are a mission-driven, enthusiastic team player with the creativity to develop and manage benefits programs. As a Benefits Wellness Specialist, you will be accountable for health program development, vendor management, program implementation, and data analysis demonstrating program impact. You are detail-oriented, analytical in your approach, action-oriented, and thrive in a fast-paced environment. You are “ready to roll up their sleeves” and willing to do whatever is needed to move an effort forward. You enjoy building solid working relationships with peers, cross-functional teams and vendor partners. You enjoy facilitating cooperative partnerships among multiple partners to achieve the most effective, efficient program for Googlers and their families. You have a proven track record in the health and wellness space of tackling ambitious goals and succeeding. You're an independent thinker who isn't afraid to ask questions. You are a mission- driven, enthusiastic team player with the creativity to develop, improve, and manage benefits wellness programs. You will be supporting and leading projects for Google’s US wellbeing and mental health programs. Great just isn't good enough for our People Operations team (you probably know us better as "Human Resources"). Made up of equal parts HR professionals, former consultants and analysts, we're the champions of Google's colorful culture. In People Ops, we "find them, grow them, and keep them" - we bring the world's most innovative people to Google and provide the programs that help them thrive. Whether recruiting the next great Googler, refining our core programs, developing talent or simply looking for ways to inject some more fun into the lives of our Googlers, we bring a data-driven approach that is reinventing the human resources field. Responsibilities Design, develop, and implement the delivery and management of globally relevant, culturally-appropriate, industry-leading wellness programs to positively influence business impact and help Googlers and their families be healthy and happy. Implement, analyze and report on relevant health and wellness programs, as well as using data analytics to ensure understanding of impact and outcomes against program objectives. Support the design, development, and delivery of health and wellbeing research pilots and experiments. Work with diverse third-party benefits vendors and contractors to manage the delivery of programs and interventions, and ensure alignment across key milestones and program deliverables, including all privacy, legal, security and related requirements are met. Work with cross-functional Google stakeholders, partners, and leaders to collaborate on effective and efficient program delivery of holistic health, wellness, fitness, nutrition, and mental health services. Qualifications Minimum qualifications: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. 4 years experience in a clinical, corporate health or worksite health promotion setting including program planning, development, implementation and evaluation. Experience in evaluating data and synthesizing trends into actionable interventions, and ideally broader plan strategy Experience in demonstrating results orientation, collaboration, flexibility, and adaptability. Preferred qualifications: Experience in corporate US benefits. Experience in managing benefits, health management, or corporate wellness vendors. Ability to engage and communicate with employees, understand their needs, and exceed their expectations in delivering benefits. Ability to assess the bigger picture, think outside the box, and implement team goals/objectives across the organization. Strong communication and influencing skills; ability to build relationships and working collaboratively across multiple offices and vendors. At Google, we don’t just accept difference - we celebrate it, we support it, and we thrive on it for the benefit of our employees, our products and our community. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know. To all recruitment agencies: Google does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, Google employees or any other company location. Google is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

text:
Affordable Housing Data Analyst Intern
$15.00 HOUR Position located in Alhambra The Community Development Commission/Housing Authority of the County of Los Angeles (CDC/HACoLA) is a dynamic and innovative local government agency created in 1982 by the Los Angeles County Board of Supervisors. The agency is an industry leader in four core service areas: affordable housing, and community, economic, and housing development. Funded primarily with federal grants, the CDC/HACoLA prides itself on sponsoring new solutions to local issues, and forming partnerships with private and public agencies. To learn more about the agency's work in support of its mission to _Build Better Lives and Better Neighborhoods_ , please visit www.lacdc.org. The Economic and Housing Development Division (EHD) administers a variety of affordable housing programs on behalf of the Los Angeles County Board of Supervisors. One of EHD's core functions is to administer federal and local funding made available to help finance the development of affordable and special needs housing in the county. The Capital Finance and Asset Management Unit (CF/AM) within EHD monitors compliance of all affordable housing projects funded by CDC/HACoLA. In addition, CF/AM has oversight or administrative duties related to multifamily bond financing, monitoring of land use and planning requirements for affordable housing, Housing Successor Agency, and the Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) Pilot Project. The CF/AM unit works closely with the Los Angeles County Department of Regional Planning (DRP) to track housing data needed for compliance with the County's Housing Element as well as participation in the County's Homeless Initiative. The CF/AM Unit is seeking a part-time Housing Data Analyst Intern to assist with management and analysis of affordable housing program data associated with the full range of housing data and compliance tracking efforts. This intern position will assist the CF/AM in checking the accuracy and improving systems and protocols to manage a wide range of housing data fields, while also exploring ways to map and display information. CF/AM tracks data related to unit sizes, amenities, population type, affordability levels, accessibility, rents, development costs, and funding types, among other fields. Additionally, CF/AM will be developing new data systems to track housing stock with expiring affordability commitments, and to share this preservation data with other state and local governments and research organizations. The work to be done by the Affordable Housing Data Analyst Intern will help CF/AM in the development of recommendations for improved data systems that are coordinated across multiple programs. Duration of the internship would run for 6 months, with possible extensions. The position has flexible hours for up to 12 hours per week, or less. The CDC's work hours are Monday through Friday between 8 AM to 6 PM. Essential Job Duties Under direct supervision, performs assignments requiring the use of EXCEL and ACCESS databases, network file structures, network email, and Laserfiche record searches to compile, verify, input, sort and map past and present housing project data. The three key parts of this assignment are 1) searching past electronic records to capture, verify and input data, 2) work with Development Specialists and Analysts to add and map data from new projects, and 3) maintain and improve the master Excel spreadsheet and produce data sets and reports upon request. This work may also include some contact with developers, property management companies, and EHD Project Managers in order to verify older housing data, as well as interaction and some coordination with CDC GIS mapping efforts. The employee will work with management on tasks related to specific assignments. The successful candidate will perform a wide range of duties requiring initiative, focus, time-management, and good communication skills in addition to a wide variety of skills needed to organize and sort electronic data, with a strong focus on accuracy and timely performance of assigned tasks. Qualifications Must be currently enrolled in a graduate degree program in Urban and/or Regional Planning or a closely-related field from an accredited college/university. Highly Desirable Qualifications: High degree of proficiency with MS Excel with the ability to do data links, graphs, and Macros. Experience with MS ACCESS and the ability to transfer data to and from Excel. Experience with GIS and other mapping systems. Experience or knowledge of database software systems. Experience managing a database. Experience with or knowledge of affordable housing finance and development terminology and practices. Experience creating or using Infographics. Experience with Adobe InDesign or related graphic design programs. Additional Information Possession of a valid California Driver's License and an acceptable driving record are required. Human Resources staff will notify all applicants of their application status via email. You are responsible for monitoring correspondence from this office by checking your e-mail account in a timely manner. Successful candidates must complete a thorough background investigation, including a fingerprint search and physical evaluation prior to appointment. A resume cannot be substituted for any section of the online application and/or supplemental application. If your application is incomplete, it may be rejected at any stage of the examination process. Work experience must be supported by the experience in your application. "See resume" is not an acceptable answer. _Those applicants whose qualifications most closely meet the needs of the Division, will be invited for the examination process._ DEADLINE: OPEN UNTIL FILLED. APPLY IMMEDIATELY, POSITION MAY CLOSE WITHOUT PRIOR NOTICE. RECRUITMENT NUMBER: 18043

text:
Data Analyst
The Data Analyst (DA) is primarily responsible for extracting and analyzing relevant data from existing systems, designing reports and delivering thoughtful, clear and concise presentations on the results of analysis to management and / or boards of directors to advance or improve quality and clinical outcomes and achieve organizational goals. The DA must possess exemplary interpersonal skills and broad knowledge of methods for synthesizing data into information consumable by management and staff, demonstrating proficiency in business processes. This person is also responsible for creating, implementing, and maintaining data to support quality improvement projects and initiatives, quality of care goals, and patient management programs. The DA must demonstrate the ability to work independently on complex analytical projects and collaboratively with various managers and executives. ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES : 1\. Responsible for coordinating activities by other Data Analysts as well as other Data Reporting activities 2\. Participate in business analysis activities to gather reporting requirements. Translate business requirements into specifications that will be used to implement the required reports and dashboards, created from potentially multiple data sources. 3\. Designs reports and include tools that can help others understand data, such as dashboards, charts, and graphs. 4\. Surveys systems, databases, data repositories, and departmental workflows for data collection and designs solutions to improve efficiency in data gathering and accuracy at the entry point. Identifies practices and/or protocols to ensure validity of data (i.e. relevance, accuracy, usability, etc.). 5\. Assists with data audits in various environments to maximizing the value of data reporting systems; provides recommendation(s) for changes or upgrades of data reporting systems as needed. 6\. Studies the data repositories for clinical, operational, financial and performance data, for continuous improvement of reporting and enhanced relevance of data points across multiple systems. Works towards data integration where possible while ensuring data integrity across multiple programs, services, and sites. 7\. Identifies potential or actual discrepancies in data reporting systems, and then works to solve inaccuracies and/or reconcile data. 8\. Maps relationships between databases and reporting systems. Illustrates data relationships across multiple databases, with the ability to understand and explain relationships to users of the information. 9\. Determines priorities and method of completing daily workload to ensure responsibilities are carried out timely. 10\. Develops standardized client surveys, matrices, and dashboards that accelerate management access to data reporting. 11\. Meets with key management and staff, practicing good interpersonal skills to clarify, extract and define data needs for decision-making. 12\. Facilitates improved understanding of data systems for laypersons to enhance use of data in everyday work with an aim at increasing quality standards, productivity and efficiency. 13\. Presents data sets in a manner that is user-friendly and facilitates learning/understanding at various levels (i.e. line staff, supervisors, executive and Boards of Directors). 14\. Manipulates and reports data from various sources; interprets meaning of data and provides accurate analysis; and maintains working knowledge of assigned systems through formal vendor training and self-guided instruction. 15\. Interprets the needs of the user to build ad hoc and custom reports; establishes reporting systems for regular periodic reports. 16\. Assists clients in expressing and defining data requirements; draws “rough” data reports and works with clients to further define data sets to best meet the clients’ needs. 17\. Presents data reporting both formally and informally at department or management meetings. Manages questions / answers on data reporting and utilizes feedback to further develop data systems and reporting parameters. 18\. Ensure proper configuration management and change controls are implemented for production reports. 19\. Conducts all reporting and data mining in compliance with privacy, confidentiality and proprietary regulations and policies. 20\. Performs other related duties as assigned. Qualifications To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE: Bachelor’s degree in information technology or credential in health information technology, preferred and/or four years of experience using enterprise class data reporting, information, and decision support tools for management and operational reporting, required. Experience with databases, reporting software, data extraction and data presentation tools required. Experience with Microsoft Office suite required and EPIC EMR system or MAS 200, preferred. Experience in the health care field preferred. Working knowledge of data security and privacy laws preferred (e.g. HIPAA). Familiarity with EHR and other clinical systems preferred. OTHER SKILLS AND ABILITIES: Strong organizational skills. Strong problem-solving skills. Detail oriented. Excellent communication skills. Able to deal with frequent changes, delays, or unexpected events. Strong interaction skills with management and staff.

We are looking for a Data Analyst to join our growing Los Angeles Video Labs team. This position will conduct analysis and provide reports around established and emerging social video platforms in support of a team servicing a major television and film client. The ideal candidate would have previous experience with and a passion for social video platforms, digital entertainment, and brand marketing. The candidate would also have a proven track record of personal and/or professional growth, initiative, and attention-to-detail. Please note that this is a contract position, with the possibility to convert to full-time. Responsibilities Interface with brand clients to understand and deliver on their custom reporting needs Interface with account teams on data collection, information sharing, and department-wide collateral Work with Strategist to develop new platform metrics Work with internal teams to create custom reporting solutions Create visually clear presentations and one-sheets based on research and analysis Provide product development recommendations around emerging metrics Actively participate in department and company culture, training, and development initiatives Other duties as assigned Qualifications 1-2 years of related experience in fast-paced business environment (agency preferred) Demonstrable Excel mastery working with large data sets. Ideal experience includes building complicated formulas, parsing strings, mapping assets and metadata, and hacking formulas to improve efficiency. Up-to-date knowledge of Facebook / Youtube platform functionality Proficiency in the following: PowerPoint (Keynote a bonus),Excel, Google Drive, DropboxProficiency with time / email-inbox management - Gmail, Google Calendar A deep interest in online video and marketing strategyComfortable with research and analytics Passionate about online video across a variety of genres (Comedy, Drama, Gaming, How-TO) Ability to predict and anticipate future opportunities and challenges and create solutions in advance Excellent written and verbal communication skill Flexibility to succeed in innovative, sometimes ambiguous situations BONUS POINTS IF (PRIOR EXPERIENCE WITH): Social media agency, digital agency, or online video experience Completion of key social platform certifications (YouTube Certified, Facebook Blueprint, etc) Experience with reporting packages (Business Objects etc), databases (SQL etc), programming (XML, Javascript, or ETL frameworks) Fullscreen is a global media company that develops online creators and programs multi-platform entertainment experiences. 600 million subscribers generate more than 6 billion video views across Fullscreen’s global network each month. SQL/Oracle - Data Base Analyst
Assists in the analysis of the clients' business and the development and integration of data and process models, process flows, and logical database designs. Assists in the physical design, testing, implementation, maintenance and control of the organization's databases across multiple platforms, technologies (e.g., hierarchical, relational and object oriented) and computing environments (e.g., host based, distributed systems, client/server). Assists in developing and maintaining the department's documentation standards and development process guidelines and tools. Essential Functions: Assists in the identification and analysis of corporate business processes, the information flows and interfaces among them, and their transformation into data and process models. Assists in the development of detailed data models in consultation with clients and staff. Works closely with technical and client management to design and implement databases and support tools for complex business application development requirements and processes (e.g., diverse development platforms, technological environments, software, hardware, tools, etc.). Monitors transaction activities and assists in optimizing the performance and utilization of databases. Responsible for the integrity and security of data in corporate databases. Participates in the analysis and resolution of issues related to information content, data integrity, integration, and database performance with clients and other Data Processing staff. Assists in the development of standards and procedures affecting data and process modeling and documentation, along with database design, maintenance and management. Assists in the development of the corporate data architecture and related data architecture standards and conventions.

Analyst I, Data Science
_Are you_ _passionate_ _about improving the quality of healthcare?_ _Are you_ _interested_ _in exploring a rapidly expanding universe of clinical data?_ _Are you ready to_ _leverage your talents_ _to make healthcare better for everyone?_ _Are you_ _fascinated_ _by the growing field of_ _data science_ _?_ Then join the new _Data Science & Advanced Analytics_ team at Health Services Advisory Group (HSAG) that is transforming the delivery of healthcare in the United States! HSAG has been a pioneer in the field of healthcare quality improvement for over three decades, serving approximately: 25 percent of the nation’s Medicare population 46 percent of the nation’s Medicaid population 20 percent of the nation’s dialysis population HSAG is nationally recognized as an industry leader in the areas of data analysis, measure development, and patient satisfaction surveys. We are in search of talented individuals that are interested in a career in analytics as an Analyst in HSAG’s Data Science & Advanced Analytics division. Together we can spread positive change to make healthcare better. UNIQUE BENEFITS The Analyst also benefits from HSAG’s desire to grow its staff into the future leaders of healthcare quality improvement in the nation. New HSAG analysts are provided formal training in statistics, clinical epidemiology, SAS, healthcare data, and an assortment of healthcare-related topics. HSAG offers: A comfortable work-life balance, including half-day Fridays and flexible work schedules. Three weeks of paid time off and 13 company-paid holidays where staff leave two hours early prior to each holiday just to get a “jump start” on holiday festivities. HSAG offers a competitive benefit package which includes, medical, dental, vision, tuition reimbursement, 401(k) and an employee stock ownership plan. DESCRIPTION The Analyst is a key contributor to cutting edge analytic work that spans the broad spectrum of healthcare data projects at HSAG. Driven by intellectual curiosity and a passion for healthcare quality, the Analyst develops and executes innovative analytic plans that are intended to provide healthcare decision and policy makers with the necessary information to transform healthcare. The Analyst will also assist in designing a wide array of analytic studies and participate in all phases of the research design process. The Analyst will have at his or her fingertips a wide array of data types to facilitate data exploration, including: survey case review medical and prescription drug claims eligibility clinical electronic health record operational Details regarding potential project assignments will be discussed with potential candidates during the interview process. ESSENTIAL COMPETENCIES, DUTIES, AND RESPONSIBILITIES Serve as an integral part of HSAG Data Science & Advanced Analytics division. Understand primary types of healthcare data and methods for approaching data assessments. Evaluate a wide array of data types. Conduct and interpret analyses, develop appropriate statistical models, manipulate complex databases, and track and evaluate patterns of care and outcomes. Perform data validation, conduct analysis plans, and cross reference data. Attend and participates in team training meetings. Present and communicate project results to non-analytic staff members and customers. Represent HSAG in a professional manner at all times. JOB REQUIREMENTS EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE Bachelor’s degree in public health, related social science, business, economics, math, statistics, or another quantitative discipline. Master’s degree preferred. OTHER QUALIFICATIONS Knowledge of statistical programming in SAS. SAS certification preferred. Experience with relational databases, SQL, and other reporting tools. Experience working with healthcare data is preferred. Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, and Access. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to handle several projects simultaneously and work with multiple teams. WORK ENVIRONMENT The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. DISCLAIMER This is not necessarily an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, skills, duties, requirements, efforts or working conditions associated with the position. While this is intended to be an accurate reflection of the current position, management reserves the right to revise the position or to require that other or different tasks be performed when circumstances change (e.g., emergencies, changes in personnel, work load, rush jobs requiring non-regular work hours, or technological developments). HSAG is an EEO Employer of Veterans protected under Section 4212. If you have special needs and require assistance completing our employment application process, please feel free to contact us.

This position will conduct analysis and provide reports around established and emerging social video platforms in support of a team servicing a major television and film client. The ideal candidate would have previous experience with and a passion for social video platforms, digital entertainment, and brand marketing. The candidate would also have a proven track record of personal and/or professional growth, initiative, and attention-to-detail. Please note that this is a contract position, with the possibility to convert to full-time. Responsibilities Interface with brand clients to understand and deliver on their custom reporting needs Interface with account teams on data collection, information sharing, and department-wide collateral Work with Strategist to develop new platform metrics Work with internal teams to create custom reporting solutions Create visually clear presentations and one-sheets based on research and analysis Provide product development recommendations around emerging metrics Actively participate in department and company culture, training, and development initiatives Other duties as assigned Qualifications 1-2 years of related experience in fast-paced business environment (agency preferred) Demonstrable Excel mastery working with large data sets. Ideal experience includes building complicated formulas, parsing strings, mapping assets and metadata, and hacking formulas to improve efficiency. Up-to-date knowledge of Facebook / Youtube platform functionality Proficiency in the following: PowerPoint (Keynote a bonus),Excel, Google Drive, DropboxProficiency with time / email-inbox management - Gmail, Google Calendar A deep interest in online video and marketing strategyComfortable with research and analytics Passionate about online video across a variety of genres (Comedy, Drama, Gaming, How-TO) Ability to predict and anticipate future opportunities and challenges and create solutions in advance Excellent written and verbal communication skill Flexibility to succeed in innovative, sometimes ambiguous situations BONUS POINTS IF (PRIOR EXPERIENCE WITH): Social media agency, digital agency, or online video experience Completion of key social platform certifications (YouTube Certified, Facebook Blueprint, etc) Experience with reporting packages (Business Objects etc), databases (SQL etc), programming (XML, Javascript, or ETL frameworks) Fullscreen is a global media company that develops online creators and programs multi-platform entertainment experiences. 600 million subscribers generate more than 6 billion video views across Fullscreen’s global network each month. Are you an experienced Data Analyst ready to make an immediate impact? Do you love the challenge of deciphering and analyzing complex data? If metrics and chowing are your thing, then we might have the perfect opportunity for you. About the Team: At ChowNow, our mission is to help local restaurants grow their business by improving relationships with their customers. We are passionate about serving the needs of over 10,000 restaurants to help them compete in an increasingly technical world. Our team works on products focused on restaurant clients and their diners, who transact over $1M daily on the ChowNow platform. We believe positive relationships make our team able to do more with less. You will collaborate, learn, teach, and experiment with new approaches to getting big things done together. Our team is located in the Playa Vista neighborhood and tech hub of Los Angeles — just a few minutes from both the beach and the freeways. We believe in equal opportunity for all, and you should, too. We’ve been named a Best Place to Work, have been certified as a Great Place to Work, and have a whole bunch of happy employees on Glassdoor. About the position: As our Data Analyst, you will work on our core products and business functions to help shape the future of what we build and how we provide service at ChowNow. Reports to Business Intelligence Analyst; No Direct Reports Specifically, you will: Analyze corporate and client performance data, discover and solve real world problems, propose new ideas to enhance product value, and build metrics and business cases to improve decision making. Focus on creating and improving corporate reporting frameworks and data visualization. You'll own everything from ad-hoc reporting to long term analytical and statistical projects that will greatly affect our business outcomes. Within 1 month, You'll.. Experience employee onboarding to absorb ChowNow’s mission, products, history, culture and toolsets. Obtain access to all datasets including our data warehouse, SFDC, Zuora, corporate library, Mode Analytics and others Work with various stakeholders, to understand business drivers, goals and actionable outcomes using analytics Be fully ramped building dashboards within Mode Analytics Within 3 months, You’ll.. Work with teams across ChowNow to improve the general understanding of performance within their respective products, services and platforms Assume responsibility for day-to-day data operations for data across the company Identify root causes of any data issues and propose solutions Create and improve reporting to drive business intelligence for executive team and other stakeholders Complete ad hoc data research requested by various department heads Research new data tools to streamline the utilization and visualization of our growing datasets Have gained deep insight into our client behaviors, diner behaviors, the definition of both success and failure at the client level, and general trends in our ecosystem Within 6 months, You’ll.. Completely own the design, development, and maintenance of ongoing metrics, reports, analyses, dashboards, etc. to drive key business decisions. Implement best practices in reporting, analysis, data integrity, and documentation Have designed and evaluated several experimental ideas for products and workflows Create and refine machine learning models to project growth, performance and various KPI’s Within 12 months, You’ll.. Earn trust and respect throughout the organization based upon your delivery of valuable insights and reporting. Automate dashboards and updates for decision makers to gather data on their own without assistance from the data team Influence product, sales, service and finance teams through presentation of data-driven presentations and proposals Have generated and tested dozens of new ideas which have both succeeded and failed and you have learned from the failures Be well on you way to creating a measurable ROI for the organization from the efficiencies that you have implemented and the new corporate opportunities that you have discovered You Should Apply If: You have a background in a quantitative or technical field You have knowledge of SQL and proficiency in Microsoft Excel You have experience working with large data sets You are focused on results, a self-starter, and have demonstrated success in using analytics to drive the understanding, growth, and success of products and organizations You are an effective communicator to various audiences You have the capacity to remain flexible and adept at learning new tools You have the ability to implement new systems within a team atmosphere About Our Benefits: Competitive salary Ongoing training and growth opportunities A "best place to work" winner multiple times where we focus on creating a great employee experience Rock solid medical, dental, and vision plans Open Vacation Policy; paid holidays; we expect you to work hard, but still enjoy your personal life Six weeks of fully paid primary parental leave and two weeks secondary leave Employer contributing student loan assistance program Commuter benefits (including Uber Pool) Employee Stock Incentive Plan Quarterly Industry Speakers Series Quarterly Tech Events (Women, LGBTQ, Diversity, Inclusion) Consistent & fair leadership: we’ll share info, set clear goals, show you respect, and treat everyone fairly Enough freedom to spread your wings while still holding you accountable Fully stocked kitchen and cold brew on tap

Data Analyst
At Tala, we are connecting millions of people to the financial services they deserve. The Data Analytics team operates in a nimble working style, flexing between a variety of business questions and data needs at the company. We are asked to investigate and solve big questions other companies have yet to find solutions for such as digital identity management and understanding customers fully based on their mobile data. You will be part of an innovative and fast growing team that pushes to provide access, choice, and control to millions of customers. As a Data Analyst, your goal is to deeply understand internal client needs and to build out data products that provide the company with real-time and in- depth insights about our diverse customer base. This role will be based out of our Santa Monica, CA office. In this role you will: Be a key resource: become an expert on Tala’s data infrastructure, analytics tools, and best practices in data-driven research for the company Be curious: investigate new data sets, identify strategic opportunities for improving servicing for our customers, and share your findings with our partner teams Be a multiplier: build out new data flows as our product changes, and produce high-value, timely analytics based the unique aspects of each of our markets What we’re looking for: BA/BS in a quantitative field Expert in at least one analytics language (ex. Python, R) Proficient in SQL, GitHub, bash commands Experience interning or working in a data-intensive role (or equivalent experience) Perfect candidates would have: Experience with multiple types of messy data in a business environment Experience in emerging markets (either personally or in professional scope) Modeling and machine learning expertise outside of school or Kaggle Ability to juggle multiple projects effectively in a fast-paced environment About Tala: Tala ( http://tala.co ) is a mobile technology and data science company that is working to deliver financial access, choice and control to underserved people around the world. Tala’s smartphone app instantly evaluates customers for credit using only the data on their devices and delivers customized loans in minutes. Tala, formerly known as InVenture, is backed by IVP, Ribbit Capital, Lowercase Capital, Data Collective, Collaborative Fund and other leading venture and impact investors. In 2016, Fast Company ranked Tala, formerly known as InVenture, as one of its top 10 companies in Money, and Forbes named Tala as one of the top 50 FinTech companies in the world. text:
Data Compliance Analyst
Data Compliance Analyst ( Job Number: 180001XD ) Description The Chicago Public Schools (CPS) has set ambitious goals to ensure that every child—in every school and every neighborhood—has access to a world-class learning experience from birth, resulting in graduation from high school college- and career-ready. Information Technology Services is seeking an ISBE (Illinois Board of Education) Data Compliance Analyst to serve as the primary point of contact to perform data quality assurance analysis and reject clean-up (between the CPS and ISBE systems), take the lead to resolve duplicate student records/IDs in the CPS student information system, and interface with ISBE personnel and various CPS and ITS teams. This position requires strong interpersonal, communication, organizational, and analytical skills. This position must also have the ability to work effectively with ITS teams, Central Office staff, internal and external School Administrators, and CPS’ ISBE contacts. Responsibilities: Take the lead to resolve duplicate student records created in the CPS student information system: Perform investigate analysis in one or more CPS student information systems and in the ISBE system, in order to determine which student record/ID is the correct one to keep, and be responsible (through to close) of all tickets pertaining to Duplicate ID requests Give top priority in working directly with school users to provide guidance and inform them of which Student ID is the correct one to use Determine whether manual clean-up is needed before the duplicate records can be merged and reach out to the applicable internal teams who may need to take action in their respective systems or in the ISBE student information system. Utilize the Duplicate Student Resolution Tool to merge records, to include resolving any errors that may result during the merge process and working closely with the Student Information System Technical teams who support the tool. Work closely with various Central Office teams to prioritize and determine the order in which duplicate student records may need to be resolved Manage CPS’ ISBE mailbox Resolve ISBE compliance errors, such as missing data (i.e. grade, homeless, english learner, RSSP, etc.) or address corrections in the CPS student information system by reaching out to schools (emails or phone calls), as needed, and/or working with applicable ITS and/or CPS teams. Perform manual edits in the ISBE student information system (enrollment entries and exits; state ID creation, and other data quality cleanup) Work with CPS’ Office of Teaching & Learning to ensure course code mapping is correct Interface with other school districts across the State of Illinois (emails and phone calls) Maintain a cohesive relationship with CPS’ ISBE contacts Inform ITS Data Solutions/Data Analytics team of the duplicate and shared state ID resolutions to be implemented in the nightly load files Qualifications: At a minimum, Associates Degree or equivalent technical or business certifications and experience required 2 - 4 years of experience in a fast paced, highly interactive customer service related field Prior experience supporting end users in an education environment desired Must have excellent customer service and interpersonal skills Excellent verbal and written communication skills Strong analytical skills and attention to detail required Deep understanding of CPS’ Student Information Systems desired Problem solver with demonstrated experience troubleshooting issues and following through to resolution Strong organizational skills Strength of character to work in a fast-paced environment while juggling competing priorities and maintaining deadlines and goals Ability to work well both independently and as part of a team Diligent in following processes and procedures Ability to comfortably interface with all levels of management and staff Residency Requirement: As a condition of employment with the Chicago Public Schools (CPS), employees are required to live within the geographic boundaries of the City of Chicago within six months of his or her CPS hire date and maintain residency throughout their employment with the district.

Data Analyst
FourKites is looking for a data analyst to support business intelligence and analytics efforts throughout our organization and identify opportunities for improvements through data-driven decision making. This new team member will work on our Engineering team in Chicago and work cross-functionally with product, operations and engineering. Responsibilities Data mining using state-of-the-art methods Extending company’s data with third party sources of information when needed Enhancing data collection procedures to include information that is relevant for building analytic systems Processing, cleansing, and verifying the integrity of data used for analysis Doing ad-hoc analysis and presenting results in a clear manner Creating automated anomaly detection systems and constant tracking of its performance Skills and Qualifications Excellent understanding of machine learning techniques and algorithms, such as k-NN, Naive Bayes, SVM, Decision Forests, etc. Experience with common data science toolkits, such as R, Weka, NumPy, MatLab, etc. Excellence in at least one of these is highly desirable Great communication skills Experience with data visualisation tools, such as GGplot, etc. Experience with NoSQL databases, such as MongoDB, Cassandra, HBase is preferable Good applied statistics skills, such as distributions, statistical testing, regression, etc. Good scripting and programming skills FourKites is the fastest-growing predictive supply chain platform, backed by top-tier VC firms in Silicon Valley, Boston and Chicago, delivering real-time visibility and execution for Fortune 500 companies and third-party logistics firms. Using a proprietary algorithm to calculate shipment arrival times, FourKites enables customers to lower operating costs, improve on-time performance, and strengthen end-customer relationships. With a network of more than four million GPS/ELD devices, FourKites covers all modes including ocean, rail, parcel and over-the-road. The platform is optimized for mobile and equipped with market-leading end-to-end security. We look for smart, agile, creative team players who are ready to roll up their sleeves and deliver for our customers.

Quality Data Analyst
JOB DESCRIPTION One (1) Full-time position Develop and maintain all Outpatient quality related tools and analysis required to achieve organizational goals and objectives in relation to HEDIS and other pay for performance metrics as required by the Medicaid Managed Care plans. Serve as the data analyst and liaison in relation to all PCMH/OP quality reporting; inclusive of understanding HEDIS expectations of each Medicaid Managed Care plan and conveyance of this information to the members of the quality committee Creates and manages all data reports in relation to HEDIS/NCQA and other OP related quality initiatives Develop analytical models to identify trends to improve quality metrics and overall clinical care delivery Development and maintenance of a comprehensive incentives tracking dashboard Performs ETL processes with EMRs, including reporting to management quality issues and places for improvement, quickly and precisely Training and assisting coworkers with producing reports and retrieving information from medical databases Ensure confidentiality of patient data while working within and outside of organization by adhering to HIPAA guidelines Provide supporting data and high level data analysis for grant submissions and public outreach projects Work with providers on research projects and clinical quality improvement tasks, including analysis of survey reports and clinical data Identify performance tools available to La Rabida via various Medicaid Managed Care payer websites/portals and use of tools to pull relevant quality and other performance based data for analysis and dissemination Analyze HEDIS and NCQA-focused data and produces clear and comprehensive reports that assist in quality improvement metrics Creation of quality performance dashboard and dissemination of results and accompanying analyses Capable to multitask on various projects and handling immediate-need projects as they arise Conduct routine audit of reports, including clinical performance to ensure quality care and present data at quality committee meetings High level data analysis, entry and other tasks as assigned JOB REQUIREMENTS Bachelor’s degree required. Demonstrated ability to work with staff on healthcare information systems and serve as expert resource for all quality data and reporting questions required. Experience working on reporting projects related to medical management, population health, value-based care or clinical quality preferred. Experience creating reports using business intelligence, data visualization and/or dashboarding tools (such as Tableau, SPSS, SAS) strongly preferred. Ability to operate a computer, its applications, accessories, and all associated peripheral equipment (copiers, scanners, faxes, etc.) required.

text:
Performance Data Analyst
Performance Data Analyst ( Job Number: 180001W7 ) Description At Chicago Public Schools, our mission is to provide a high-quality public education for every child in every neighborhood that prepares them for success in college, career, and community. The Department of School Quality Measurement and Research (SQMR), where this position is located, supports this work by providing timely and accurate data to stakeholders throughout CPS (families, schools, central office leaders, etc.) working to meet these goals. The Performance Data Analyst will be held accountable for the following responsibilities: Manage process for writing and executing code to calculate various performance metrics. Metric calculations will be performed in SAS and the process will include developing and/or maintaining detailed documentation for metric calculation work. Compile, manipulate, and analyze data using appropriate statistical techniques and produce reports Fulfill internal and external requests for performance data (including Freedom of Information Act requests) in a timely manner using SAS and Microsoft Office. Implement quality assurance process to make sure that code for metric calculations and other data requests is checked for accuracy before being finalized. As needed and available, develop and communicate reports with descriptive statistics on various performance metrics. Work collaboratively with IT staff to ensure warehousing of metric and rating data. Work collaboratively with other departments to maintain an understanding of data needs and work that may require support from SQMR. In order to be successful and achieve the above responsibilities, the Performance Data Analyst must possess the following qualifications: Education \- A degree in field that has established a strong understanding of computer coding and quantitative work. Bachelor’s required, Master’s preferred. Experience \- Experience with managing large data sets (pulling data from multiple data sets, merging data sets, etc.) and applying complex rules to create custom indicators required. Experience in working with educational data strongly preferred. Knowledge, Skills and Abilities : Experience writing code with data analytic tools (SAS preferred, R, SPSS, STATA, etc.) Ability to conduct multiple projects concurrently and switch between them as needed based on shifting priorities. Solid oral and written communication, problem solving, organizational and project management skills Ability to work in a team, with technical and non-technical personnel, and across departmental boundaries Ability to understand and apply detailed programming specifications and in a complex data management environment. Knowledge of educational performance measures, educational research and urban education systems a plus. Residency Requirement: As a condition of employment with the Chicago Public Schools (CPS), employees are required to live within the geographic boundaries of the City of Chicago within six months of his or her CPS hire date and maintain residency throughout their employment with the district.

text:
Data Analyst
Dual-headquartered in New York and London, Fitch Ratings is a leading provider of credit ratings, commentary and research. Dedicated to providing value beyond the rating through independent and prospective credit opinions, Fitch Ratings offers global perspectives shaped by strong local market experience and credit market expertise. The additional context, perspective and insights we provide help investors to make important credit judgments with confidence. Fitch Solutions delivers credit market data, analytical tools and risk services to the global financial community. In addition to offering proprietary market-based content, Fitch Solutions distributes the ratings, research and financial data of Fitch Ratings through a variety of flexible platforms. With innovation and experience behind every solution, Fitch Solutions helps financial professionals meet the diverse and evolving needs of today’s global markets. Fitch Ratings and Fitch Solutions, along with Fitch Learning and BMI Research, are part of the Fitch Group, a global leader in financial information services with operations in more than 30 countries. Fitch Group is majority-owned by Hearst. Fitch Ratings and Fitch Solutions are an equal opportunity / affirmative action employer, complying with all laws governing employment in each jurisdiction in which operating, and provide equal opportunity to all applicants and employees. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, marital or protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity and other status protected by applicable laws. Fitch is seeking an Analyst or Associate Director (title will be commensurate with experience) to join the Global Corporates group as a member of the Data & Analytics team. The Global Corporates group provides ratings, research, and data on thousands of debt-issuing corporations to market participants around the world. Data & Analytics is an entrepreneurial team of hybrid analysts within the broader Global Corporates group that operates at the intersection of traditional research and technology. We are a highly visible team and play an integral role in building solutions to support the rating and research efforts of over 300 analysts globally. We also harness the data and insights generated by the analysts using our tools to develop our own data-driven research and products. These products can be internal or external and can range from traditional research reports to interactive visualizations. We are seeking a new team member that can help us further build out our data infrastructure while also becoming knowledgeable about corporate credit research from an operational and analytical perspective. The key responsibilities of the position will include but are not limited to: Develop, support and maintain the applications used in the rating and research process Integrate and mine large data sets, connecting data from disparate sources to identify critical insights and pragmatic data solutions Collaborate with functional experts and organizational leaders in the implementation of new products and process improvements Produce data-driven reports and presentations for internal and external use Position Requirements Bachelor’s degree in a technical/quantitative field. Programming knowledge required (VBA, SQL, R, Python or JavaScript). Experience in software/web development a plus. Basic knowledge of database concepts required. Have a keen interest in finance and business. Knowledge/experience in finance/accounting, economics or capital markets a plus but not required. Strong attention to detail and problem-solving ability Good written and verbal communication skills LI-AG1 Fitch is committed to providing global securities markets with objective, timely, independent and forward-looking credit opinions. To protect Fitch’s credibility and reputation, our employees must take every precaution to avoid conflicts of interests or any appearance of a conflict of interest. Should you be successful in the recruitment process at Fitch Ratings you will asked to declare any securities holdings and other potential conflicts prior to commencing employment. If you, or your immediate family, have any holdings that may conflict with your work responsibilities, you may be asked to divest yourself of them before beginning work.

Our pursuit of this mission is the driving force that brings us to work each day. We believe in embracing new ideas, challenging ourselves and failing forward. If you’re looking for a place where your work can be personally and professionally rewarding, don’t just join a company with a mission. Join a mission with a company behind it. What You’ll Be Doing: We are looking for a bright and energetic individual for the Data Analyst role in our Operational Performance department. This position involves the preparation and analysis of data with an emphasis on performance metrics. This selected applicant must have experience using SQL to pull data. NetherRealm Studios seeks a Data & Monetization Analyst to join our team. In collaboration with our existing Analytics Department, the Analyst will work closely with the development teams for the full lifecycles of our products. This position requires excellent project management, communication, and documentation skills. The ideal candidate will demonstrate passion for discovering interesting facts through data and sharing them with others. Daily tasks include gathering requirements from project stakeholders, drafting schemas and tables, working with the ETL and reporting process, and developing documentation. The Data and Monetization Analyst must be comfortable working with large sets of data related to acquisition, engagement, and monetization. The Analyst will coordinate with external BI engineering and QA teams to ensure the data pipeline can meet our needs and work with internal design, development, and product management to translate the results of data analysis into compelling designs that compliment and further elevate fun game experiences. Analytic reports are in high demand by multiple entities. This position will collaborate on everything from planning the way we record events in-game, monitoring the ETL process, and ensuring the final report satisfies the intended audience. The Analyst will need strong communication skills and an ability to be a contributor working with a wide variety of internal departments. They will be comfortable with all levels of ownership, from hands on design to providing high-level guidance and feedback. Detail-oriented and organized, the ideal candidate will thrive in a fast-paced and evolving environment that offers the opportunity to work hands-on with world-class brands, and contribute concretely to the success of our games. What part will you play? Answer questions about our products by querying our databases and packaging the answers in an easily digestible way for our internal teams. Identify in-game events that affect business KPIs including revenue, retention, use acquisition, k-factor, and lifetime value. Collaborate with other analysts in drafting table schemas and dimensional models to measure the variables necessary for later analysis. Design, build, and maintain analytics documentation including requirements from various departments as well as timeline. Organize staff meetings while drafting meeting minutes and syndicating action items. Work with Confluence, PowerPoint, and other tools to ensure project details and analytical value is being communicated to all stakeholders Perform market research, competitor teardowns, and write up trend summaries. Monitor progress by playing builds in development as well as reviewing ongoing player behavior reports and trends. Brief the team regularly on key learnings and new insights that can be applied across games. What do we require from you? BA/BS Degree in Business, Finance, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, or Mathematics Minimum 2-3 years as a data and/or monetization design contributor or similar role (product, design, analytics, etc.) in the games industry, in mobile, PC, or consoles. Strong background in analysis fundamentals through previous work experience, collegiate thesis, and/or passion projects. Strong familiarity with mobile application ecosystems and operating systems like iOS and Android. Experience with project managing multiple deliverables that each have their own separate stakeholders, environments, and operational teams. Experience designing, building, reporting, and maintaining project documentation. Must be comfortable reading, interpreting, explaining, and responding to data; background in statistics, data mining, or other quantitative discipline is highly valued. ETL knowledge desired from schema generation, event design, ETL processing, to reporting. Business Intelligence tools experience a bonus: SQL, Tableau, Looker, Python, C++. Comfortable presenting complicated material to diverse audiences; strong ‘soft skills’. Passion for analytics. Passion for gaming. Ability to collaborate with colleagues across different disciplines and locations to achieve results. Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and prioritize work to meet specific deadlines required. “Team First” personality with excellent interpersonal and communication skills. “No job is too small” attitude. Must be self-motivated and results-oriented.

text:
Data Analyst
The Data Analyst is responsible for scientific data analysis of various oilfield and laboratory measurements, as well as creation of log images for presentation to the customer. The Data Analyst is called upon to process and analyze the data utilizing proprietary software, creating finished log images for use by both internal and external customers. The Data Analyst must have the capability of supporting innovation of multi-well deliverables when needed (3-D graphics, data analytics and statistics). ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned. The principal duty is to computer-process field-generated log data into processed log images for presentation to customers. This includes processing chemical analysis data, and interpretation of well logs for Sales staff and customers, as well as making special data presentations. It also includes interacting with customers to obtain customer-provided data necessary to process the well data and to ultimately interpret the results for internal and external customers, either verbally or in written form. Processing of data requires knowledge of the underlying science and mathematics associated with the data and analyses, and the ability to explain these principals. This knowledge is also used to make necessary adjustments to produce quality analysis results. The Data Analyst must demonstrate the ability to identify correlations between the processed data and well completion records, client provided log and production data and other information. Results are interpreted using a variety of techniques such as; data aggregation and statistical analysis. All available information is used to improve the quality of the final result. Interpretations of identified correlations are communicated to internal and external clients. The Data Analyst must demonstrate the ability to review processed results along with the various available data and information from multiple wells, and identify trends and correlate the trends to completion, drilling, geologic and other miscellaneous records. Processed data must be managed and archived for future retrieval. Responsible for contributing to continuous improvement of processes and presentation of data to the customer. These improvements may include: algorithm development, minor programming,innovation of new data deliverables in various forms: print, digital, 2‑D, 3‑D and animation. The Data Analyst must demonstrate the ability to execute the above mentioned duties and responsibilities accurately with minimum supervision from the Senior Data Analyst or supervisor. QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE Bachelor’s degree required, with an emphasis in physics or mathematics preferred. Minimum 5 years of experience with data analysis in the oilfield industry preferred. An equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered in lieu of a degree. Knowledge of offshore operations (gravel/frac pack environments) preferred. Strong computer skills with experience in data analysis software required. Must be able to produce technical reports on analysis of stimulation tracing and post fracturing stimulation logs. Experience with oilfield stimulation and completions preferred. LANGUAGE SKILLS Ability to read, analyze and interpret instructional and technical materials. Ability to write applicable reports and correspondence clearly. Ability to effectively present information in one-on-one and small group situations to clients and other third parties. Strong written and oral communication skills preferred for Data Analysts supporting work from Mexico, Central and South America. MATHEMATICAL SKILLS Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals, and calculate area, circumference and volume. Ability to compute rate, ratio and percent and interpret various graphs used to analyze data. Ability to apply mathematical operations to such tasks as determination of test reliability and validity, analysis of variance, and correlation techniques. REASONING ABILITY Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists. Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form. Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. Ability to apply principles of logical or scientific thinking to a wide range of technical data problems. Ability to deal with formulas, scientific equations, and graphs. CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS None required; participation in professional organizations (for example, SPE) strongly encouraged. PHYSICAL DEMANDS The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The employee may be asked to lift and/or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. WORK ENVIRONMENT The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Work is performed in a normal office working environment. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

Summary Responsible to manage and analyze the inputs of the data and output of the feedback from the Call Miner (CM) voice analytics tool. This includes establishing the relevant reports and distributing feedback throughout the management team in the organization. Help facilitate Direct Energy to drive a better customer experience, stay within Compliance, and facilitate expectations pertaining to Sales/Churn. Responsibilities/Skills & Qualifications Establish a detailed understanding of our strategies, vendor requirements, and regulatory concerns as they apply to our business Look for opportunities where gaps may exist between our stated practices and actual practices. Elevate significant gaps to executive management Based on your detailed understanding of our practices, calibrate Call Miner tool so it best reflects the content of our calls, highlighting areas of concern within our calls, as well as best practices Learn the mechanics of the CM product with the goal of being Direct Energy’s content expert on this tool While this is not an IT role, you should have familiarity with the mechanics of the CM and how it relates to our various collection databases. This includes how data is accumulated and how it flows through the process all the way from the call itself to the CM output Analyze the daily data input into CM to ensure its completeness and accuracy. Recommend process or improvement to the data feed into the CM tool to maximize the value of using this tool Improve our CM scripting to ensure our calls are properly graded by the CM software. Data Quality Analyst
Learn and work on meaningful initiatives with some of the best and brightest in the market research industry. The NPD Group provides the world’s most successful brands with leading market research, combining consumer and retail point-of-sale data with analytic solutions to interpret today’s market trends while anticipating tomorrow’s. In addition, we offer a career filled with innovation and growth to the forward-thinking problem solvers who join our team. Position Overview This person is responsible for ensuring the quality, timeliness and integrity of NPD products. The Data Quality Analyst establishes and implements processes and methodologies to ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, adhere to high quality standards and meet customer expectations. He/she will also work directly with the practice to address quality concerns, communicate quality decisions and conduct validation exercises. Overall Responsibilities: Evaluating and approving data for validity and impact on deliverables. Responding to internal data inquiries. Compiling and analyzing data reports. Demonstrating a sense of urgency and utilizes resources efficiently. Making recommendations on standards for reports and analysis that will either improve quality or decrease timing. Demonstrating skills to think outside the box and challenge the status quo. Assisting in the development and maintenance of training materials, and process documentation. Providing guidance in the planning and launching of critical products for the practice. Ability to work on multiple priorities and/or projects simultaneously. Taking responsibility for personal development by seeking training, on-the-job experiences and input from manager. . Qualifications: Must be fluent in Brazilian Portuguese and English. Knowledge of the Automotive industry a plus. BA/BS degree or equivalent. 2 years experience. Knowledge of search engines and business research tools. Ability to think conceptually and analytically with strong problem solving and decision making skills. Ability to adapt to changing business needs. Understanding of data analysis and interpretation. Have a strong sense of commitment to the execution of deadline-driven tasks. Must be detail-oriented with the ability to multi task. Embraces teamwork & possesses ability to effectively work cross functionally. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Knowledge of MS Office (Access, Word, PowerPoint) with excellent expertise in Excel including Pivot Tables, Importing/Exporting, Formulas, etc. Experience in data processing environment or retailer/industry knowledge a plus, but not required. The NPD Group, Inc. is an Affirmative Action/Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

text:
Data Analyst
Empowering The People Who Power The World Are you interested in a career opportunity with a growing software company? P2 Energy Solutions is dedicated to providing a positive culture where the ability to learn, collaborate, and make a difference is rewarded. We have a fast-paced, innovative culture where employees are empowered to provide a superior experience for internal and external customers. Upstream oil and gas professionals who are focused on solving tough challenges rely on P2 software, data and analytics solutions to optimize their business performance. We are currently developing our solutions on mobile and in the cloud! More than 1,600 companies from around the world use P2 solutions every day to manage their land assets, measure and process financial information, optimize production, and manage their reserves. With more than 80 years of experience in data and 30 years in software, P2 has offices around the world, and employs approximately 600 people. Responsibilities & Qualifications Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Individual draws business and quality insights from data through analysis, mining, and visualization. Leverages technical skills and creative thinking to solve problems and make quantitative recomendations to leadership and project team(s). Individual is responsible for the accuracy, efficiency, quality, and retrieval of processed data and develops understanding of complete product portfolio. Individual constructs detailed data analytic visualizations to demonstrate potential operational insight for customers. Serves as a research focal point, evaluating new data sourcing avenues, analyzing data from third party resources for quality, feasibility, and other logistics, and evaluates/facilitates potential new data products. (1) Collaborate with operational teams to understand data needs and priorities, identify opportunities for analytics services while operationalizing resulting analytics tools or reports, and discovery of any data product gaps or quality challenges (2) Educate staff on how to utilize data to inform strategy and business decisions (3) Maintain the highest standards for data ethics, accuracy, collection, and transparency in data collection and analysis methodologies (4) Interacts with departmental and other staff on matters affecting data and publications flow and makes recommendations for improvement or enhancement to workflow processes to ensure standards in data entry, collection, processing, and delivery (5) Develop knowledge of key concepts, terminology, and processes of assigned discipline (6) Provide auditing of data in alignment with P2 Tobin quality model and recommend remedies for deficiencies Qualifications Include: (1) Bachelor or Associate degree, preferred in research/data science-based disciplines (statistics, mathematics, economics, information systems/technology, business) (2) 0-3 years experience (3) Ability to gain working knowledge of business operations, decision and intelligence systems concepts, database structures, and/or geographic information systems (4) Excellent verbal and written interpersonal, business, and technical communication skills; strong collaboration. (5) Well organized and efficient with keen judgment, problem-solving and decision-making skills (6) Ability to develop excellent analytical skills and integrate information from multiple sources to execute effectively and efficiently in a dynamic environment Belief In The P2 Way Always _be learning_ When in doubt, _talk it out._ Show up and _follow up._ Create _positive_ Think _beyond…_ Please note: Assessment testing may be required for this position. We offer a casual work environment, comprehensive benefits plan, generous PTO, and a competitive compensation structure. We have a positive culture designed around the philosophy of mutual respect and the challenge of contributing to the continued success of our organization. P2 is dedicated to individual and corporate growth opportunities, and we would love to talk to you further! P2 Energy Solutions and its affiliated companies is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We also participate in the E-Verify program, a service of DHS and SSA.

This position will act as a liaison to other Human Resource teams, the Information Technology Department, Payroll Department and other business units to ensure that systems provide the means for and enable processes to effectively gather, maintain, and utilize HR-related information. Proactively identify trends for further management discussion and review Mine and aggregate data from various sources (HRIS systems, Applicant tracking, Learning Management, Benefits Vendors, Engagement Survey Vendor, Exit Survey, etc.) Develop and perform regular audits of HR data to ensure the accuracy and integrity of the HR database Validate data by reconciliation to neutral source or system of record, understand and explain variances Identify correlations and patterns in complicated data sets Collaborate with HR colleagues and subject matter experts to identify reporting needs and leverage HRIS systems to expand the HR reporting function Develop metrics, reports and dashboards to support the needs of the business. Automate, generate, analyze, and distribute recurring HR metrics and ad-hoc reports to the appropriate stakeholders Evaluate and automate processes, data sources and reports to improve the organization's ability to measure programs and outcomes Perform other duties as assigned KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES
