text:
Supply Chain Architect
Are you interested in learning and growing each day? Join us, and unleash your potential while delivering value-centric solutions for one of the world's most recognized brands. As our team builds and supports new applications at a rapid pace, we are looking for an exceptional Supply Chain Business Architect in Menlo Park, CA Key Skills: This Supply Chain Architect position will focus on developing reference architecture, supply chain strategies, roadmaps, and associated systems to support the growth of the clients datacenters and associated hardware. The Supply Chain Architect will be expected to engage with partner teams across the organization to understand their requirements and turn them into phased operational roadmaps. This process includes documenting the current state of the supply chain and cross-functional dependencies, identifying pain-points and deficiencies, identifying improvement opportunities, and proposing future state solutions. The end goals being supply continuity, lead time reduction, and minimization of commercial risk. Once the opportunities have been identified, the Supply Chain Architect will be responsible for preparing, and in some cases program managing, the implementation plan. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Supply Chain business processes and related IT solutions enablement. Direct experience managing traditional supply chain functions such as: forecasting, demand/supply planning, master scheduling, order fulfillment, logistics, transactional procurement (Source-to-Pay), supply chain master data management, and product lifecycle management is required. Extensive experience in architecting and mapping business models against different IT solutions and architectures, as well as a proven Program Management experience in implementing such solutions is mandatory. Responsibilites: Engaging with business stakeholders to understand strategic objectives, business requirements, and pain points. Developing complex, multi-year, supply chain strategies, roadmaps, and implementation plans. Championing activities across multiple functional groups within the larger Infrastructure team. Supporting associated change management initiatives across the Infrastructure org. Working with IT system developers to spec, implement, and validate, new tools/systems. Engaging with third party vendors to evaluate capabilities and software tools. Leading implementation programs, from high-level program management to preparing process workflows and related documentation. Identifying, collecting, and analyzing data to drive processes optimization. Establishing KPIs to track and monitor performance and develop improvement plans. Training participating and partner teams on new processes and supporting tools as required. Minimum Qualifications: Demonstrated experience transforming supply chains across products and industries. Experience developing solutions to problems, which require the use of ingenuity and innovation. Organizational, project, and time management experience. Experience influencing and interacting with cross-functional teams and harnessing the potential of a bottom’s up culture. Experience and application of supply chain principles, concepts, practices, and standards, along with an experience in industry practices. Master’s degree in technical or business related field with at least 8 years of supply chain experience. Experience with Oracle, Demantra, Agile PLM or equivalent tools. Communication experience. Prefered Qualifications: A Supply Chain business consulting background, with “Hands-On” experience. Proactive and self-driven, focused on delivering impact and getting things done, in a collaborative and service-oriented manner. Insatiable curiosity coupled with the tenacity and grit required to implement truly. Experience working with ambiguity and working effectively in an entrepreneurial environment. Experience in a large cross-functional work environment, driving beyond the organization’s natural boundaries. Demonstrated experience transforming supply chains across server, network, or data center infrastructure products and industries. Additional Responsibilities: Participate in OrangePeople monthly team meetings, and participate in team building efforts. Contribute to OrangePeople technical discussions, peer reviews, etc. Contribute content and collaborate via the OP-Wiki/Knowledge Base. Provide status reports to OP Account Management as requested About us: Orange People is an Enterprise Architecture and Project Management solutions company. Our most valuable asset is our people: dynamic, creative thinkers who are passionate about doing quality work. As a member of the Orange People team you will have access to industry-leading consulting practices, strategies & technologies, innovative training & education. An ideal Orange Person is a technology leader with a proven track record of technical achievements and strong process/methodology orientation.

text:
Supply Chain Architect
Facebook's mission is to give people the power to build community and bring the world closer together. Through our family of apps and services, we're building a different kind of company that connects billions of people around the world, gives them ways to share what matters most to them, and helps bring people closer together. Whether we're creating new products or helping a small business expand its reach, people at Facebook are builders at heart. Our global teams are constantly iterating, solving problems, and working together to empower people around the world to build community and connect in meaningful ways. Together, we can help people build stronger communities — we're just getting started. This Supply Chain Architect position will focus on developing supply chain strategies, roadmaps, and associated systems to support the growth of Facebook’s datacenters and associated hardware. We are driving transformational change and need creative leaders to participate in building unique solutions to solve unique challenges! The Supply Chain Architect will be expected to engage with partner teams across the organization to understand their requirements and turn them into phased operational roadmaps. This process includes documenting the current state of the supply chain and cross-functional dependencies, identifying pain- points and deficiencies, identifying improvement opportunities, and proposing future state solutions. The end goals being supply continuity, lead time reduction, and minimization of commercial risk. Once the opportunities have been identified, the Supply Chain Architect will be responsible for preparing, and in some cases program managing, the implementation plan. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Supply Chain business processes and related IT solutions enablement. Direct experience managing traditional supply chain functions such as: forecasting, demand/supply planning, master scheduling, order fulfillment, logistics, transactional procurement (Source-to-Pay), supply chain master data management, and product lifecycle management is required. Extensive experience in architecting and mapping business models against different IT solutions and architectures, as well as a proven Program Management experience in implementing such solutions is mandatory. RESPONSIBILITIES Engaging with business stakeholders to understand strategic objectives, business requirements, and pain points. Developing complex, multi-year, supply chain strategies, roadmaps, and implementation plans. Championing activities across multiple functional groups within the larger Infrastructure team. Supporting associated change management initiatives across the Infrastructure org. Working with IT system developers to spec, implement, and validate, new tools/systems. Engaging with third party vendors to evaluate capabilities and software tools. Leading implementation programs, from high-level program management to preparing process workflows and related documentation. Identifying, collecting, and analyzing data to drive processes optimization. Establishing KPIs to track and monitor performance and develop improvement plans. Training participating and partner teams on new processes and supporting tools as required. MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS Demonstrated experience transforming supply chains across products and industries. Experience developing solutions to problems, which require the use of ingenuity and innovation. Organizational, project, and time management experience. Experience influencing and interacting with cross-functional teams and harnessing the potential of a bottom’s up culture. Experience and application of supply chain principles, concepts, practices, and standards, along with an experience in industry practices. Master’s degree in technical or business related field with at least 8 years of supply chain experience. Experience with Oracle, Demantra, Agile PLM or equivalent tools. Communication experience. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS A Supply Chain business consulting background, with “Hands-On” experience. Proactive and self-driven, focused on delivering impact and getting things done, in a collaborative and service-oriented manner. Insatiable curiosity coupled with the tenacity and grit required to implement truly. Experience working with ambiguity and working effectively in an entrepreneurial environment. Experience in a large cross-functional work environment, driving beyond the organization’s natural boundaries. Demonstrated experience transforming supply chains across server, network, or data center infrastructure products and industries.

Clinical Data Specialist
We just got in a new contract req for a Clinical Data Specialist at Roche in Pleasanton, CA. Pay rate is $37/hr on W2. It is position number 8275305\. Must have clinical data standards (CDISC/CDASH, SDTM etc.). Lead clinical data standardization efforts for Clinical Operations and Biometrics (COBM) organization, within Molecular Solutions. The job holder ensures that the interface to the study teams is in place and that the study team members are trained and instructed in the application of the DIA clinical data standards (best practices). Please email your Resume attached as a Word Doc along with your desired Hourly Rate. I will also need your current location, visa status , and date you are available to start a new position . Please make certain your resume clearly details the your experience with the skills required for this requirement. This is a 12 month contract to start. Also please provide a brief writeup about why you are a match for the position that can be passed along to the manager. If you have worked at Roche or Genentech in the past please provide your previous managers names, so they too can be passed along to the hiring manager. ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES: Review COBM study protocols and identify variables to be standardized, using expertise in CDASH and SDTM standards published by CDISC. Request new standard variables to enhance DIA clinical data standards, and ensure full adherence on study level. Review and approve standard variable proposals raised by other BA representatives. Define clinical data standard catalogues. Train study team members on DIA data standardization processes. Work closely with Data Management to ensure data standards are adopted in EDC study configuration. Work closely with Global Data Standards Manager and Information Architect to enhance training material on data standardization. Provide adherence to data standards results to stakeholders (e. g. Study Teams, CLOC). Analyze data standards adherence and define means to improve it. Monitor releases of Standard Development Organizations (e. g. CDISC). Support the adoption of external standards. Clearly and effectively communicate changed processes to affected groups and leadership. Develop and maintain knowledge base for DIA data standards. MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS: Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Data Science, Computer Science, a related scientific field or equivalent work experience. At least 5 years of data standardization experience using standards provided by CDISC. Experience in working with Data Management team to drive implementation of data standards. Experience and thorough understanding of the Clinical Trial Process, specifically in Clinical Data Management, CRF development and data collection, review and handling best practices. Experience analyzing and solving business situations. Experience presenting information to diverse audiences. Comprehensive understanding of clinical development process. Must be detail oriented. Able to simplify a complex set of components into a simple, effective message or communication plan. Strong executive presentation skills and writing skills Demonstrate ability to develop and present sound proposals and recommendations. Brings experience in implementing and embedding solutions, not just information-gathering to management. Knowledge of industry standards as it applies to the collection, tabulation and analysis of study data Good knowledge of international health regulations, ICH, GxP, CSV guidelines. In-depth knowledge of clinical data standards (CDISC CDASH, SDTM, Controlled Terminology). TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS: Approximately 5% of domestic travel required with occasional international travel as necessary.

BI Data Architect, Partnerships Analytics
Facebook's mission is to give people the power to build community and bring the world closer together. Through our family of apps and services, we're building a different kind of company that connects billions of people around the world, gives them ways to share what matters most to them, and helps bring people closer together. Whether we're creating new products or helping a small business expand its reach, people at Facebook are builders at heart. Our global teams are constantly iterating, solving problems, and working together to empower people around the world to build community and connect in meaningful ways. Together, we can help people build stronger communities — we're just getting started. The Partnerships team at Facebook works with leading content creators, publishers, and businesses in entertainment, sports, news, and many other verticals. This role is a unique opportunity to work with one of the most important datasets in the world. In this role you will lead the connection of data assets across many product lines to create business analytics tools and systems to enable field organizations, analysts and clients alike. Your primary responsibility will be to partner with stakeholders across the organization unlock easier access to data – create, maintain and expand data pipelines. You will help translate business needs into requirements and identify opportunities for increased efficiency, mostly in the form of extracting, transforming, and visualizing data. You will be expected to use your expertise to provide meaningful recommendations to other analysts in areas like performance enhancements, best practices, and streamlining data sources. Your expertise will also be relied upon to contribute to a wide range of analytics products that will further multiply the scale and impact of your work. You will also support on-call shift as needed to support the team. The ideal candidate will have a passion for problem solving and a belief in the power of incremental change in a fast-paced environment. You have the ability to calmly and effectively make decisions when there is no right or wrong answer. You are the type of person who is constantly thinking about the big picture. You're a self-starter, motivated by a passion for developing the best possible solutions to problems. The role will report to the Data Infrastructure Lead and is based in Menlo Park. RESPONSIBILITIES Develop methods and tools to unlock access of data to non-technical stakeholders across the Partnerships Organization Create scripts to automate operational processes Optimize and maintain existing data pipelines, ensuring that data arrives accurately and on-time Build and ensure data tables can serve as the source of truth for various high-level priorities Work cross-functionally to define problem statements, collect data, and make recommendations Be a representative to other data teams and educate them about the team’s latest initiatives MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS 3+ years’ experience using scripting languages such as R, SAS, Python 2+ year’s of SQL (Oracle, Vertica, Hive, etc.) or relational database experience (Oracle, MySQL) creating queries 1+ years of experience working with enterprise Data Analytics tools and experience learning in-house Data Engineering tools 1+ years of experience with packages such as Tableau, SPSS, STATA, etc. Experience working independently PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 1+ years of experience with data visualization tools 1+ years of experience working with BI, Ops, or Strategy teams Experience translating non-technical use cases into technical requirements

Overview Who we are: Meridian Health Plan is a family-owned, family-operated company of passionate leaders, achievers, and innovators dedicated to making a difference in the lives of our members, our providers and in the healthcare industry. We provide government-based health plans (Medicare, Medicaid, and the Health Insurance Marketplace) in five different states (Michigan, Illinois, Indiana, Kentucky, and Ohio). Our employees work hard, play hard, and give back. Meridian employees enjoy: Happy hours, special events, company sports teams, potlucks, Bagel Fridays, weekly Executive Lunches, and volunteer opportunities. A Day in the Life of a Data Architect: This role will work on a team that will meet with Business Analysts, Business Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), system owners, and end users to understand existing business processes, future goals, and requirements. Works with and supports Data Architects to model data as a Business Information Model (BIM or logical model), eventually creating physical models to instantiate as database tables. This position is responsible for developing healthcare subject matter expertise in order to better understand the business. Building an understanding of the correct business rules is essential to assuring that only quality data enters the databases. The Data Architect will learn to understand the big picture of how all of the data subject areas are related and affect one another. He/she will develop skills necessary to master ER/Studio, data modeling techniques, and best practices. Responsibilities Develops and delivers standard data model artifacts for new systems and enhancements to existing systems. Participates in data model design and review processes Responds to change and engages in multiple projects simultaneously Works with guidance from Data Architects Qualifications Education: Bachelor's degree in a related field is required Experience: 1+ years of experience as an IT professional 1+ years serving in a Data Architect role 1+ years utilizing data modeling tools (ERwin, ER/Studio, PowerDesigner, etc), or strong aptitude to learn 1+ years creating conceptual, logical and physical data models Prior business experience in a complex, highly integrated services environment Knowledge: Familiarity with health plans or PBMs. Familiarity with the regulatory environment affecting data in a Health Care Services environment is a plus (e.g., HIPAA 5010) Familiarity with relational database design principles Familiarity with Agile methodology SQL Excellent written and oral communication skills Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, Access, Visio) Strong consultative and presentation skills Assertive (yet diplomatic) personality and the ability to handle change Candidates need to work well in extended project teams What Meridian can offer YOU: Our healthcare benefits include a variety of PPO plans that are effective on the first day of employment for our new full-time team members Meridian offers 401k matching that is above the national average Opportunities for growth are abundant; full-time MHP employees are eligible for tuition reimbursement and all employees have access to a variety of training through Meridian University Meridian Health Plan was named Detroit's 1 Fastest Growing Company by Crain's Magazine, so it is a great time to get involved with Meridian EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER MNSTR

Our people and their experiences are critical to making that happen. And that’s where we come in. We drive the human side of Ford – fostering a winning culture that empowers people from diverse backgrounds to work together and realize the otherwise impossible. In partnership with leaders, we enable our teams, partners, and businesses to contribute their best, shape tomorrow, and satisfy their passion to win. We create value through people by being change leaders, talent strategists, employee advocates, and culture architects. Simply put, we are trusted partners – experts in all things people. Position Duties Develop and drive strategic talent acquisition plan for Autonomous Vehicles team Gather external / internal talent trend data to drive talent acquisition decisions Support hiring forecasts through data analysis Drive short-term tactical workforce planning Lead implementation of the annual recruiting cycle plan; collaborate with recruiting teams Assist with managing requisitions (Direct Hires, Interns, FCG’s and Co-ops) Partner with third party recruiting organization (RSR) to manage all aspects of the hiring process Monitor hiring process metrics to ensure on target delivery and generate in-process metric reports Partner with HRBO, Operations, and RSR to facilitate the onboarding of interns, co-ops and FCG’s Drive the strategic direction of the intern, co-op and FCG programs Plan and facilitate lead recruiter / recruiting governance meetings Lead various recruiting projects as needed Collaborate with operations to determine direct hire staffing needs Assist with monitoring and tracking requisition time to fill Coordinate sourcing and hiring activities for hiring managers Required Qualifications: Bachelor's Degree 3+ years of Recruiting and/or Project Management experience 1+ year of experience using Microsoft Excel and Power Point Preferred Qualifications: Change management and Project management skills Strong facilitation skills Ability to build and maintain strong relationships with HR colleagues/leaders and operating partners Desire to learn – OD mindset Ability to analyze data and develop effective recommendations Create and deliver effective presentations Effective oral and written communication skills Ability to work independently; self-starter Ability to conduct crucial conversations; win-win solutions Problem-solving skills Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite The distance between imagination and … creation. Ford Motor Company is an equal opportunity employer committed to a culturally diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, age, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status or protected veteran status.

Data Architect
The Data Architect is responsible for designing and implementing the data architecture for Lineage’s next generation supply chain operating platform. Specifically, this includes being responsible for developing normalized, dimensional, and hybrid data models to support reporting, analytics, and APIs used by other internal and external applications. The Data Architect will serve as the primary data modeler and provide oversight of the following areas: Data Ingestion- moving source system data to a unified data lake Data Modeling - determining field-level data usage Data Wrangling - identifying queries/algorithms to efficiently transform data from source system formats to a unified RDBMS schema Data Quality - ensuring complete and uninterrupted data mappings from source to canonical form At Lineage Logistics, IT’s aim is not to build the largest teams but to build a small, highly skilled, team that focuses specifically on having the capability, knowledge and skills focused in areas that define our core differentiators and allow us to leverage cloud, best-of-breed technologies and manage/leverage external teams of contractors for capacity. This means that in addition to being a great architect, you need to be able to review and collaborate with partners to ensure that we get the same quality from them too. As a company, Lineage Logistics leverages state-of-the-art technology to meet our customer’s needs, assist in our international growth, and create an infrastructure that enables Lineage to lead the industry. As the ideal candidate for this position, you will exhibit the technical expertise, business acumen and flexibility required to successfully work with all levels of Lineage’s organization. Essential Job Functions: Perform detailed data analysis and translate business requirements into logical and physical data models Lead complex technical data warehouse discussions on modeling, integration, and overall technology solutions and design Possess the ability to a create robust, scalable, and sustainable data architecture that supports requirements and provides for future expansion Build integrated Enterprise Data Warehouse and Dimensional models using both Hadoop and relational models to support optimized reporting solutions Work closely with DBAs and Hadoop resources to help insure the physical design meets the functional and performance requirements of the applications utilizing the data Collaborate with ETL, Report and API developers on data mapping and report/application design Re-engineer existing physical data structures and recommend efficiencies as it relates to data storage and retrieval Automate, monitor, and support data mappings, and re-design if required to make them faster and/or more reliable Design system components which reconcile and audit the results of the extract/transform or conversion of data from source systems to the target structures Conduct quantitative and qualitative analyses of large and complex data Requirements: Expert in designing canonical data structures Full life cycle experience in Data Warehousing (good understanding of Kimball & Inmon methodologies), Data Modeling, Data Integration, and Master Data Management Data modeling and architecture experience implementing proper data structures for a reporting solution from enterprise OLTP systems Ability to communicate in an organized and knowledgeable manner in written and verbal formats including presenting to senior executives, developing lasting relationships, delivering clear requests for information and communicating potential conflicts. Able to identify and addressing customer needs: build solid relationships with customers; communicate with the customer in an organized and knowledgeable manner; deliver clear requests for information; demonstrate flexibility in prioritizing and completing tasks Experience Leading teams: generate a vision, establish direction, and motivate team members; understand personal and team roles; contribute to a positive working environment by building solid relationships with team members; provide guidance, clarification and feedback to less experienced staff Able to manage engagement(s): stay educated on current trends and assist in the development of knowledge capital, contribute to project planning, engagement administration, budget management, and successful completion of customer on-boarding initiatives Demonstrate an understanding that all customers are important whether internal or external Exemplify and promote Lineage’s core values May require some travel (20%) to gather business requirements and collaborate with partners Education and/or Experience: 5+ years - Data Architecture / Modeling experience; delivering both logical models and physical designs with extensive experience with translating business needs into data requirements A degree in Computer Science, a related discipline, or equivalent work experience of 5+ years overall IT or the equivalent combination of education, training and experience from which comparable skills can be acquired At least 2-3 years of experience with open source big data technologies (e.g. Cloudera/Spark/Impala/Hadoop/Kudu, Storm/Heron, Cassandra, Mongo, etc.) Experience with a mix of relational database technologies including Microsoft SQL-Server, Postgres and MySQL At least 3-5 years of experience with data modeling tools like ERwin, ER Studio, PowerDesigner, Oracle Designer and/or other modeling tools Preferred Skills: Previous Supply Chain or Logistics industry experience strongly preferred Experience working with data from the following technologies is a plus: ERP, WMS, TMS, CRM, HRIS Not ready to apply? Proven ability to lead the development and implementation of systems and projects. Excellent verbal and written communication skills Working Conditions Office Environment Tobacco Free Travel (25%)

IT Architect- Big Data
This position will be responsible for strategic design, development and implementation and support of Big Data applications related to Healthcare industry vertical. This would include implementation of mapping solutions to reduce jobs, preprocessing and loading of disparate data sets, databases and associated web applications for data visualization and analytics. This also includes the support of our production Hadoop environment. Essential Duties : Develop and present an overall strategy for Big Data to IT and Business Executives. Translate advanced business analytics problems into technical approaches that yield actionable recommendations, across multiple, diverse domains.· Work with developers, IT Architects and business units within Beaumont Health as needed to create an effective software development blueprint Rapidly design, prototype, and implement enterprise-grade Big Data solutions for a Hadoop platform, by leveraging current ecosystem tools, third party and custom integration frameworks Analyze massive amounts of data and help drive prototype ideas for new tools and products Build (code) and unit test new systems functionality per technical specifications, with deliverables to include code builds and documented unit test results Build and unit test production deployment packages and implementation plans for scheduled systems enhancements. Develop application support documentation as required by the application support teams for acceptance of systems changes into production Mentor and develop team resources on documentation and development of solutions that are aligned with overall strategy. Being able to drive and meet project schedules by providing accurate estimates of effort required for development deliverables, by providing updates on project progress, and by escalating issues that might affect project success to management Communicate results through design and build of insightful visualizations, reports, and presentations for Business and IT audiences. Maintain industry leading technical skills and expertise through continuous education and training. Standard Qualifications Required: Master's Degree in IT OR Bachelor's Degree in IT or engineering related field and 4+ years of experience in developing data warehousing solutions Required: Experience with data modeling, complex data structures, data processing, data quality, and data lifecycle Required: Experience in relational databases and solid SQL skills Required: Exposure to Healthcare sector and previous experience with EMRs Preferred: Minimum 5 years of application development experience in Java/J2EE Preferred: 3+ years of EPIC Clarity/RWB experience Preferred: Minimum 3-5 years development experience on Hadoop platform including PIG, Hive, Sqoop, Hbase, Flume, Spark and related tools to build web applications; including 3 years of professional experience designing and developing Business Intelligence/ Big Data applications Good understanding of Operating Systems (Unix/Linux) and experience in UNIX Shell scripting with experience in code optimization and high performance computing Preferred: Experience in supporting production Hadoop jobs; experience in messaging and collection frameworks like WebSphere MQ, Kafka, and Flume Preferred: Exposure to Hadoop cluster connectivity and tuning map/reduce jobs, and Hadoop security configurations; Hadoop ecosystem experience with Hadoop distributions such as BigInsights, Cloudera, Hortonworks; exposure/experience in Cloud technologies; exposure/experience in NOSQL database Must be a self-starter and be able to work with minimal direction. Team player, ability to work in a fast-paced environment Highly organized with good time management skills; customer service oriented, and strong interpersonal and presentations skills; analytical thinker with creative problem-solving skills and attention to detail Able to travel up to 10% of the time or as needed

text:
Contract and Procurement Specialist IV
The Office of the Chief Financial Officer is seeking to fill multiple Contracting and Procurement Specialist IV positions. The Contracting and Procurement Specialist IV is an advanced level procurement professional that requires nominal direction and supervision. The Contracting and Procurement Specialist IV conducts complex analyses and provides recommendations concerning the City of Detroit procurement requirements. The key services include, but are not limited to: administer contracts by assuring compliance with the terms and conditions of contracts, including resolution of problems concerning the obligations of the parties; analyze and evaluate cost or price proposals and accounting systems data; plan, establish, or review contracts, programs, policies, or procedures; formulate and administer policies and procedures to insure achievement of City socioeconomic goals; develop acquisition strategies and direct or manage procurements; and provide staff advisory services in one or more of the specializations in this occupation. EXAMPLES OF DUTIES: The Contracting and Procurement Specialist IV performs a full range of procurement functions including but not limited to: Plans, assigns, and coordinates the work of Contracting and Procurement Specialists I, II, and III and other clerical and administrative staff; Formulates procedures, policies, and guidelines for bid proposals and procurement of goods and services, including preparing estimates for use in selecting vendors or subcontractors; Leads in researching and writing specifications and preparing time, cost, material, and labor estimates for items to be purchased; Negotiates techniques and technical requirements sufficient to procure complex and/or diversified supplies, services, construction, or research and development; Develops acquisition strategies and directs or manages procurements; Analyzes price proposals, financial reports, and other data and information to determine reasonable prices; Investigates sources of supply for certain commodities and obtains information on new products to meet designated needs; Reviews requisitions for accuracy of description of products and services, and makes referrals to departmental specifications for acceptance or modifies departmental specifications and award criteria; Approves requests for proposals, quotations, and the issuance of formal purchase requisitions; Confers with engineers, architects, owners, contractors and subcontractors on changes and adjustments to cost estimates; Prepares cost and expenditure statements and other necessary documentation at regular intervals for the duration of the project; Sets up cost monitoring and reporting systems and procedures. Reports should include assessment of cost effectiveness of products, projects or services, tracking actual costs relative to bids as the project develops, and develop progress reports; Prepares purchase orders and solicits bid proposals; Researches, analyzes, and evaluates suppliers based on price, quality, selection, service, support, availability, reliability, production and distribution capabilities, and the supplier's reputation and history; Prepares estimates used by management for purposes such as planning, organizing, and scheduling work; Works with bidders, contractors, and other vendors to resolve difficulties which arise during and after the procurement and/or sales process; Reviews computerized or manual records of items purchased, costs, deliveries, product performance, and inventories; Consults with clients, vendors, personnel in other departments, or construction foremen to discuss and formulate estimates and resolve issues; Monitors shipments to ensure that goods come in on time and resolve problems related to undelivered goods; Evaluates and monitors contract performance to ensure compliance with contractual obligations and to determine need for changes; Monitors changes affecting supply and demand, tracking market conditions, price trends, or futures markets; Monitors expenditures to ensure all purchasing is conducted in compliance with City approved policies and procedures; Arranges the payment of duty and freight charges; Researches, analyzes, and evaluates suppliers based on price, quality, selection, service, support, availability, reliability, production and distribution capabilities, and the supplier's reputation and history; Solicits formal advertising sufficient to solicit bids to procure a variety of requirements ranging from standard to specialized supplies, services, or construction; and Monitors and follows applicable laws and regulations. MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS: Education Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university, with major course of work in business or public administration, finance, purchasing or a closely related field. Experience Four (4) years of professional experience conducting procurement related activity, such as administration of contracts, analysis and evaluation of cost or price proposals, and review of contracts is required. Contracting and Procurement Specialist IV must demonstrate proficiency with integrated word processing and spreadsheet functions. License / Certificates There may be a requirement for some positions to have or be working on achieving a Certified Professional Public Buyer (CPPB) and/or Certified Purchasing Manager (CPM) certification. Equivalency Equivalent combinations of education and experience that provide the required knowledge, skills, and abilities will be evaluated on an individual basis.

text:
Experience Architect
_WHY PILLAR? WHY NOT?_ Pillar Technology is a high-tech consulting company taking marketing and strategy by the horns, with an unmatched company culture. Inspired by the inventions of the future, we fuse software craftsmanship, creativity and innovation together to solve our clients’ most challenging problems. And the driving force behind it all? Our people—the Pillar family. _EXPERIENCE ARCHITECT, WHAT?_ Experience Architects are curious problem solvers with a tenacious desire to understand the user experience from start to finish. They work closely with our Experience Designers to provide them the info needed to create beautiful, functional digital experiences. Our Experience Architects are successful because they have: Background in Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Human Factors, Interaction Design, Information Architecture, Ethnographic User Research, or equivalent. Experience as a key member of a DX, UX or design team working within a fast-paced, iterative, Agile environment. Strong knowledge of web, accessibility, design standards and creating artifacts—we’re talking wireframes, interactive prototypes, user personas, journey maps, story maps and user stories. Participated in the complete product development lifecycle of successfully launched digital products—beyond just web design, this also includes web and mobile apps, embedded systems and more. Ability to turn data into knowledge. Proven prowess to plan and conduct user research, including usability testing, interviews and contextual inquiries. Experience with tools like Axure, Sketch, InvisionApp and other prototyping and/or information architecture tools.. Strong portfolio demonstrating experience design for mobile apps, web apps or software—include this in your application please! Proven leadership skills by facilitating design sessions and leading creative discussions with teams and clients alike. _A DAY IN THE LIFE._ So that’s what an Experience Architect is, here’s a look at what to expect: Facilitating design thinking workshops. Communicating and guiding experience development in a multifunctional team. Iteratively adapting to changes in business, product, organization and individual needs. Clearly presenting creative ideas to clients and stakeholders. Rapid prototyping and wireframing clickable prototypes. User testing and user research like it’s your job—well, because it is. _ARE YOU A GAME CHANGER?_ Our mission is to provide an environment where people do what they love and feel empowered to influence change. Of course our open and flexible workspaces, fully-stocked fridge and pantry help create a thriving work ecosystem. But we also support this goal in ways that can’t be contained within four walls—so whether you are working at a client site or at home from your patio, the Forge mindset goes where you go. “No-constraints” thinking—we’re talking “change the world” kind of thinking. Team members who push you to succeed, because they expect you to do the same for them. Diverse and changing work environments. Learning, sharing and working closely with other team members because we take the “two heads are better than one” saying very seriously. A “Speed2Value” approach to solving problems and delivering value. Open communication across the company—direct, expert and personal. Active participation in Agile and software craftsmanship communities and we hope you do the same! Having a direct impact on projects by commuting across Southeast Michigan to work personally with clients, teams, community groups and candidates. _PERKS OF THE JOB._ So what’s in it for you, right? On top of “Creative Collision” lunches served up every Friday, we provide our team members with a dynamic and supportive environment that promotes a healthy work-life balance. Competitive compensation package including salary, medical, dental, vision, short and long-term disability, and life insurance. PTO to do literally whatever you want, and holidays off to spend with whoever you want. 401K with match, because we care about your future beyond Pillar. A flexible and customizable career growth path. Family is family—that’s why it’s important to us to offer adoption assistance, reimbursement of infertility treatment-related expenses, and maternity and paternity leave. Knowledge is power, so we’ll drop $500 a year for you to spend on continuous learning (conferences, books, workshops, etc.). One word—PillarCon—a weekend filled with fun and learning for Pillarites, their families and guests. Flexible work environment, because we know things just come up sometimes. LIKE WHAT YOU SEE? Now that you’ve got the goods on being a part of the Pillar family, we just have one question: Are you ready to unleash your potential? If so, let’s chat. Go ahead and click the “apply” button. Tell us a bit about yourself and one of our Talent Engagement Specialists will be in touch. For more info, check out our website, come to an event at the Forge or reach out and start a conversation with us. We’d love to talk! Pillar Technology is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE). We strongly support diversity in the workplace.

PLEASE ONLY APPLY IF YOU DO NOT NEED SPONSORSHIP TO WORK IN THE UNITED STATES NOW OR IN THE FUTURE. WE ARE UNABLE TO CONSIDER CANDIDATES WHO REQUIRE SPONSORSHIP. Wanted: Software Developers and Information Technologists who are innovators, creative minds, problem solvers, and people who get things done! At General Motors, we’ve charged ourselves with one mission: to design, build and sell the world’s best vehicles. We have recently undergone one of the largest Information Technology transformations in the history of the automotive industry and continue to drive technology innovations within General Motors. GM IT is a leader in cutting edge technologies such as Mobility, Telematics, Mission-Critical Business Systems, Supercomputing, Vehicle Engineering, and Real-time Computing. We offer challenging positions for passionate professionals looking to get in on the ground-floor of a growing “Fortune 5” firm that is re-inventing IT with a laser focus on Innovation, Speed, and Business Value. We’re looking for Information Technology graduates who: Have an insatiable drive for excellence Challenge themselves and their peers Enjoy working collaboratively in a cross-functional teams Demonstrate a strong work ethic Have a strong ability and willingness to learn Excel in a variety of job assignments Understand physics and math concepts, and have the ability to apply them to real applications Desire to deliver innovative solutions to complex problems In addition to specific areas below, our roles require critical thinking, excellent communication, and a passion for service excellence. If you have what it takes, come join our team in one of the many following positions: The Software Developer is responsible for developing solutions that drive innovation and competitive advantage. The role encompasses writing code to build and support GM’s systems, applications, and platforms as well as configuring, optimizing, and deploying packaged software (COTS). The role will interface with other project developers and architects to ensure that designs and quality are meeting GM requirements. Each Developer is envisioned to be part of the full SDLC of a project: from initiation through deployment. Minimal Qualifications include: Experience with programming in Java, .NET or other languages Knowledge of XML and relational databases (Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL) Familiarity with packaged software (eg., SAP, PeopleSoft, Sharepoint, etc.) Knowledge of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) as well as software development methodologies (e.g. Agile, Scrum, Iterative, Waterfall, etc.) Understanding of security, efficient code reuse, and software design The Software Test Analyst is responsible for testing solutions that drive innovation and competitive advantage. The role encompasses testing code and writing automation code to build and support GM’s systems, applications, and platforms as well as testing packaged software (COTS). The role will interface with other project members such as testers, product owners, business analysts and developers to ensure that designs and quality are meeting GM requirements. Each Test Analyst is envisioned to be part of the full SDLC of a project: from initiation through deployment, and assumes the critical quality role in the software development process. Minimal Qualifications include: Experience with programming in VB, Java, .NET or other languages Knowledge of XML and relational databases (Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL) Familiarity with packaged software (eg., SAP, Siebel, PeopleSoft, SharePoint, etc.) Knowledge of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) as well as software development methodologies (e.g. Agile, Scrum, Iterative, Waterfall, etc.) Understanding of security, efficient code reuse, and software design The Database Administrator will work with other organizations in the deployment, management, and support of all databases world-wide. This includes but is not limited to, working closely with database vendors, infrastructure groups, other DBAs, and application developers to implement, monitor, manage, control, upgrade, and patch consistently across GM’s database landscape. Working primarily from our I/T Innovation center sites, this business critical role is providing around the clock active monitoring and implementation services of GM’s critical database infrastructure. Some positions do features flexible shift opportunities, database development roles or emerging database technology roles. Minimal Qualifications include: Exposure to enterprise database technology (Oracle, SQL Server, DB2, MySQL or similar) Basic technical knowledge across multiple technology areas including: Java platform, Net framework, performance tuning, storage, networking, client libraries Basic awareness of data modeling, database design and architecture Excellent analytical, problem solving, written and oral communication skills Ability to concentrate and pay close attention to detail and think broadly with a system orientation Great team player The Information Security Specialist applies solid information security principles and best practices to their specific discipline, regardless of the specialization. This includes the understanding of the application of security concepts including risk management, compliance, threat and vulnerability assessments, information protection and access control, security processes, policy and standards. These skills are applied across a broad range of areas including operational security, application design and development, technology evaluation and acquisition. Minimum Qualifications include: Proficiency in computer programming, administration and/or scripting Knowledge of cyber security and risk management practices Knowledge of security architectures, tools and technologies Experience with designing secure applications and data protection Familiarity security forensics, vulnerability assessment and policy implementation Excellent collaboration and teamwork – ability to work cross functionally The IT Operations Engineer is a dynamic role that comprehends specific responsibilities pertaining to one or more of the following areas: Incident management and response Monitoring and continuity planning Service desk and user support Problem resolution and root-cause analysis System administration Database administration Minimal Qualifications include: Knowledge of Service Operations concepts (ITIL) Skills proficiency in System, Network, Security or Database operations and administration Knowledge of infrastructure and IT trends such as Cloud Computing Excellent collaboration and teamwork – ability to work cross functionally The Network Engineer role is responsible for analyzing, designing, installing, administering, maintaining, and troubleshooting network systems. As part of a high-performance global team, the Network Engineer participates in capacity planning, supports the creation and the maintenance of network disaster recovery plans, and monitors all network performance activities. Minimal Qualifications include: Knowledge of networking infrastructure and operations Familiarity and exposure to technical concepts in data, video, and voice services Knowledge of Service Operations concepts (ITIL) and networking protocols Excellent collaboration and teamwork – ability to work cross functionally These entry level positions are recruited through our on campus and organization recruiting efforts. For more information on our process and our event and interview dates, please check out our Student Center Recruiting Calendar at https://search-careers.gm.com/eventscalendar Requirements: Education: Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Software Engineering degree preferred Preferred minimum cumulative GPA of 3.0 Job locations will be in one of our IT Innovation Centers: Detroit or Warren, Michigan; Roswell, Georgia; Austin, Texas; and Chandler, Arizona May have some work on an alternate shift. You must have the right to work in the U.S. without sponsorship (training/learning visas not sufficient)

text:
Move In Coordinator
Stonecrest is a premier Assisted Living and Memory Care community designed by award winning architects encompassing a new generation of Senior Living. We are dedicated to providing the highest level of quality lifestyle and care for seniors in a world class, upscale community environment. If you believe in putting people first, taking ownership of every situation, doing the right thing every time and living generously, then Stonecrest Senior Living is the place for you! Stonecrest Senior Living is committed to a work environment that encompasses integrity, respect and customer focus. We are dedicated to recognizing individual strengths where employees can attain a personal satisfaction in their work while promoting a team-oriented atmosphere. Join our Stonecrest Team! The Move In Coordinator is responsible for assisting the Director of Sales and Marketing in actively acquiring and managing short- and long-term leads. These responsibilities include handling telephone, walk-in, and inbound mail inquiries; qualifying prospects; converting qualified leads to tours; converting tours to deposits; and, assisting with move ins in accordance with established procedures. The Move-In Coordinator is also responsible for the smooth transition of a new resident into the community. Greet and assist residents, families, guests, staff and visitors at the concierge desk and respond appropriately to all inquiries about the community. As directed, handle inbound telephone, walk-in and mail inquiries including completing the inquiry information form, entering inquiry information into the electronic database and follow-up correspondence. Qualify prospects, convert qualified prospects to tours and convert tours to deposits using the sales process. Give community tours as a backup to the Community Relations Manager and provide marketing information in accordance with the marketing process. Coordinate inquiry follow-up activity with the Community Relations Manager. Assist the Community Relations Manager in implementing plans to acquire leads, manage leads and increase census. As assigned, serve as a liaison for residents and family members new to the community. Work to ensure that all new residents have a smooth transition by creating welcome signs; introducing the new resident to key community staff; planning and hosting new resident parties/luncheons; introducing new residents to other residents, training new residents on the community’s emergency call system; scheduling the new resident’s showers, laundry, housekeeping and other internal tasks; assigning the new resident a table/seat in the dining room; and any other tasks assigned. Qualifications Prior experience in marketing, sales, advertising and client experience preferred. Telephone sales experience preferred. A Bachelor’s degree (B.A./B.S.) from a four year college or university preferred. Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data. Excellent writing/communication skills. Strong Microsoft Office Suite skills (Word, Excel) Experience with database or customer relationship management software preferred. Enjoy working in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment. PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS: Continuous walking and standing Must be able to perform work both inside and outside, which requires stooping, bending and lifting of approximately 75 pounds

stonecrest is a premier assisted living and memory care community designed by award winning architects encompassing a new generation of senior living. we are dedicated to providing the highest level of quality lifestyle and care for seniors in a world class, upscale community environment. if you believe in putting people first, taking ownership of every situation, doing the right thing every time and living generously, then stonecrest senior living is the place for you! stonecrest senior living is committed to a work environment that encompasses integrity, respect and customer focus. we are dedicated to recognizing individual strengths where employees can attain a personal satisfaction in their work while promoting a team-oriented atmosphere. join our stonecrest team! the move in coordinator is responsible for assisting the director of sales and marketing in actively acquiring and managing short- and long-term leads. these responsibilities include handling telephone, walk-in, and inbound mail inquiries; qualifying prospects; converting qualified leads to tours; converting tours to deposits; and, assisting with move ins in accordance with established procedures. the move-in coordinator is also responsible for the smooth transition of a new resident into the community. greet and assist residents, families, guests, staff and visitors at the concierge desk and respond appropriately to all inquiries about the community. as directed, handle inbound telephone, walk-in and mail inquiries including completing the inquiry information form, entering inquiry information into the electronic database and follow-up correspondence. qualify prospects, convert qualified prospects to tours and convert tours to deposits using the sales process. give community tours as a backup to the community relations manager and provide marketing information in accordance with the marketing process. coordinate inquiry follow-up activity with the community relations manager. assist the community relations manager in implementing plans to acquire leads, manage leads and increase census. as assigned, serve as a liaison for residents and family members new to the community. work to ensure that all new residents have a smooth transition by creating welcome signs; introducing the new resident to key community staff; planning and hosting new resident parties/luncheons; introducing new residents to other residents, training new residents on the community’s emergency call system; scheduling the new resident’s showers, laundry, housekeeping and other internal tasks; assigning the new resident a table/seat in the dining room; and any other tasks assigned. qualifications prior experience in marketing, sales, advertising and client experience preferred. telephone sales experience preferred. a bachelor’s degree (b.a./b.s.) from a four year college or university preferred. strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data. excellent writing/communication skills. strong microsoft office suite skills (word, excel) experience with database or customer relationship management software preferred. enjoy working in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment. physical requirements: continuous walking and standing must be able to perform work both inside and outside, which requires stooping, bending and lifting of approximately 75 pounds

BI COE Senior Big Data Solution Architect/ Manager
Adient is embarking on a digital journey to drive the adoption of social, mobile, analytics and cloud technologies (SMAC). As advanced analytics is an integral part of the digital transformation strategy, we are in need of a Business Intelligence COE Solution Architect / Manager for big data solutions. This position will report to the Senior Manager of Reporting Architecture & Projects. The successful candidate will lead the strategy and design, maintenance & data modeling of the Enterprise BI template with an emphasis on big data solutions. This role will be responsible for delivering best practice solution(s) based on leading industry practices, business process expertise & expertise in Business Intelligence Advanced Analytics. He/she will be responsible for solution reviews, security compliance, and providing expertise to other team members throughout the development lifecycle. Core Responsibilities: Provides consultation to application owners, business partners and peer groups regarding long and short-range architecture solutions to meet business imperatives; recommends solutions and develop business case alternatives which anticipate the future direction of the business, its drivers and technology strategy Analyzes business requirements/use cases to translate them into executable designs based on BI best practices Design data flow and processing pipelines for ingestion and analysis using modern toolsets such as AWS, MS Azure and Hadoop. Design and architect multidimensional databases for data warehouse and analytics processing applications Responsible for building Proof of Concept/prototyping for validation of proposed solutions in the BI domain Supports the design and maintenance of the Enterprise BI Template according to business requirements and ensure its continued governance and evolution; this includes reviews and sign-offs to production changes such as configuration and enhancements and associated system design and deployment deliverables such as functional & technical design specs, test results etc. Provides effort and cost estimation deliverables Provide Level 3 support to the BI COE Operations team Qualifications Basic Qualifications: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline. Master’s degree in related discipline preferred. 8+ years of Data Warehouse design and development experience; developing ETL processes/data sync between two or more 'operational' systems Good knowledge of standard methodologies, concepts, best practices, and procedures within a Big Data environment Implementation and tuning experience specifically in Hadoop, MS Azure, Hortonworks, AWS, MapR + tools such as Pig, Hive, Impala, Splunk, Spark, etc. Experience with Business Intelligence data acquisition methodologies (Data Stage, Enterprise Application Integration (EAI), native Oracle PL/SQL and APIs) Proficiency in R or Python, PL/SQL , CSS, Javascript, Java Experience in visualization tools such as MS Power BI, Tableau, Qlik, etc Understanding of streaming analytics, cloud architecture and methods for data provisioning into the big data platform. Advanced SQL skills, including the ability to write, tune, and interpret SQL queries; tool specific experience in the Oracle 12c and Microsoft SQL Server is ideal Expertise with full application development lifecycle (analysis, architecture, design, development, testing and deployment) Experienced in working in an Agile\Rapid Prototyping environment, Agile Methodology Customer facing and presentation skills with a high degree of professional confidence and credibility to represent the BI COE within the customer’s environment and drive discussions of IT related concepts effectively with all levels of the business with both technical peers and non-technical partners Demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, product, and technical challenges in an enterprise environment. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills Preferred Qualifications: Experience in Automotive is a plus Data Science certification is a plus Experience with SAP Business Intelligence (SAP BW HANA, SAP Business Objects) Job Information Systems Primary LocationUS-MI-Southfield Organization Automotive Seating

Architect
Purpose of Position: Architects are an important part of a well- functioning team. Architects work closely with the development team, providing mentorship through technical guidance, pair development, code review feedback, and assistance debugging stubborn issues. Product owners and project managers also work closely with the architecture team to refine requirements, identify risk, define solutions and estimate tasks. As part of our team you will be challenged to deliver secure, reliable and scalable solutions to our web and back office applications. Essential Functions: Evaluate technologies, best practices, and patterns in the best interests for solutions design Create proof-of-concept level prototypes to assist in solution determination and estimation Coordinate cross-team development changes and vision across teams Champion code reviews, enforcing and creating support for best-in-class code clarity, quality, and maintainability Support developer workspaces and deployed environments Assist with issue resolution and root-cause analysis Act as the technical domain expert for your product Maintain safety, security, and privacy standards throughout all areas of responsibility Essential Requirements: Fluent in Java and common Java libraries. Our developers work on both front-end and back-end code, so you should also feel comfortable with modern HTML, JavaScript, and CSS. You should understand data structures, relational databases, and have the ability to quickly grasp new languages, frameworks, and APIs. In addition to being hands on, you should be able to lead the design and implementation for new products and features. The key is being meticulous while meeting objectives, managing own assignments, and working independently towards goals. Non-Essential Requirements: B.S. in Computer Sciences or related field, advanced degrees preferred Experience with presentation technologies such as HTML, JavaScript, CSS, and XSL/T Architecture experience with synchronous and/or asynchronous messaging constructs, standards and technologies such as MQ Series, SOAP, SOA, HTTP messaging Experience in performance tuning J2EE applications a plus jQuery, Angular or other JavaScript frameworks Messaging or distributed caching Familiarity with the Spring core and MVC frameworks Understanding of design patterns, domain driven design, test driven development Experience using version control systems such as Git, CVS, or SVN Experience with automated build systems Knowledge of popular software development processes Solid understanding of maintainable software development principles Experience with various testing types: unit, integration, load, performance, functional, etc. Understanding of security concepts with a focus on web application security

text:
Data Analytics External Monetization Manager
Who we are At General Motors, we embrace the opportunity to think bigger and aim higher. It’s the confidence in knowing our ideas produce exceptional vehicles and mobility solutions that move the world in exciting new ways. With strong leadership and bold vision, we’re directing the future of transportation—and enriching people’s lives along the way. What we do Breakthroughs happen every day here—from advances in vehicle electrification and fuel cell technology to automation and connected car platforms. The knowledge and perspectives of our diverse workforce offer insight into the changing needs of our customers, spark inventive ways to improve our vehicles and elevate our business. And we’re developing more sustainable methods along the way that maximize our planet’s resources and benefit our surrounding communities. Why work with us We combine the passion of a startup with the influence of a global powerhouse. We offer careers that are built on a strong foundation and are motivated by discovery. We encourage you to explore few of the many reasons to unleash your talent with General Motors. GM has led the automobile industry for years with its connected cars, OnStar service, 4G Wifi in virtually every automobile, and most recently its venture into autonomous cars. The prevalence of these data across literally millions of cars translates into massive amounts of data ranging from car performance (tire pressure, gas consumption, radio utilization, etc.) to driver behavior (speeding, sudden stops, location, and the like). Simultaneously, over the past 5 years, Information Technology has created a best-in-class Hadoop environment to house these and other data about the customer including digital behavior, third-party demographics, service and warranty transactions, and many more. To-date, most of these data have gone untapped and the Chairman and CEO believes there is opportunity to create better customer experiences, maximize safety, drive incremental revenue, and monetize the data externally through marketplaces and new products. To solve for this, the company recently hired its first Chief Data & Analytics Officer, who will shepherd a cross- enterprise endeavor to maximize the ROI of its Data and Analytics efforts. The Function & Role The External Monetization lead identifies opportunities in GM’s data to monetize them. It coordinates all external monetization efforts at GM, sets targets and goals by opportunity type (e.g. direct sales of data to third parties, negotiating with aggregators, introducing new services available to current customers, dealers, or suppliers, etc.). These data include both vehicle-related data, as well as critical, anonymized information about GM’s customers. Currently, there are three types of external monetization (with more to be discovered by the External Monetization team):  1-to-1 Sales – activities in which the company identifies targets who will want to purchase data assets from General Motors. These one-off opportunities are smaller in nature, but have the potential to be very profitable since they involve no third-party.  Aggregation Opportunities – partnering with data aggregation companies to make customer data available to companies wishing to make special offers to GM customers.  Greenfield – un-predicted opportunities to mine our data to create new data products to sell to prospective companies and/or create new marketplaces. The data external monetization manager will identify monetization opportunities aligned with the overall external data monetization strategy. In addition, the external monetization manager will work with Data Architects to ensure the appropriate data is available (meaning coverage across the GM customer base, the amount of time data are stored, and the types of data we collect and retain from either the vehicle or from our customers) and Data Science and Analytics team to ensure that right insights are applied. Responsible for creating roadmap for the new data products, taking it through incubation and to production and managing P&L; associated with the product Work cross functionally with engineering, IT and data analytics to lead ideation, incubation, development, and launch for the data products Successful experience managing stakeholders across the organization and influencing without formal authority Own and drive the product development roadmap for the Company’s monetization products. Responsibility for the full product lifecycle from initial concepts to commercial launch. Determine prioritization of features and functionalities of each data product with needs of the consumer in mind Key partners  Information Technology (for data and tools)  Head of Data Sciences and Advanced Analytics  Global Connected Customer Experience team (including its business development)  Legal & Privacy  Information Security  Collaborative team player orientation towards work relationships, strong culture awareness  M&A; and/or business development skills  Highly developed skills in priority setting and alignment of project priorities with business strategy  Ability to break down complex problems and projects into manageable goals  Ability to influence people, skilled in communicating the benefits of data analysis to business line professionals to create a value proposition  Effectiveness in building trust, respect and cooperation among teams  A well-rounded consulting skill set or deep B2B monetization background would be highly valued. Experience  Preferred – 3-5+ years experience creating data products and selling to external businesses  experience with a Data Services and Analytics service provider (Fair Issac, Experian, Acxiom Equifax) or agency (e.g. Merkle) Education Quant undergrad degree MBA (preferred)

Global Business Architect - Infotainment and Telematics
Global Business Architect Infotainment and Telematics: Displays, Controls and Audio Systems Description: The Global Business Architect (BA) is the Systems Management Team (SMT) focal point for cost ownership in Engineering. The role combines component level knowledge, strategy and cost data to feed vehicle programs with appropriate solutions at the right time. The BA role allows for some operational differences across functional areas due to the varied nature of the components. The Global Business Architect (BA) enables engineering to focus more on cost management and cost avoidance through invention and less on after the fact continuous improvement efforts. They understand technical strategies for parts in their area, with associated costs / tradeoffs for the near and long-term needs of the business. The BA is also the single-point contact for managing the status of Global B Electrical Architecture component issues and initiatives for the Displays, Controls and Audio Systems area. TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES: The BA is the driver for managing the business in their area of responsibility. Responsible for business imperatives (piece cost, tooling, enterprise cost) In addition to imperatives responsibilities, the BA may be the focal point to develop ED &D; business cases for the Financial Review Board (FRB), Budget Lead, Workload Model, Etc., within their area of responsibility. They will Work and Collaborate cross-functionally with Purchasing, Engineering, Program engineering and Cost Engineering, including: Buyers/ Global Customer Master (GCM's) Engineers, Vehicle Systems Engineers (VSE), Leads, BOM Family owners, Engineering Management and Global Subsystem Leadership team. Cost Engineers Program Finance The day-to-day Global B tasks involve interacting with the Engineering Group Manager (EGMs) and Design Release Engineers (DREs) to gather, track and communicate Global B issues to the Director and larger Global B leadership team and to roll out Global B initiatives/requests to the EGMs and DREs. Program Focus: Vehicle System Engineering / BOM Family Owner Support / Program Solutions Drive accurate production intent cost data into the global product development pipeline for initial program cost books. System Team Management BA’s are primary contact point for Cost Imperatives, maintaining and providing data to be used for status and target setting. Drive accuracy and consistency into Program Target Setting activity, i.e. Read-Across database, part of assembly ownership Document Program Target setting data for historical reference Support disciplined approach to early content definition, escalate product program content fidelity disconnects when inadequate or out of sync with target. Drive consistency into the Design Direction Review (DDR). Highlight total cost implications of DDR selections (complexity, supplier foot print, piece cost, investment, logistics) Review and approve all program BOM Picks to ensure programs content and solutions are in line with business strategies. Provide accurate data to rapidly evaluate option cost studies Investment Costs - Coordinate with Vendor Tooling/Vehicle Systems Engineering to document early tooling forecasts/assumptions by program. Understand detail and raise concerns early based on assigned area. Identify component BOM Strategy disconnects early enough in program development to impact System Management Team design/strategy. Component Focus: Ownership and documentation of component cost data. Gives Direction for updates to Cost Database when appropriate. Data intended to be shared between Global Purchasing & Supply Chain, Engineering, New Program Development Attends sourcing table as required to support global functional lead staff with data & background EDD Expertise and read-across for assigned areas Incorporate use of Big Data for read-across Cross Systems Management Team's Communication for cost and access point to Electrical Expertise Train and mentor new engineers and buyers to understand the cost structure of their components Request Cost Engineering support where appropriate. CE performs traditional functions, Estimates, Models, Reviews, Rates, Etc. Job Description The Central Software Organization and Software Architecture team within Product Development is dedicated to enhancing existing software related solutions and creating new and exciting software technologies that integrate with existing architectures as well as our next generation mobility ecosystem. This position is focused on ensuring Ford teams share a cohesive view of Service Oriented Architecture (SOA), related services and vehicle level application programming interfaces. Responsibilities : Develop and refine SOA related specifications. Develop feature focused software architectures and designs that are scalable across different physical architectures. Develop and refine use cases and functional level requirements for features participating in SOA. Support the transition of ECUs to SOA and domain controllers. Create SOA services that are portable across different ECUs. Create vehicle side application programing interfaces that transforms data into information for backend systems and partner developers. Support the development of system and subsystem level design, interfaces, and specifications to ensure production feature delivery across the entire range of Ford Motor Company vehicle offerings. Plan and execute real-world evaluations of SOA services and related features to identify system problems and issues. Basic Qualifications: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Electrical, Mechanical, Aerospace, Controls, Software Engineering 5+ years’ experience in embedded software design and development Preferred Qualifications: Knowledge of service oriented architectures. Knowledge of IoT, cloud related architectures and edge computing. A technical foundation that facilitates the development into the role of a Software Architect. Experience with POSIX based operating systems. Understanding of embedded hardware and software architectures. Experience with production embedded software system The distance between imagination and … creation. It can be measured in years of innovation, or in moments of brilliance.
