text:
Architect II
Attends work on a regular and predictable schedule in accordance with agency leave policy and performs other duties as assigned. Architect II performs complex construction inspections of healthcare facilities located throughout Texas for general and special hospitals, private psychiatric hospital and crisis stabilization units (PPH&CSU;), ambulatory surgical centers (ASC), end stage renal disease facilities (ESRD), special care facilities (SCF), and freestanding emergency medical care facilities (FEMC) within the multiple licensing programs of Architectural Review Group (ARG). On-site health facilities construction inspections and Medicare Life Safety Surveys (LSC) assures that facilities comply with State statutes, licensing rules, National Fire Protection Association (NFPA) standards, and Medicare Conditions of Participation (CoP). Investigates complaints regarding services provided by provider facilities or agencies. Responsible for data entry and processing of technical reports, which identifies deficiencies/violations. Evaluates the healthcare facility’s corrective actions and preventive measures and supporting documentation. Provides consultative feasibility conferences and phone conferences pertinent to federal and state statutes and technical rules to current and prospective healthcare facilities and their design disciplines, regulated community and governmental agencies. Accurately interprets rules/regulations to determine compliance. Reviews construction documents for proposed new health care facilities and new additions, remodels, modifications and/or expansion to existing facilities. Prepares required documentation necessary for the Health and Human Services Commission (HHSC). Makes appropriate referrals to state and federal agencies. Other duties as assigned include but are not limited to actively participating and/or serving in a supporting role to meet the agency’s obligations for disaster response and/or recovery or Continuity of Operations (COOP) activation. Such participation may require an alternate shift pattern assignment and/or location. Works under general supervision with extensive latitude for initiative and independent judgment. Essential Job Functions: (45%) Conducts on-site pre-construction, intermediate, and final construction inspections at hospitals, PPH &CSUs;, ASCs, SCFs, ESRDs, and FEMC’s to assure compliance with State statutes, licensing rules and NFPA standards. Performs on-site physical plant initial surveys and resurveys, hospital validation surveys, critical access surveys, and complaint investigations to assess compliance with applicable Medicare regulations and NFPA standards. Makes appropriate professional judgments and applies professional expertise in technical skills on fire safety design in evaluating health care facilities. Responsible for composing deficiency reports outlining violations of state and NFPA Standards using word processing, spreadsheets, the Internet, email and data entry to track reports. Assures that all HHSC required documentation is accurate, concise, and timely so that construction is not detained. Enters Medicare survey reports into federal database. Visits facilities to verify correction of previously cited regulatory violations. This position ensures completeness of project documentation. (20%) Conducts in-office consultative feasibility conferences with health facility representatives (architects, engineers, health care providers, etc.) to assure compliance with State statutes, State licensing rules, NFPA Standards/Codes and Medicare requirements. Interprets, verbally or in writing (e-mail or correspondence) for interested individuals ranging from lay persons to technical experts. Provides complex technical assistance on incoming calls/emails questions. Answers incoming telephone calls requesting construction and building systems technical assistance to public, stakeholders, and other State agency. Able to deal with people in a tactful manner and to explain proper interpretation of technical requirements pertaining to rules and regulations. (20%) Reviews construction documents (architectural, structural, mechanical, plumbing and electrical plans and specifications). Using word processing, writes plan review reports, citing violations of State statutes, State licensing rules, NFPA Standards/Codes and Medicare requirements, or approves the plans. Reviews design architect’s and engineer’s letters of disposition and revised plans, as necessary. (10%) Completes necessary department forms and records such as employee time records, travel vouchers, performance evaluation, etc. in a timely manner. Assists in writing, rewriting, formulating and updating existing licensing rules as necessary by offering suggestions for content. Attends workshops, seminars and training as needed to keep abreast of code and licensing changes. (5%) Other duties necessary for smooth daily operations and management objectives within ARG, including representing the agency with expert testimony for depositions, hearings, and/or trials involving actions taken against facilities. Other duties as assigned include but are not limited to actively participating and/or serving in a supporting role to meet the agency’s obligations for disaster response and/or recovery or Continuity of Operations (COOP) activation. Such participation may require an alternate shift pattern assignment and/or location. Works under general supervision with extensive latitude for initiative and independent judgment. Attends work on a regular and predictable schedule in accordance with agency leave policy and performs other duties as assigned. Knowledge Skills Abilities: Skill in verbal communication. Ability to communicate effectively and intelligently with public, stakeholders, and other State agencies. Ability to record that information by drafting correspondence. Ability to communicate verbally with various facility personnel to obtain required survey information. Ability to conduct interviews, record information, prepare case narratives/lengthy documents using word processing. Skill in composing, editing, and proofreading correspondence and reports. Technical writing ability to prepare concise reports and business correspondence. Skill in the use of personal computers and software packages including Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook and database programs. Skill in establishing and maintaining positive and professional business and working relationships with co-workers, other program personnel, and the general public. Ability to work in a team environment and work with all levels of staff. Ability to express ideas clearly and concisely. Ability to learn, remember and integrate complex concepts and complicated processes involving healthcare Life Safety Code regulations. Skill in the development of standard operating procedures for administrative functions and confidential records and information. Ability to handle substantial workload and coordinate/prioritize multiple assignments with minimal supervision, and to exercise independent judgment. Ability to independently analyze new situations and respond with sound technical judgment. Ability to climb ladders and go through tight spaces; such as attics and mezzanines. Registration or Licensure Requirements: Registered as an Architect by the Texas Board of Architectural Examiners. Initial Selection Criteria: The following six (6) criteria are REQUIRED; the hiring supervisor cannot consider any applicant that does not meet all six (6) of the required criteria for this position. 1. Experience writing reports and letters via organizing, preparing, proofreading and presenting information in written format. 2. Experience using computers for such functions as word processing, spreadsheets, and e-mail programs. 3. Experience in a position requiring direct contact with the public and presenting information in written and/or verbal format. 4. Must possess a valid Class C (or higher) Texas driver’s license or equivalent license from another state 5. Registered Architect. 6. Educational experience that indicates a mastery of the engineering/architectural knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job functions. Additional Information: CMS Surveyor Qualification preferred or must successfully obtain within the first year of employment 60% travel is required. Requires overnight travel. May be required to work other than usual hours (8 a.m. – 5 p.m. M-F) including evenings, weekends, and holidays. Outside work in inclement weather may be required. May be directed to work in any area of the state as needed. Employee must possess and provide a current, valid Texas driver’s license. You may be asked to provide a copy of your driving record. Must have reliable transportation. Note: Military occupation(s) that relate to the initial selection criteria and registration or licensure requirements for this position may include, but not limited to: 51S, 32EX, 510X, 653X. All active duty military, reservists, guardsmen, and veterans are encouraged to apply if qualified to fill this position. WD-BIM/Revit Designer
_Stretch yourself – and your potential to succeed. ETS-Lindgren is the leading solutions company providing components and systems that measure, shield and control electromagnetic and acoustic energy. Throughout our company, our people bring a wide array of abilities and backgrounds – strong interpersonal capabilities, technological savvy, and every skill set in between. Join a global, team-oriented organization. Where the work is interesting and the days are filled with exciting, new types of projects for a wide variety of clients._ _www.ets-lindgren.com_ _Be a key member of the ETS-Lindgren team, a world leader in the development and manufacturing of RF Test and measurement products._ NOTE: Only one job vacancy is available. The selected candidate will work in the Wood Dale, IL office or the Cedar Park, TX office. _J_ _ob Description:_ ETS-Lindgren, an international manufacturer of components and systems to measure, shield and control electromagnetic and acoustic energy, seeks a BIM/Revit Designer to work in our A.E.C division who is a highly motivated individual and is driven to work in on unconventional architectural designs in a design build environment. Our BIM Modeling Services include 3D BIM Modeling and Clash coordination in Revit 2017 & 2018\. BIM modeling and coordination with general contractors utilizing 2D, 3D components. Specializing in R.F shielded enclosures, Architectural, and Structural modeling. In this position you will work in the AEC division of ETS-Lindgren with other Architects and Designers of similar background. Responsibilities: Responsibilities include extensive use of Revit, and Auto Cad to virtually design and model R.F shielded enclosures to create architectural, electrical and mechanical construction documents with structural detailing ability and preparing Bills of Materials in an MRP system. Interface with the customer, general contractors, project management and architects on various projects both domestic and international. Work with our clients during the pre-construction phase to build 3D models, 2D Shop Drawings, As-Built and Submittal drawings This is a fast paced environment and will require an individual who has flexibility, creativity and a willingness to do whatever it takes to get the job done. The right candidate must be an assertive, self-starter with excellent communication skills, must be able to work in a team environment and adapt to changing priorities. Qualifications: Education AA degree in Design, Architecture, Technology or 3 years BIM modeling experience Experience 1-3 years of experience in an Architecture design/build firm using CAD and Revit or any equivalent combination of education and experience. Knowledge Skills and Abilities Working knowledge of Revit 2018 and AutoCAD 2018. Good understanding of basic AEC; Architectural Engineering and Construction methods. Analyze building codes, space and site requirements, and other technical documents and reports to determine their effect on architectural designs. Draw rough and detailed scaled plans for foundations, buildings and structures, based on preliminary concepts, sketches, engineering calculations, specification sheets and other data. Obtain and assemble data to complete architectural designs, visiting job sites to accurately document existing conditions as necessary. Ensure installation compliance with design specifications and provide guidance of any design changes. Structural Steel detailing is a plus. Be an enthusiastic champion in the advancement of Building Information Modeling The ability to work in a variety of construction environments including commercial, government, industrial and health care related projects. Ability to read and interpret detailed drawings and specifications. Working knowledge of good dimensioning and tolerance principles. Good organizational skills and the ability to handle numerous priorities simultaneously. ETS-Lindgren offers: Competitive Wages Medical/Dental/Vision/Life Insurance Paid vacation and holidays 401K with company match Employee Stock Purchase Plan with company match Tuition Reimbursement ETS- Lindgren is an equal opportunity employer

Chief Data Scientist Solution Architect - Virtual / Texas Job
Chief Data Scientist Solution Architect - Virtual / Texas (Job Number:437693) Description: JOB DESCRIPTION: Company is a trusted partner to the government, providing scientific analysis and modeling, engineering, information technology and high performance computing solutions to NASA, NOAA, DoD and all branches of service, DoE, and other Federal and state government agencies. The Chief Data Scientist plays a leadership position in the data science department and is responsible for overseeing activities of the junior data science team ensuring proper execution of duties and alignment with the business’s overall vision. The Chief Data Scientist is responsible for the creation of new data sciences capabilities for the business by envisioning and executing strategies that will influence improvement of the business’s performance by enabling informed decision-making. The Chief Data Scientist proactively works with business executives and various departmental heads across the business in order to provide advanced analytic data modeling systems. The Chief Data Scientist designs and launches innovative and complex analytic models, utilizing a blend of contemporary and traditional data mining techniques, which he applies to both structured and unstructured data sets. The Chief Data Scientist leads the development of big data capabilities and utilization as well as the coordination of cross-functional analytic initiatives. Leadership/Supervisory Role: This is a leadership position responsible for playing the role of leading innovation within the business and, as such, defining how the business creates additional value through the utilization of its data assets and analytics. The Chief Data Scientist is tasked with consistently identifying and monitor key business risks and realizing the data needs of the business. The Chief Data Scientist oversees all data science proposal activities ensuring alignment with market segment and subsegment vision and strategies. In this position, it is also the Chief Data Scientist’s role to drive education and evangelization of data sciences throughout the business by communicating the vision and use cases of advanced analytics. This is an Engineering position, which will provide for Research and Development activities in areas such as enterprise deployment of deep neural networks, integration with big data analytics platforms including Apache Spark, Apache Hadoop and SAIC analytics products as an example. Develop functionality in an agile fashion, with regular releases. Learn new technologies and techniques from efficient GPU programming, C, CUDA, Python and Java code. Design and develop analytics solutions and products for production use. Prototype new technologies and approaches to assess alternatives. Work as part of an agile team, delivering new functionality on a regular cadence. Work in a collaborative and fast-paced fun team environment with effective communication and assisting peers. Be an asset and contributor to the team. Contribute to designing and building our next generation architecture/ platform for Machine and Deep Learning. Work with a group of Machine Learning engineers, data scientists and product management. Distill business objectives into technical solutions through effective system design and architecture. Show ownership and completion for delivery of technical functions. Provide technical and analytical solutions to evaluate the merits and challenges of a product idea. Perform high complexity integration testing, distributed development and validate integration. Qualifications: REQUIRED EDUCATION: BS is required. BS, MS or Ph.D in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Science or other related technical discipline is preferred. REQUIRED EXPERIENCE/SKILLS: Overall 14+ years of experience managing or supporting in a significant role, the acquisition, integration, and acceptance lifecycle of one or more complex computational systems or system upgrades in a mission critical or production R&D; computational environment. 3+ years of full time programming experience within an operations or technical department. Understanding of programming concepts and application development. In-depth understanding of one or more computational technical areas such as advanced modeling and simulation. Domain knowledge in artificial intelligence and machine learning Demonstrated ability to manage complex projects, creating innovative processes and solutions. Problem solving and analysis skills. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Experience working for federal agencies in a consulting position. Experience specifying user-representative requirements for complex computational environments. Clearance: US Citizen Ability to obtain a SECRET Clearance Work Location and Travel: Flexwork in Texas, ideally Austin area. 100% telecommute. Travel would be up to 50% SAIC Overview:SAIC is a premier technology integrator providing full life cycle services and solutions in the technical, engineering, intelligence, and enterprise information technology markets. SAIC is Redefining Ingenuity through its deep customer and domain knowledge to enable the delivery of systems engineering and integration offerings for large, complex projects. SAICs approximately 15,000 employees are driven by integrity and mission focus to serve customers in the U.S. federal government. Headquartered in Reston, Virginia, SAIC has annual revenues of approximately $4.5 billion. For more information, visit saic.com. For information on the benefits SAIC offers, see My SAIC Benefits. EOE AA M/F/Vet/Disability Job Posting: Jul 19, 2018, 4:30:47 PM Primary Location: United States-TX-AUSTIN Clearance Level Must Currently Possess: None Clearance Level Must Be Able to Obtain: Secret Potential for Teleworking: Yes Travel: Yes, 50% of the time Shift: Day Job Schedule: Full-time

The BA shall work under the supervision of a PM in collaboration with other BA resources to create, normalize, document and govern an Enterprise Taxonomy and Enterprise Taxonomy Governance process based on class/record/document types, search criteria, document retention and security rules, legacy document sources, etc. This is a sole contributor role in a highly collaborative environment, responsible for driving high quality results with vendors and stakeholders of TxDOT, one of the State’s largest agencies. This is an evolving role in a changing environment. The role is responsible for completing other projects and tasks as assigned and for adhering to TxDOT and IMD’s processes and standards. You have: 10 years of demonstrated expertise and experience in all aspects of IT business analysis – including but not limited to discovering, creating and documenting business analysis, requirements, functional designs, test cases, training, data migration/interfaces, and process documents. 10 years of demonstrated experience in delivering business analysis scope on time, within budget, and to the specified level of quality under the direction of a project manager. 10 years of demonstrated expertise in delivering high levels of customer satisfaction and organizational benefits. 10 years of expert skills in oral and written communication, negotiation, and conflict resolution. 5 years of experience with high-level skills in utilizing collaboration and project management tools, such as MS Office Suite, MS Project, SharePoint, and enterprise PPM tools (e.g., Innotas). Bachelor Degree in related discipline. You may also have: 10 years of experience in defining approach, creating and normalizing, governing an agency-wide Enterprise Content Management Taxonomy using existing baselines, accelerators and departmental document information, retention/security rules, legacy document sources/interfaces, etc. 5 years of business analysis experience with a state government or federal organization, particularly with a department of transportation, or with a large engineering or construction organization. Project term: 6 months Compensation: $69.50 / hour (W2) What's it like to work for Peak Performers Qualified applicants with chronic medical conditions and/or disabilities receive job preference. Our clients can hire you at any time - with no fee! We want you to get hired. We pay weekly through direct deposit. We offer ACA compliant health insurance at 60 days. In business since 1994, our relationships span 24 years and thousands of job placements. All employment offers are contingent on the successful completion of a pre- employment criminal background check, in compliance with all applicable federal and state laws. Applicants for employment with Peak Performers must possess work authorization that does not require sponsorship for a visa now or in the future. Peak Performers is an equal opportunity employer and will consider all applicants without regard to race, marital status, sex, age, color, religion, national origin, veteran status, disability or any other characteristic protected by law. Peak Performers does not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies or fee based recruitment services.

This person will provide guidance in defining the product and customer master data to ensure consistency of the target architecture. Partners with Solution Architects to ensure a complete solution exists representing both the business need, technology design and expected outputs. Must be able to work nights and weekends, variable schedule(s) as necessary.- Other duties and responsibilities as assigned.Education: - Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Information management, Information data systems or equivalent- Masters degree preferredYears of Experience- Generally requires 6-9 years of related experience in OSS and BSS application analysis, process analysis, data modeling or data architecture- Experience in network modeling is a must- Experience with product catalogs and integrated BSS and OSS systems is a must- Experience working in data communication and cable highly preferred- Experience with large data migration projects across OSS and BSS both from a process and a data mapping point of view will be a big plusAdditional Requirements: - Proven track record driving alignment at different levels of the organization including senior leadership.- Experience in planning, team building and delivering on large system and data migration projects- Extensive experience in business process, data analysis, and OSS/BSS systems- Ability to think both strategically and tactically to solve problems with good attention to detail- Must be resourceful and able to work independently- Track record of taking ownership and driving results.- Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills; strong writing and presentation skills.Comcast is an Affirmative Action/EEO employer M/F/D/V Comcast is an EOE/Veterans/Disabled/LGBT employer

Interacts with Business Analysts and staff within business units to determine options for addressing business requirements. Supports the existing architecture, deliverables, new product releases, and plans for additional capacity as needed to support business needs. Analyzes issues and new business needs as required, and designs and develops new models and/or major enhancements to existing models and maintains current models to business specifications. Assists users with system testing. Rotates with team as on-call contact for production issues. ANALYSIS & REPORTING: Analyzes business processes in order to determine and develop technical solutions to meet business objectives. Interacts with Business Analysts and staff within business units to determine options for addressing business requirements. The Associate Data Architect develops expertise with ERP data, indexes, keys, views and relationships in an ERP database. Analyzes and documents business process flows, working closely with a variety of HR/IT disciplines and subject matter experts, to help create efficiencies with additional or improved automation. Creates reports and queries using SQL based development tools and implements SQL based process flows. Interfaces with the user community and provides end-user support while troubleshooting issues as needed. Key Responsibilities include: Key Responsibilities include: Participates in the analysis of business process flows and requirements to implement and support automated solutions that improve efficiency and effectively accomplish desired objectives. Diagnoses interface and front-end application issues and improves overall function and data entry integrity. Designs complex queries and other reports, as needed. Implements changes to existing codebase to add or improve functionality of applications and workflows. Utilizes data structures and algorithms to write quality and extensible code. Monitors and supports application maintenance and enhancements by performing unit tests, code review and version control. Provides documentation as required regarding application configurations, problem solving resolutions, procedures and scripts. Position Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science. Motivated to learn new applications and business operations. Knowledge in SQL programming. Ability to interpret customer needs in development of application and operational requirements. Organized and self-motivated with strong communication skills. Java and JavaScript knowledge is highly desirable, but not required. Ability to maintain confidential information is mandatory. Data Architect - Teradata
As the world's leading video and ecommerce retailer, QVC has a history of growth and success that goes unmatched. We are an $8.8 billion business that reaches over 370 million homes worldwide. QVC continues to grow on-line, on- air, and through mobile. Ranked as the 3 largest mobile commerce player among multi-category retailers and with nearly 3 million downloads for QVC apps for iPhone and iPad in US, UK and Germany, our global IT organization is expanding and we are in search of tech talent to join our high performing team. We are an innovative, technology-driven company that embraces corporate responsibility and is committed to our people. US Headquarters are located just outside of Philadelphia in West Chester, PA. Whether you’re coming from Center City, the airport, or a suburb with regional rail service, the QVC shuttle service provides a stress-free daily commute to work. As an Enterprise Data Management (EDM) – Data Architect – Teradata at QVC you will report to the EDM Director and be responsible for enterprise-wide oversight and development of QVC’s Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW) environment in support of internal systems and customers. The position requires a strong background in a heterogeneous database environment. You should have extensive knowledge, hands-on experience and expertise with medium to large Teradata databases (50+ terabyte). You will work with the EDW team, BI team, other IT members, business analysts, and hardware and software vendors. Job Description Details Job Responsibilities: Provide technical leadership for the Teradata enterprise data warehouse (EDW), and related data marts, including but not limited to, optimal table & index structure design, performance tuning and monitoring, and security. Work with data modelers to create and maintain consistency and accuracy of all logical and physical data models inclusive of associated metadata. Proactively support the environments, particularly around issues and improvements. Responsible for partnering with application teams, and DBA team regarding all aspects of the EDW system; including but not limited to design, creation, tuning, validation, and troubleshooting. Work with agile development teams and DBAs to develop optimal Teradata environment for databases, ETL flows and business usability. Work with BI management to abide by QVC Data Governance standards and guidelines. Assist with and make recommendations for setting up complex workflows and schedules. Follow SDLC methodology in regards to code development and deployment. Keep current in terms of technology and best practices. Participate in quality assurance reviews of database and ETL components. Write scripts and code as needed. Provide regular updates to EDW manager and assist with project planning, and execution of Data Management strategic roadmap. Educate users/developers on various Teradata techniques through development forums and other means. Minimum Requirements: Highly technical knowledge of Teradata Active Data Warehouse and Data Warehouse Appliance including DBMS configuration, DBMS internal structures, physical database design concepts, database access and query languages, and DBMS administrative tools Experience in development, production support processes and problem resolution according to service-level agreements Highly technical and strong DBMS performance and tuning skills Must possess excellent communication skills Must possess ability to work independently and in a team environment Must possess excellent investigative and problem solving abilities Teradata certification is highly desirable but not required. 10+ years SQL programming experience 7+ years advanced hands-on experience with Teradata 5+ years experience in database design, performance tuning and workload management 5+ years of enterprise warehouse data modeler experience 5+ years strong experience with ETL/ELT creation and tuning 5+ years of experience with BI or Data Warehouse projects 5+ years experience with Linux, UNIX and Windows 3+ years strong experience managing multiple technical projects through a SDLC 3+ years experience Shell Scripting 2+ years advanced experience with Informatica Must be proficient with MS Office '07 (or higher) - Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc. Retail Industry is preferred BI performance management tool (e.g. MicroStrategy or Tableau) experience preferred Temporal data management experience is a significant plus Data Labs experience is a definite plus Working knowledge of SQL Server and Oracle is a definite plus DB2 experience a definite plus Hadoop experience is a plus Google Cloud Service & Big Query experience is a plus Knowledge of Stonebranch is a plus Data Architect - Teradata QVC, Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of Liberty Interactive Corporation (NASDAQ: QVCA, QVCB), is the world’s leading video and ecommerce retailer. QVC is committed to providing its customers with thousands of the most innovative and contemporary beauty, fashion, jewelry and home products. Its programming is distributed to approximately 300 million homes worldwide through operations in the U.S., Japan, Germany, United Kingdom, Italy and a joint venture in China. Based in West Chester, Pa. and founded in 1986, QVC has evolved from a TV shopping company to a leading ecommerce and mobile commerce retailer. The company’s website, QVC.com, is ranked among the top general merchant Internet sites. QVC, Q, and the Q Ribbon Logo are registered service marks of ER Marks, Inc. As an equal opportunity employer, QVC is committed to a diverse workforce and is also committed to a barrier-free employment process. In order to ensure reasonable accommodations for individuals pursuant to applicable law, individuals that require accommodation in the job application process for a posted position may contact us at CareersUS@QVC.com for assistance.

text:
Data & AI Architect
MTC Technical Architect – Data & AI Are you motivated with solving complex business and technical problems? Are you passionate about the promise of the cloud? Are you excited about the latest trends in data analysis through machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI)? The Microsoft Technology Center (MTC) in Malvern, PA is looking for individuals that can help customers move to agile, cloud-based solutions that are powered by the Microsoft Azure Cloud platform. As the Data & AI Technical Architect you will be one of the senior technical leaders for Microsoft in the Philadelphia area spanning Data Management, Business Analytics and Artificial Intelligence. You will win the hearts and minds of Microsoft’s largest and most strategic customers by translating abstract technical data and machine learning concepts to business value, and walking through the solution sales process, from discovery to solution design. As a technical leader you will help influence the future roadmap for the Microsoft Azure Cloud data platform and play an important part in maximizing Microsoft’s long-term vision for empowering every person and organization on the planet to achieve more. You will work in Microsoft’s state-of-the-art facility where you will showcase the latest Microsoft technologies and lead customers through Strategy Briefings, Architecture Design Sessions, Proof of Concepts, Workshops, and Hackathons. Responsibilities This position will have the following key responsibilities: Articulate the possibilities of the Microsoft Azure Cloud with specific emphasis on the data services including Databases, Analytics, AI + Machine Learning, Internet of Things and Business Intelligence. Accelerate the customer’s digital transformation journey using Microsoft Big Data, Advanced Analytics, and Artificial Intelligence (AI) platform. Guide business and technical decision makers on creating business value through Architecture Design Sessions, Workshops, and Proof of Concepts. Propose and validate solution architecture and transfer knowledge on best practices to Data Scientists and App Dev Leads. Serve as the as the go-to technical expert in the business applications space for the regional sales teams. Deliver speaking engagements evangelizing the Microsoft Cloud Data platform in business and technology conferences. Collaborate with the US and worldwide MTC community to drive industry specific scenarios that deliver business value. Qualifications This position requires knowledge in the following areas: 7-10 years’ experience as a solutions architect (or equivalent) in the area of data transformation, warehousing, business intelligence, analytics, analysis, etc. Solid background in Machine Learning including Deep learning. One or more of AI domains: Computer vision, NLP, intelligent agents Proficiency in architecting data migration scenarios including hybrid and pure cloud data solutions. Practical experience in one or more of the following: R or Python, Scikit, Microsoft ML Server, Azure ML, Spark ML, Cognitive Services, Bot Framework, Cognitive Toolkit, Tensorflow, MXNET Ability to create actionable business insights and visualization by using large data sets and leveraging Microsoft Business Intelligence capabilities, including in-depth, hands-on knowledge of warehouse architecture, analytics, reporting tools, and SQL operational expertise. Experience in using software development skills using both Microsoft tools and Open Source platforms. High-level expertise in sophisticated identity, authentication, security, privacy, and compliance requirements, and experience integrating them into cloud and hybrid solutions. Experience with cloud, hybrid infrastructures, networking and adjacent technologies, architecture designs, migrations, and industry standards Understanding of Data/IoT related Azure services including emerging computing trends such as Machine Learning and Cognitive Services. Desired Skills: Be a self-starter who takes ownership of opportunities; works independently, manages multiple simultaneous projects, and deals well with ambiguity and last-minute changes. Have the ability and passion necessary to maintain technical excellence with emerging technologies, including competitive technologies, while continuing to manage customer opportunities. Have a commitment to customer and partner satisfaction, including internal customers, strong listening, communication and presentation skills, and the ability to thrive in a competitive team environment. Be able to communicate complex concepts in a simple, business value context. Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or the recruiting process, please send a request via the Accommodation request form. Benefits/perks listed below may vary depending on the nature of your employment with Microsoft and the country where you work.

text:
Chief Architect, Data Architect
Lockheed Martin Space has embarked on a transformational journey – destination the future. The Digital Tapestry is Lockheed Martin’s path to the future with its interconnected environment where data becomes information and information drives decisions that create value across the entire lifecycle. To help us along this journey Space is seeking a qualified candidate for the position of Digital Enterprise Chief Architect. We’re looking for someone with passion and enthusiasm in systems integration, data management, architecture and project management! The Digital Enterprise Chief Architect / Data Architect should have special expertise in information and data architecture. It includes the evaluation of data needs, integration of data across systems, collection, storage, processing, management, governance and analysis of data. This includes enterprise data, supplier data and customer data. It also includes a special focus on data quality management and data protection. The Chief Architect / Data Architect will provide the architectural leadership for the Integrated Environment, DataHub, Enterprise Data Strategy, and Data Governance domains. The Chief Architect / Data Architect designs, develops and oversees system architectures, including complex systems and systems design activities. The Chief Architect / Data Architect will drive the execution and management the Space Data Governing body as well as Digital Enterprise focused projects. Serve as focal point for the development and communication of the system architecture working in direct collaboration with the LM Space Chief IT Architect. Ensures conversion of mission requirements into total systems solutions that account for design and technology maturity constraints of the system. Develops systems and system element architecture, design, and interface definition. Supports internal and external design reviews. Maintains knowledge of current and developing technologies, design and analysis methodologies. Develops models and architectural guidelines for current and future system development. Additionally, the Digital Enterprise Chief Architect / Data Architect will work closely with the Corporate Future Enterprise Program (FEP) Chief Architect and Chief Engineer to align the digital infrastructure with the overall FEP Enterprise Architecture. Desired Skills: \- Master’s degree from an accredited university in a technical (e.g. Science, Technology, Engineering or Math) or equivalent discipline Demonstrated previous experience at Qualified architect level with 7+ years of technical experience and 3+ years or technical leadership experience (via the Architect Development and Qualification Program or equivalent program) of a large program as demonstrated through related work experience (senior systems engineering experience may also be considered if architecture background is very strong) Lean or Six Sigma experience (green or black belt certified where applicable) Cross functional collaboration – works well with all disciplines across the product lifecycle Change agent – ability to drive for change including technical, cultural and organizational Persistence – maintain focus on goals even when faced with resistance or changing landscapes Experience with IT system development and deployment Ability to embrace and demonstrate Full Spectrum Leadership imperatives Interpersonal skills and the ability to lead effective teams Excellent communication skills both written and verbal Record of proven success BASIC QUALIFICATIONS: Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university in a technical (e.g. Science, Technology, Engineering or Math) or equivalent discipline 7+ years of technical experience as a qualified architect 3+ years or technical leadership experience Formal architecture documentation methodology Systems architecture modeling tools and techniques, using standard architecture frameworks (e.g., DODAF, TOGAF, etc.) Experience operating in large, distributed organizations Corporate and/or industry data management policies familiarity Familiar with product lifecycle, business processes, systems and data architecture Understanding of microservice/service-oriented architecture concepts Business/functional knowledge of Graph Database technologies Project management skills including cost, schedule, technical and stakeholder management Excellent computer skills (e.g. MS Office Suite) Lockheed Martin is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran status, or disability status. As a leading technology innovation company, Lockheed Martin’s vast team works with partners around the world to bring proven performance to our customers’ toughest challenges. Lockheed Martin has employees based in many states throughout the U.S., and Internationally, with business locations in many nations and territories. Join us at Lockheed Martin, where we’re engineering a better tomorrow.

text:
Global Finance Systems - Data Architect
The Finance System Data Architect will lead and support the definition and shaping of data solutions that meet the data demands across the Global Finance Systems organization. This Data Architect will develop the data strategy considering current and known future business demands leveraging all available innovative data technology solutions. Duties and Responsibilities: Support the definition and evolution of solutions to the data challenges across Finance business. Define principles and guidelines for the design and management of Finance data entities and attributes across the Finance Systems landscape Define principles and overall design of the logical Finance Data Model and Data Standard which reflects Finance’s complete data requirements for processing, reporting and control requirements. As a Data technologies champion, lead the definition of the methodology and roadmap for strategically and tactically remediating the logical data architecture Support the definition and articulation of data related issues as well as the solutions for remediation. Identify evolving Cloud based data technologies and find opportunities to introduce these data technologies to improve the data consumption experience of the business. Analyze the performance and reporting management solutions for the finance business and define the future state data architecture for these needs. Qualifications: 10+ years of IT experience working in the Corporate Finance are helping the business leverage ERP data. Expert level knowledge and experience with the definition and design of logical data models and data structures including data and model normalization Expert level knowledge of the different types of data models (conceptual through physical) and their usages and business value Expert level knowledge of the data requirements and design challenges associated with delivering data for finance management, finance reporting as well corporate performance needs. Expert level knowledge of the design and logical flow of data through Finance’s end to end Systems Landscape. This landscape includes: Source Systems, Accounting Engines, Sub-Ledgers, Data Integration layers, General Ledgers, Consolidation, Analytics and Reporting platforms Experience with developing data sourcing approaches, data query and analysis approaches, visualization approaches to meet business needs. Expert level knowledge on finance data platforms such as Peoplesoft, Hyperion and EssBase is a must. Knowledge of Cloud data technologies such as EMR, S3, DynamoDB, RDS, RedShift and other supporting AWS technologies such as IAM, Cloudformation, is a plus. A track record for delivering relevant, tangible outputs of a high quality standard. Strong attention to detail, with the ability to accurately collate and report on significant amounts of information from a variety of sources Ability to communicate effectively (both verbally and in writing) with a diverse set of stakeholder groups Vanguard is not offering visa sponsorship for this position.

text:
Americans with Disabilities Act Coordinator
Job Description The Office of Diversity & Inclusion is looking for an individual who will coordinate the City’s efforts to comply with and carry out its responsibilities under the American with Disabilities Act, as amended. The duties and responsibilities of the ADA Coordinator shall be to work with internal stakeholders and external consultants to develop a comprehensive plan to address issues related to Title II of the ADA, including managing departments through an in-depth evaluation of their internal policies and procedures, followed by an analysis of city facilities and properties, to ensure that individuals with disabilities participate fully in the City’s programs, services or activities. The ADA Coordinator will also be responsible for working with relevant leadership to develop comprehensive city-wide policies and procedures to address the requirements of the administration under Title II of the ADA. Planning, Coordination, and Implementation of ADA Compliance Projects Develop and implement a long-term plan to evaluate and edit programs and policies from various departments Manage department leadership and other relevant stakeholders through evaluation process Create an internal communications strategy for the ADA self-evaluation process Work with City departments, independent licensed architects, city contracted businesses and IT consultants to plan and coordinate projects to ensure access to City facilities and programs including building improvements and alternative technology implementation Collaborate and consult with the Mayor’s Executive Director for the Mayor’s Commission on People with Disabilities on issues relating to the community ADA Complaint Management Work with internal stakeholders to develop internal procedure for filing, responding to and investigating ADA related complaints Receive, and investigate ADA and relative complaints Internal Review Review City programs, policies, activities, services and facilities for ADA compliance Work with affected departments to develop and implement plans to bring identified violations into compliance Provide assistance with Reasonable Accommodation by City employees and constituents

Front Desk Receptionist
Company Overview VERTEX is regarded as one of the premier engineering, construction, environmental and IT companies serving many top insurance companies, real estate owners, contractors, banks, real estate investors and attorneys across the country. VERTEX has 25 offices worldwide and a dedicated staff of over 450 engineers, architects, environmental, and construction professionals. VERTEX offers comprehensive solutions for construction and environmental exposures. With 55,000 projects completed since inception, our experience speaks for itself. In late 2013, VERTEX implemented an Employee Stock Ownership Program (ESOP). VERTEX’s employee-owners help our clients identify and mitigate risks to a project’s physical, environmental and economic well-being; it drives every decision we make. We offer highly personalized and customized service to address highly specialized challenges. By applying technical and scientific skills to our clients’ real business challenges, VERTEX creates integrated solutions that minimize risks while achieving the required results. For more information about VERTEX visit us here http://vertexeng.com/. Responsibilities The Vertex Companies, Inc. is looking for a dynamic, energetic Front Desk Receptionist who welcomes the challenge of joining our team in Aston, PA. VERTEX is a rapidly growing, multi-national consulting firm that is experiencing exponential growth, and we’re looking to augment our team of talented individuals. The Receptionist we are looking for will provide office support with a variety of administrative activities and related tasks. This position requires the ability to multitask with minimal supervision, providing support to VERTEX employees, from junior staff to senior management. Core Responsibilities Welcomes and directs all visitors such as clients, candidates, or vendors to the company. Receives, sorts, and distributes incoming and outgoing mail/parcels (FedEx, UPS, etc.). Answers incoming calls and direct the callers to the appropriate person. Warm transfer calls; voicemail is appropriate when the person is not available. Assists in the ordering, receiving, stocking and distribution of office supplies. Assists with other related administrative duties such as, data entry assistance, photocopying, faxing, and filing. Maintains safe and clean reception area/kitchen area. Supports with roll call and communicating actions. Embraces positive moral and engagement. Provide positive team support for all personnel and departments. Position Requirements Experience Experience answering calls in a pleasant & knowledgeable front desk environment. Minimum 1 year of experience in general administration. Knowledge & Skills Strong customer service focus. Energetic about taking on new tasks. Must be able to perform multiple tasks, handle multiple priorities, and have the ability to perform exceptionally under high stress conditions. Must have basic proficiency in computer operations and standard software packages (Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, Adobe). Must have strong attention to detail. Spanish or other foreign language skills a plus. Physical Demands Occasionally lift and/or move up to 15 pounds. EEO Statement VERTEX is an equal opportunity employer committed to workforce diversity. M/F/D/V. 11

MTC Technical Architect - Data & AI
MTC Technical Architect – Data & AI Are you motivated with solving complex business and technical problems? Are you passionate about the promise of the cloud? Are you excited about the latest trends in data analysis through machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI)? The Microsoft Technology Center (MTC) in Malvern, PA is looking for individuals that can help customers move to agile, cloud-based solutions that are powered by the Microsoft Azure Cloud platform. This role will be one of the senior technical leaders for Microsoft in the Philadelphia area spanning Data Management, Business Analytics and Artificial Intelligence. You will win the hearts and minds of Microsoft’s largest and most strategic customers by translating abstract technical data and machine learning concepts to business value, and walking through the solution sales process, from discovery to solution design. As a technical leader you will help influence the future roadmap for the Microsoft Azure Cloud data platform and play an important part in maximizing Microsoft’s long-term vision for empowering every person and organization on the planet to achieve more. You will work in Microsoft’s state-of-the-art facility where you will showcase the latest Microsoft technologies and lead customers through Strategy Briefings, Architecture Design Sessions, Proof of Concepts, Workshops, and Hackathons. Responsibilities This position will have the following key responsibilities: Articulate the possibilities of the Microsoft Azure Cloud with specific emphasis on the data services including Databases, Analytics, AI + Machine Learning, Internet of Things and Business Intelligence. Accelerate the customer’s digital transformation journey using Microsoft Big Data, Advanced Analytics, and Artificial Intelligence (AI) platform. Guide business and technical decision makers on creating business value through Architecture Design Sessions, Workshops, and Proof of Concepts. Propose and validate solution architecture and transfer knowledge on best practices to Data Scientists and App Dev Leads. Serve as the as the go-to technical expert in the business applications space for the regional sales teams. Deliver speaking engagements evangelizing the Microsoft Cloud Data platform in business and technology conferences. Collaborate with the US and worldwide MTC community to drive industry specific scenarios that deliver business value. Qualifications This position requires knowledge in the following areas: 7-10 years’ experience as a solutions architect (or equivalent) in the area of data transformation, warehousing, business intelligence, analytics, analysis, etc. Solid background in Machine Learning including Deep learning. One or more of AI domains: Computer vision, NLP, intelligent agents Proficiency in architecting data migration scenarios including hybrid and pure cloud data solutions. Practical experience in one or more of the following: R or Python, Scikit, Microsoft ML Server, Azure ML, Spark ML, Cognitive Services, Bot Framework, Cognitive Toolkit, Tensorflow, MXNET Ability to create actionable business insights and visualization by using large data sets and leveraging Microsoft Business Intelligence capabilities, including in-depth, hands-on knowledge of warehouse architecture, analytics, reporting tools, and SQL operational expertise. Experience in using software development skills using both Microsoft tools and Open Source platforms. High-level expertise in sophisticated identity, authentication, security, privacy, and compliance requirements, and experience integrating them into cloud and hybrid solutions. Experience with cloud, hybrid infrastructures, networking and adjacent technologies, architecture designs, migrations, and industry standards Understanding of Data/IoT related Azure services including emerging computing trends such as Machine Learning and Cognitive Services. Desired Skills: Be a self-starter who takes ownership of opportunities; works independently, manages multiple simultaneous projects, and deals well with ambiguity and last-minute changes. Have the ability and passion necessary to maintain technical excellence with emerging technologies, including competitive technologies, while continuing to manage customer opportunities. Have a commitment to customer and partner satisfaction, including internal customers, strong listening, communication and presentation skills, and the ability to thrive in a competitive team environment. Be able to communicate complex concepts in a simple, business value context. Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or the recruiting process, please send a request via the Accommodation request form. Benefits/perks listed below may vary depending on the nature of your employment with Microsoft and the country where you work.

Project Coordinator/Business Analyst
Program Description: We are a nonprofit that launches careers for military veterans and underserved young adults through consultancy positions with our client companies. We place individuals looking to launch their careers in a minimum of nine month engagements where they learn and grow with our client. Our consultants are provided with a mentor to ensure they are maturing and becoming successful, professional employees. After a candidate applies, WOS will work to match that candidate's skill set with the requirements of a current, or future, position. We then work on the candidate's behalf to place them with one of our partners as a consultant. After the consultancy period (consultancy period varies for each consult, but averages between 9-12 months), the intent is for consultants to be hired away by the client company. At that point your tenure with WOS is complete and you are a fully integrated employee. All of our positions are full-time, entry level opportunities. Individuals will receive an hourly wage in addition to our benefits package. Think of this as a test-drive situation. Throughout the consultancy period you will make an hourly wage, but if you work hard and actively work on bettering yourself, you will transition into a full time employee with the client at a much more competitive salary. Science Associate or Bachelor degree in Business Administration (concentration in Technology Management) Military experience in Technology/Computer Science Availability to work full-time Project functional direction to teams to ensure project milestones are achieved Monitor compliance with system development standards Ensure issues are captured, tracked and resolved in a timely fashion Responsible for all matters relating to the coordination of the project tasks in the project plan Support the project team by utilizing the necessary project systems and tools Develop the necessary project reports and communications Ensures quality through the use of company-approved methodologies Keeps informed of technical and managerial advances in IT, including leading the introduction of best practices Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or a related field experience Demonstrated leadership capabilities through projects or other work planning experiences Good to thorough understanding of and experience in IT project management methodologies, requirements management, quality assurance and IT processes Demonstrated experience working with outsourced vendors (on and off shore) within the information technology field Ability to manage projects from inception to successful implementation Strong to excellent oral and written communication skills Good to strong facilitation skills Strong judgment and management skills Strong analytical ability Good to excellent leadership, technical teamwork and interpersonal skills Ability to foster working relationships with the team, IT Management and Client departments Good understanding of technology platforms and ability to explain technical concepts to the business users in the context of business requirements Ability to define performance and scalability attributes, constraints, and other nonfunctional requirements Candidate must have a valid driver's license and be willing to travel within the state Business Analyst: Responsibilities: Responsible for the full data life cycle from business requirements analysis and data feed definition, to data mapping and testing. Monitor project costs Research projects and prepare correcting entries, as necessary Prepare project cost accruals Work with Finance users to organize, analyze and document business requirements. Responsible for gathering and documenting functional requirements, producing detailed functional specification. VERTEX has 25 offices worldwide and a dedicated staff of over 450 engineers, architects, environmental, and construction professionals. VERTEX offers comprehensive solutions for construction and environmental exposures. With 55,000 projects completed since inception, our experience speaks for itself. In late 2013, VERTEX implemented an Employee Stock Ownership Program (ESOP). VERTEX’s employee-owners help our clients identify and mitigate risks to a project’s physical, environmental and economic well-being; it drives every decision we make. We offer highly personalized and customized service to address highly specialized challenges. By applying technical and scientific skills to our clients’ real business challenges, VERTEX creates integrated solutions that minimize risks while achieving the required results. For more information about VERTEX visit us here http://vertexeng.com/. Responsibilities The Vertex Companies, Inc. is looking for a dynamic, energetic Front Desk Receptionist who welcomes the challenge of joining our team in Aston, PA. VERTEX is a rapidly growing, multi-national consulting firm that is experiencing exponential growth, and we’re looking to augment our team of talented individuals. The Receptionist we are looking for will provide office support with a variety of administrative activities and related tasks. This position requires the ability to multitask with minimal supervision, providing support to VERTEX employees, from junior staff to senior management. Core Responsibilities Welcomes and directs all visitors such as clients, candidates, or vendors to the company. Receives, sorts, and distributes incoming and outgoing mail/parcels (FedEx, UPS, etc.). Answers incoming calls and direct the callers to the appropriate person. Warm transfer calls; voicemail is appropriate when the person is not available. Spanish or other foreign language skills a plus. _Physical Demands_ Occasionally lift and/or move up to 15 pounds. text:
Lead Data Architect
The primary role of the Lead Data Architect is to translate business requirements into usable information architecture which may include an enterprise data model, associated metadata, common business vocabulary, ontology’s, and taxonomies that are used to guide enterprise solution development and achieve consistency of information assets across the application portfolio. This role requires specialized depth and/or breadth of expertise. The Data Design Engineer must take business requirements, knowledge of current and future state GI technology platform design and business capabilities, knowledge of enterprise data standards, and deep data expertise into account to design solutions that are compliant with Prudential’s data architecture and can be implemented in a cost-effective manner. The result of the Data Design Engineers analysis and data specifications must be documented into design documents that are reviewed and confirmed by the managing Data Architect and then consumed by development and IT operational teams for implementation. The specific tasks performed will include analyzing business requirements and defining information systems data solutions (source to target data mapping, data lineage, data validation, and transformation rules) to address complex business needs (projects are technically difficult, requiring innovative and creative solutions and frequently involve multiple platforms, software, hardware, technologies and tools). RESPONSIBILITIES: Works with cross-functional teams of business and technology stakeholders to fully comprehend documented business requirements and ensure that new/existing information assets are identified, stewarded and leveraged across the enterprise Provide guidance to other team members Assist in the development and maintain a metadata management and repository strategy to manage all enterprise information architecture project artifacts Works with the GI Data Governance group to establish and maintain consistent data element naming conventions and definitions across computing environments Partner with the System and Data Architecture teams to insure compliance with each corresponding roadmap. Leverage Informatica Analysts (or comparable tool) to profile data in order to improve data quality and accuracy as well as reduce software defects Has detailed knowledge of the technology stack that supports GI platforms and other platforms across the enterprise Deep knowledge of the data standards and principles as defined by the GI Data Governance group. Collaborates with the lead Design Engineer to solve unique and complex data problems that have a broad impact on the business requiring a solid, vetted technology design solution Ability to generate and present schematic diagrams to convey design concepts and details to multiple recipients including but not limited to business partners and technologist Provides accurate and substantiated design effort estimates for assigned projects Responsible for consistent on-time delivery of quality deliverables in accordance with agreed upon plans Acts as expert technical resource to project team in all phases of the SDLC Enforces data architectural standards, establishes / maintains best practices and drives the principles throughout the systems delivery lifecycle Works independently, with guidance in only the most complex situations. Ability to oversee and provide direction and mentorship to less experienced Data Technicians Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience preferred Hands on experience in the development and design of functional and non-functional technical specifications for complex systems Experience delivering business capabilities for Insurance or Group Insurance Deep knowledge of contemporary architectural principles across the data architectural domain Experience delivering business capabilities for Insurance or Group Insurance a plus Understanding of the enterprise architecture to ensure ongoing alignment, driving the technical roadmap for key applications and platforms Prior experience with enterprise integration applications or techniques a plus Experience with analytical tools and Business Intelligence tools and visualization Understanding of relational databases (RDB) and RDB design with the ability to create and read Entity Relationship diagrams Knowledge of different SDLC Methodologies (Waterfall, Agile, etc) Solid written and verbal communication skills and presentation skills Strong analytical and creative problem- solving skills Ability to translate complicated concepts into easily understood terms Experience working in a team-oriented, collaborative environment Highly self-motivated and self-directed Able to exercise independent judgment and take action on it Skilled at resolving conflict and negotiating effectively and tactfully Prudential is a multinational financial services leader with operations in the United States, Asia, Europe, and Latin America. Leveraging its heritage of life insurance and asset management expertise, Prudential is focused on helping individual and institutional customers grow and protect their wealth. The company's well-known Rock symbol is an icon of strength, stability, expertise and innovation that has stood the test of time. Prudential's businesses offer a variety of products and services, including life insurance, annuities, retirement-related services, mutual funds, asset management, and real estate services. We recognize that our strength and success are directly linked to the quality and skills of our diverse associates. We are proud to be a place where talented people who want to make a difference can grow as professionals, leaders, and as individuals. Visit www.prudential.com to learn more about our values, our history and our brand. Prudential is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Note that this posting is intended for individual applicants. Search firms or agencies should email Staffing at staffingagencies@prudential.com for more information about doing business with Prudential.

text:
Senior Investments Data Architect
The Senior Investment Data Architect will develop a technology strategic direction for Investment data and energize the teams across business and IT towards the direction. This data architect will develop the data strategy considering current and known future business demands and changes as well as apply all available and evolving innovating data technology solutions. Duties and Responsibilities: Provides the architectural leadership in shaping strategic, business technology programs , with an emphasis on application architecture. Utilizes domain knowledge and application portfolio knowledge to play a key role in defining the future state of large, business technology programs. Utilizes broad and deep understanding of the competitive landscape and corporate and business unit strategies to provide context for architectural decision making. Within area of responsibility, continuously pursues advanced knowledge of business technology solutions and maintains understanding of applicable technologies, tools, and services: Establishes working relationships with appropriate business technology solution providers (e.g., Salesforce, Charles River, Reuters, etc.). Leverages knowledge capital available through subscription research services that target business technology solutions (e.g., Forrester on Digital Business, Cutter on investment management, etc.). Leverages the Internet and trade periodicals that focus on the contemporary, competitive, business technology issues within the financial industry. Attends financial industry conferences and engages in associated activities (e.g., conducting presentations, leading workshops, etc.). Defines reference and implementation application architectures. Produces technology roadmaps in support of SI’s application portfolio vision and strategy. Monitors application implementation activity to ensure architecture and design principles are upheld. Ensures application implementation solutions support the business objectives (asset gathering, cost optimization, client loyalty improvement), as appropriate. Participates in governance team discussions and provides a strong voice on critical decisions. Establishes relationships with senior IT and Business leaders for the purpose of advancing proposed application architecture solutions. Coaches and mentors more junior solution architects. Qualifications: Undergraduate degree or equivalent combination of training and experience. Graduate degree preferred. Minimum 10 to 15 years relevant work experience. Should have expert level knowledge on cloud scale data technologies. Should have strong communication and presentation skills to influence and lead multiple teams. Should have strong relationship development skills to develop effective partnership across IT support organizations. Should have expert level experience in applying some of the evolving cloud based data technologies to support business strategic demands in a highly secured and scalable manner. Should have an ability to work with delivery teams during different phases of an initiative. These include delivering a strategy, delivering a designed solution as well as provide required technical assistance. Having broad and deep investment data knowledge and experience working on delivering investments technology solutions would be a plus. Should have working knowledge and technology, engineering expertise on cloud based technologies such as Cloud compute, Cloud Analytics, NoSQL, SQL, Cloud Storage databases and stores. Experience in designing and architecting solutions to investments business clients using evolving and innovative technology tools and platforms. Should be very well connected with the industry thought leaders and leading vendors in this maturing industry. Vanguard is not offering sponsorship for this position.

Recruiter
Mobiquity is a digital engagement provider for more than 200 of the world’s leading brands. We are a collective of consultants, designers, developers, cloud advisors, and data scientists - spread across 3 continents and 9 offices - who create compelling digital experiences to help clients show they care to the people who matter most - their consumers, patients, and employees. We at Mobiquity are in growth mode, and as such, are looking to add a Recruiter to our team. The right person will have the drive, tenacity and flexibility to get the right candidates to our organization. You will be recruiting for a variety of positions, including UX, Developers, QA, Solution Architects, and various other roles for candidates with mobile knowledge. Requirements: Perform searches for qualified candidates according to the relevant job criteria, using computer databases, networking, internet recruiting resources, cold calls, social media, out-bound recruiting and employee referrals Screen and refer applicants to the hiring personnel in the organization, making hiring recommendations when appropriate Interview applicants to obtain information on work history, education and job skills and qualifications Provide excellent customer service to external applicants, internal employees, management and vendors Must be able to work independently with minimal supervision Excellent interpersonal and communication skills Experience recruiting in a technical and/or professional services environment _Recruiting Agencies: While we really do appreciate what you do, and how challenging it can be, don’t do it. Please do not send us unsolicited resumes, either to our employees, job listings, or recruiting team. (We call those “free leads”). Mobiquity is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes._ _Mobiquity is an equal opportunity employer. We feel strongly that the best ideas come from all sorts of directions and sources, and cutting ourselves off from anyone due to our own biases is simply bad business, as well as bad citizenship._
