IT Senior Data Architect
Overview Responsible for providing data modeling and source to target mapping for database development projects, design and user support for business intelligence implementation, design and ownership of the corporate data architecture and related standards, design and maintenance of reference and master data management initiatives, establishment of meta data management policies and procedures, including maintenance of data warehouse and source application data dictionaries, and development and enforcement of data management standards. Lead efforts on major corporate initiatives such as, Data Warehouse and Big Data implementations. At Fulton Financial Corporation, Data Management is moving to explore new technologies to better manage our data and provide a platform for deep analytics to the organization. This position will typically work on project teams to provide data modeling, data architecture and mapping of data elements from one system to another and will work closely with other members of the Data Architecture team to ensure that their solutions work within the context of the greater Data Management environment as well as providing their expertise to the team. Project work will also involve collaboration with Data Governance, Data Engineering, and Business Intelligence in the Chief Data Officer Team. Successful candidates will have exposure to the Hadoop and AWS environment. Office space available in East Petersburg, PA or Philadelphia, PA Responsibilities Essential Duties Senior Data Architects work on a broad range of projects as well as provide technical oversight for other members of a project team. Defining the corporate data architecture and related standards. Data integration architecture. Data warehouse and business intelligence architecture. Taxonomies and namespaces. Data modeling tools and standards. Metadata standards and requirements. Define the corporate data architecture and related standards for Data integration architecture, Data warehouse and business intelligence architecture. Taxonomies and namespaces. Data modeling tools and standards. Metadata standards and requirements. Work with Data Governance team to: Design and manage reference data and master data programs. Design and manage implementation of RDM and MDM solutions. Define and maintain match rules, data cleansing rules, hierarchies and affiliations, and Golden records. Manage changes to reference and master data by identifying sources and contributors and establishing processes for managed change. Establishing metadata management policies and procedures. Develop, maintain and enforce standards. Implement and maintain metadata tools. Manage metadata repositories. Create and manage widely accessible data dictionaries. Enforce policies and processes needed to improve and maintain the quality and ownership of data. Provide regular advice, direction and support to Data Analysts with hands on demonstrations of proper techniques and disciplines across all functions. Deliver these functions with leading industry practices with a thorough understanding of the full systems development lifecycle. Act as a role model for documentation, communication, scripting and adherence to established Information Technology governance standards and procedures. Qualifications Qualifications: Education Bachelor Degree or equivalent experience. Specialty: Relevant degree pertaining to the essential duties of this role. (Required) Bachelor's Degree (Preferred). Experience 4 or more years Quantitative analysis and reporting of customer or product data. (Preferred) 5 or more years Data modeling or architecture, Processes and Controls for development and for operations. Reporting support. Documentation. Control designs for processing integrity. Data Sourcing and Content analysis. Subject area expertise in Retail Banking, Retail Lending, Commercial Banking or Commercial Lending. Subject area expertise in anti-money laundering compliance, adverse business events, regulatory compliance, litigation, valuation. (Required) 5 or more years Skills or implementing and or using: Data modeling software, such as ERWin or ER Studio Implementation and administration of BI Software, such as Business Objects or Crystal Reports or Brio or Hyperion, including semantic layer management SQL Server and Oracle including SQL queries and stored procedures Data cleansing software, such as Trillium MDM software Data Visualization tools, such as Qlikview or Tableau Analytical tools, such as SAS. Solid communication skills and proficiency with Excel, Word and PowerPoint. (Required) 3 or more years Exposure to or training in big data technologies such as the Hadoop ecosystem. (Preferred) Certifications DAMA Certified Data Management Professional or TWDI Certified Business Intelligence Professional. (Preferred) DAMA Data Management Body of Knowledge. (Preferred) EEO Statement Fulton Financial Corporation (“Fulton”) is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all qualified persons. Fulton will recruit, hire, train and promote persons in all job titles, and ensure that all other personnel actions are administered, without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, gender, gender identity, age, genetic information, marital status, disability, covered veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

text:
Data Architect/Engineer
Job Description Camp4 is seeking a creative and experienced data engineer, passionate about joining a team that utilizes integrated and diverse datasets, proprietary and external, as a key component to its Gene Circuitry PlatformTM for drug discovery and development. This role is responsible for defining, developing and implementing Camp4’s data architecture, including data flow, management, processing, cleansing, wrangling, and retrievability. The successful candidate will collaborate closely with data analysts, as well as experimental biologists to ensure Camp4’s Gene Circuitry PlatformTM realizes its full potential to discover and develop drugs with higher probability of success. Reports to the Head of Data Sciences. Key Responsibilities Organize, process, standardize, synthesize, QA/QC and visualize in-house and external data Manage data storage solutions and computing resources (local and external) Troubleshoot internal system and support users of diverse backgrounds and seniority levels Together with Head of Data Sciences, define the data governance scheme and execute it Deliver and sustain data management solutions leveraging industry best practices Collaborate with colleagues in data analytics and biology units to ensure R&D; operates at state-of-the-art standards, from platform to translational sciences to more traditional drug R&D; Manage the resource access policy of the company and drive new SOPs as appropriate Qualifications B.Sc./M.Sc. in computer science, engineering, information systems, or equivalent, with a proven experience in data engineering Experience in Biotech, agritech, Medtech or Pharmaceutical industry, is an advantage Master system management, QA/QC and development tools, as well as development and engineering best practices (eg Python, R, SQL, noSQL, newSQL, Git) Experience harmonizing diverse next-generation genomics and human genetics datasets Experience with common processing frameworks and technologies (eg Apache Spark, git, etc) Strong collaboration and communication skills Attention to detail, high professional integrity and commitment to excellence in execution Creative, thinks out-side-the-box, developing fit-for-purpose solutions for data needs Passionate about realizing the potential of fundamental scientific discoveries to the bettering of patients’ lives and health About Camp4 Founded in 2016 and focused on a core mission of realizing a world with ‘an effective treatment option for every patient,’ CAMP4 Therapeutics evolved from seminal discoveries made by company founders Dr. Richard Young and Dr. Leonard Zon, characterizing the ways in which dynamic cell signaling networks control the expression of genes. Operating at the intersection of genomics, computational biology and data sciences, CAMP4 has extended this foundational work, creating a unique Gene Circuitry PlatformTM to amplify the value of cellular and genetic insights to better understand how genes are controlled by signaling pathways in specific disease states. By generating proprietary 4D maps, CAMP4 can identify de-risked druggable targets, produce actionable insights and improve therapeutic predictability, potentially addressing hundreds of diseases and benefiting millions of patients globally. Find out more at www.camp4tx.com.

Location: Canton, MA, US Dunkin’ Brands- Information Technology Data Solutions Architect Do you want a fast-paced and exciting work environment? Grab a coffee, let’s chat. The Data Solutions Architect leads the efforts to expand the company’s use of data to enable and achieve the organization’s goals and objectives. Provides strategic view and leads the design, development, and implementation of information, data, and analytics architectures roadmaps, and best practices that produce business outcomes. Strong focus on defining the data solutions, data management, and analytics environment that will enable more efficient and effective decision making. Develops and communicates technical roadmaps and product standards and, develops and maintains enterprise technical roadmaps. The Data Solutions Architect will provide leadership and technical expertise while providing solutions in the areas of data management, EDW, Data Lakes, system integration, application design, interoperability, and compatibility across multiple platforms. Operating as a single contributor or as part of a team (on large complex projects with multiple Architects), interprets and translates client requirements into a solution which aligns with the overarching Enterprise Architecture. The Data Solutions Architect is responsible for working with end users, business liaisons, vendor partners, and other key members of the BI team to deliver Data Solutions, Data Quality, Big Data, Data Architecture, Data Modeling and QA solutions that help Dunkin’ Brands stakeholders grow our business. Who We Are- With an energy that is infectious and a singular dedication to building on our successes, our people have grown our company into one of the world’s leading franchisors of quick service restaurants with more than 19,000 points of distribution in more than 60 countries worldwide. The success that we have built from our many years of creating products that people love is something we delight in sharing with our approximately 1,100 employees. But the best part about working at Dunkin’ Brands is being associated with well-known brands that people identify with great taste, delicious products and consistent service across the globe. We are poised for even greater success, and we need enthusiastic people who are looking for career growth at a company that encourages innovation and nurtures entrepreneurial thinking. If you enjoy a fast-paced environment, have a positive attitude, and are looking for a company that invests in its employees then please apply! issues are detected Write complex SQL queries to pull and analyze data from large relational databases Mastery of key data sources and documentation of data lineage to ensure efficient diagnosis of data quality issues Consultation on data entry processes to minimize the risk of DQ issues and help key stakeholders understand data lineage impact Consultation on current ETL and data integration processes to maximize quality of captured data Ability to quickly understand business needs and translate into technical requirements What You’ll Need- The successful candidate will demonstrate the following experience Bachelor’s degree with concentration in IT or business Minimum of 10 years of progressive, relevant BI Architecture experience Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience creating and maintaining Data Solutions Detailed knowledge of BI technology trends and best practices Practical hands-on experience in implementing Big data technologies to meet business needs Must have for both structured and unstructured data Experience in the deployment of Data Management & Analytic platforms in Private Cloud, Hybrid Cloud, and On-Prem environments Experience in the design and Strong knowledge of hardware and software evaluation principles and practice Additional Perks 1:30 release every Friday On site fitness gym Casual dress code- jeans every day! Data Architect
Analog Devices (NASDAQ: ADI) designs and manufactures semiconductor products and solutions. We enable our customers to interpret the world around us by intelligently bridging the physical and digital worlds with unmatched technologies that sense, measure and connect. Data Architect, Analytics & Customer Insights The Analytics & Customer Insights team at Analog Devices (ADI) is looking for a skilled data architect to lead on the design and implementation of our new data infrastructure in order to enable key analytics initiatives and accelerate time to revenue. You will oversee the data infrastructure and data integration of ADI’s digital intelligence and design the data models to enable our analytics programs and achieve profitable revenue growth. You will also set the process and standards of data collection, storage, usage, and ETL in collaboration with IT, analysts, and program managers. Responsibilities Understand business requirements. Design and control the data flow to meet business requirements. Set data architecture principles, create models of data that enable the implementation of the intended business architecture Bringing data fragments into the database from different sources across the company. Develop data map and data dictionary to help users to leverage and interpret the data. Mentor data engineers in design and development of complex ETL Support digital data architecture and strategy and tagging implementation on both external and internal websites. Develop training plans and documents, and provide trainings on web analytics tools, processes, and standards to different audiences and user groups. Collaborate with IT to plan and execute the implementation of a data mart to integrate data from different online/offline sources and channels for data mining Qualifications Experience integrating third party APIs & Web services and solid programming background. Strong Data Modeling experience. The candidate must have end to end experience in at least two big data warehouse projects. Experience with data modeling tools like Power designer, ERWIN, etc Experience working with relational or OLAP database: Oracle, SQL Server, DB2 etc Scripting/Programming skills – Python, Java, Scala, Go, etc. Knowledge and experience with ETL tools: Informatica, MSBI (SSIS), Datastage, SAP Data Integrator, etc. Familiarity with No SQL databases (i.e. MongoDB, Hadoop, Hive Spark, etc.), data streaming and integrating unstructured data will be plus. Familiar with Qlikview data models. 1+ years of experience in working with and developing datasets for Qlikview developers preferred. Experience Architecting Big Data platforms using Apache Hadoop, Cloudera, Hortonworks and MapR distributions will be plus Experienced in Hadoop Ecosystem e.g. Data lifecycle, governance, tools, various type of data access e.g. Batch, Script, SQL, stream, in-mem etc, security and operations. MapReduce, HBase, Hive, Impala, Oozie, Zookeeper will be plus Experience designing and architecting data solution in AWS, Azure or Google Cloud will be plus Experience with statistic software and programming language, such as SAS and R will be plus. Eagerness to learn new tools and technologies Experience working in a team of programmers as data scientists Strong communication skills. _For positions requiring access to technical data, Analog Devices, Inc. may have to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce - Bureau of Industry and Security and/or the U.S. Department of State - Directorate of Defense Trade Controls. As such, applicants for this position – except US Citizens, US Permanent Residents, and protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) – may have to go through an export licensing review process._ Analog Devices, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer Minorities/Females/Vet/Disability

Staff Data & Information Architect
Role Summary: In this role as “Data Architect” the candidate will be leading the technical aspects of all Data Solutions for the Corporate Audit Staff and Digital audit initiative. Essential Responsibilities: This role will partner closely with the CAS/FDL Solution Architect as well the CAS organization (client) to define “Data” priorities, and deliver to those priorities; these should include, but are not limited to “Data” for: Audit analytics apps, CAS Data Request Packages, CAS Risk Assessment and Prior audit coverage packages. In this role you will: The candidate should be the reference person for the CAS organization regarding any technical and system question related to “Data” and Financial Systems The candidate will engage with the CAS finance SME and the CAS stakeholders, to understand requirements, assess opportunities, propose technical solutions for CAS “Data”. This includes project reviews, feasibility analysis, and cost benefit analysis The candidate will be accountable for technical delivery of programs/projects related to: Audit analytics apps, CAS Data Requests, CAS Data packages for Risk Assessment and Prior audit coverage The candidate will need to lead the architecture and design of sound/supportable and optimized technical solutions to complex requirements. These should include advance analytics products or features The candidate will own reviewing technical designs of existing and new products to ensure completeness and compliance with organizational development standards The candidate will engage with FDL solution architect to understand the data requirements from external auditors and propose technical solutions for digital audit initiative. Qualifications/Requirements: Basic Qualifications: Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Statistics or Finance OR in lieu of a degree: a HS diploma/GED and 4+ years of IT experience or equivalent military experience/training Minimum 5+ years of working in the digital technology or data architecture and analytics space Eligibility Requirements: Legal authorization to work in the U.S. is required. GE may agree to sponsor an individual for an employment visa now or in the future if there is a shortage of individuals with particular skills Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background investigation and drug screen Must be willing to travel approximately 20% of the time Must be willing to work out of an office located in Boston, MA Desired Characteristics: Proficient in writing complex SQL statements, performance tuning and creating/manipulating complex SQL functions Familiar with Oracle E-business suite database schema, entity-relationship and common data views/reports in ERP Experience with Oracle Business Intelligences reporting tools such as OBIEE, BI Answers etc. Familiar with Oracle DRM toolset or data relationship management concept for financial master data management Experience in both build & support functions of data solutions including advanced SQL views, development and management of reporting models, complex report development and business user support Perform ad hoc analysis, insight generation, and data migrations between systems Mid-scale Data warehousing, ETL, reporting, and analytics development experience Good understanding of various data warehouse design methodologies and experienced in building scalable data platforms that enable BI, analytics and data products Familiar with the Agile methodology, test-driven development, source control management, and automated testing Experience with databases SQL and No SQL (Postgres, MSSQL, MongoDB etc) Demonstrated experience in financial systems and/or operations, better if also audit Experience in the analytics space, and preferably basic data science Organized, thorough, and detail oriented Collaborates well with others to solve problems and actively incorporates input from various sources Eager to learn, shares ideas, encourages and accepts feedback well Strong analytical and problem solving skills; anticipates obstacles and develops plans to resolve Interested in current and emerging technologies and analytics DTR About Us: GE is the world's Digital Industrial Company, transforming industry with software-defined machines and solutions that are connected, responsive and predictive. Through our people, leadership development, services, technology and scale, GE delivers better outcomes for global customers by speaking the language of industry. GE offers a great work environment, professional development, challenging careers, and competitive compensation. GE is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. Locations: United States; Massachusetts; Boston GE will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States for this opening.

Enterprise Data Architect
Exciting opportunities exist within CDM Smith's Business Technology organization for highly motivated and dynamic minded individuals. Ground- breaking innovation and a pioneering spirit are driving a number of on-premise and cloud-based automation and virtualization projects that are transforming our technology landscape CDM Smith is seeking an Enterprise Data Architect to join our team. The ideal candidate should have the right mix of deep data warehouse, data lake, ETL, and data governance knowledge coupled with business process skills and a passion for leveraging data to solve business challenges. This role will report to the VP of Digital Capital and work with representatives from every department to develop/maintain master data processes and develop data stewards. This person will develop repositories that will be used by our Advanced and Predictive Analytics teams and our data science teams Responsibilities: Provide the data framework and roadmap for enterprise business systems Establish data governance practices and framework Establish standards, policies, and guidelines for data usage Ensure the integrity, quality, and accuracy of enterprise data through governance and master data management Guide the enterprise data strategy and assist with business systems projects Socialize and evangelize data practices and standards throughout the organization Ensures technical teams are following data standards Create and maintain an enterprise data architecture map Be a subject matter expert on data integration between enterprise business systems Gather business requirements, perform vendor and product evaluations Manage projects related to enterprise data improvements Contribute to business systems test plans to ensure data integrity in system deployments Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Information Systems or equivalent 10 years of experience in a directly related responsibilities Experience integrating enterprise business systems Ability to speak persuasively to staff ranging from technical implementors through executive management Experience with ETL tools Strong written communication skills and the ability to format documentation to match the audience Excellent attention to detail and complex problem-solving capabilities Preferred Qualifications Experience with cloud-based Data Warehouse systems Proven skills to work effectively across internal functional areas in ambiguous situations Experience with financial reporting, data visualization, and dashboards Experience in working with off-shore development teams

text:
Data Architect
General Summary: This position will play a significant role in the technical development and the maintenance of the Data Warehouse Systems, and support of complex Business Intelligence systems. This position requires applied experience in developing, implementing and using data models, and shall have a strong working knowledge of the data lifecycle, from acquisition through dissemination to end users. Essential Job Functions: 1. Must have applied experience with developing, implementing and using data models, including integration of massive amounts of data across multiple databases in a data warehousing, ETL or analytic environment. 2. Must possess expertise with multiple program languages across language types. 3. Must have strong communications and facilitation skills, with ability to work with analysts and end users to clearly capture requirements. 4. Must have experience in preparing and/or reviewing technical model requirements documentation to ensure accuracy and to ensure that impacts are identified, understood and communicated. 5. Must possess knowledge and experience in data extract, transform and load (ETL) processes, Talend experience preferred. 6. Responsible for technical leadership, setting standards and procedures and following up to mentor and train technical staff. 7. Meet and/or exceed data delivery time service standards. This role must support time critical corporate reporting requirements. Meeting these needs can entail intense periods of work to meet timeliness standards. 8. Support Enterprise-wide data initiatives. This role must be filled by someone who grasps the strategic significance of activities performed and is motivated by accomplishing corporate objectives. 9. Work with appropriate customers to create and manage project schedules for reporting solutions. 10. Actively participate in the overall Data Warehouse/Business Intelligence strategy. 11. Document and conduct unit and system testing as it pertains to new Business Information/Data Warehouse development and maintenance. 12. Working closely with development team to clearly understand the business applications and databases supporting the applications. 13. Maintenance of database dictionaries, and integration of systems through database design. 14. Logical and Physical design of the warehouse BI and OLTP systems. 15. Working with the DBA group helping develop best practices, policies, and design of logical and physical tables with in the databases. 16. Support in all aspects of data analysis and data movement among different systems - source systems and data warehouses. Supportive Job Functions: 1. Perform other miscellaneous duties as assigned by management. Knowledge, Skill, and Abilities: 1\. Experience with ETL Tools (e.g. Pentaho, MarkLogic, XQuery, GreenPlum, Clover, Talend, SAS ETL, Informatica, Ab Initio, Embarcadero, Oracle Data Warehouse). 2. Experience with developing and using models based on massive amounts of data. 3. Strong ability to handle multiple projects and prioritize accordingly. 4. Bachelor's Degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics or a related field and/or 5-10 years of development and administrative experience with Oracle and SQL experience. 5. 5+ years of experience in developing, implementing and using data models. 6. Proven experience working with customers, gathering requirements, modeling cases, and documenting business processes. 7. Proven experience working with development of high-quality technical documentation and written deliverables. 8. Good understanding of algorithms and data structures. 9. Familiarity with performance optimization techniques. 10. Experience with Data Warehouse Methodologies preferred. 11. Must have extensive experience data modeling data marts/data warehouses systems. 12. In- depth knowledge of star and snowflake schemas/dimensional modeling and data warehouse methodology. 13. Must have hands-on experience in data warehouse schema design and implementation. Education, Experience, and Certification: 1. Bachelor's degree or equivalent is required. 2. 5 to 8 years of previous experience is required. Equal Opportunity Employer Minorities/Women/Protected Veterans/Disabled

text:
SENIOR DATA ARCHITECT, IS&T Applications
The Senior Data Architect has a primary focus on data warehousing, data integration, data process management, reporting and business intelligence (BI) solutions that meet organizational needs in a higher education sector. These needs are associated with applications and data-warehouse functions that support business strategy, operational, reporting and analytical solutions. This person is responsible to structure and guide specific activities associated with designing, developing, testing, implementing, and maintaining data models, data architectures and reporting/analytical solutions as part of the IS&T; Applications, Reporting and Data team. The individual must endeavor to understand and contribute at the detail level of business process, requirements gathering, data and data modeling, data integration, and reporting and data analysis needs. Working across subject areas, source systems, and in conjunction with Clients/Business-owners, Data Integration (ETL), Database Administrators, Business Analysts, Developers and Reporting/BI professionals, the Senior Data Architect will identify and work to implement specific solutions in a team environment and will also contribute to enterprise-level standards and strategies. Required Skills Qualifications Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent required Knowledge of data modeling practices and systems architectures necessary for the support data reporting and analytics Knowledge of and demonstrated experience implementing data warehouse concepts and best practices Knowledge of relational database environments (Oracle, SQLServer, MySQL, etc. both on-prem and in cloud) Knowledge of reporting and analytics; particularly via the use of business intelligence tools (MicroStrategy, PowerBI, SAP, AWS QuickSight, etc.) Knowledge and experience in database development and/or server administration Experience in problem solving and troubleshooting in a group multi-team setting Detail-oriented; ability to follow already-defined standards Outstanding writing skills to author /edit / modify concise, grammatically correct procedures and training for Boston University audience. Intermediate to advanced computer skills in the following software packages: MS Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and Visio. Interpersonal Skills Proactive questioning and listening skills are necessary to solicit information and target the value of solutions provided by IT services Deadline driven with little oversight Team player; professionalism and self-confidence Effective communication skills to work with subject matter experts (SMEs) within the University to elicit the information necessary for project technical design. Fluent in U.S. English _We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We are a VEVRAA Federal Contractor._ Required Experience

Monster is searching for an Enterprise Data Architect to join our team! The Enterprise Data Architect is a hands-on role that helps define the Monster Worldwide data strategy and its implementation. The data architect will provide thought leadership across all data systems and data stores including transactional, operational, warehousing and big data stores. Business Intelligence Architect
Location: Canton, MA, US Dunkin’ Brands- Information Technology Business Intelligence Architect Do you want a fast-paced and exciting work environment? Grab a coffee, let’s chat. Who We Are- With an energy that is infectious and a singular dedication to building on our successes, our people have grown our company into one of the world’s leading franchisors of quick service restaurants with more than 19,000 points of distribution in more than 60 countries worldwide. The success that we have built from our many years of creating products that people love is something we delight in sharing with our approximately 1,100 employees. But the best part about working at Dunkin’ Brands is being associated with well-known brands that people identify with great taste, delicious products and consistent service across the globe. We are poised for even greater success, and we need enthusiastic people who are looking for career growth at a company that encourages innovation and nurtures entrepreneurial thinking. If you enjoy a fast-paced environment, have a positive attitude, and are looking for a company that invests in its employees then please apply! For more information, please visit www.dunkinbrands.com The Business Intelligence Architect will play a key role in defining, architecting and implementing Business Intelligence and Analytics solutions that align with the company’s strategy to use technology – especially analytics – as a key differentiator. The individual must be a good communicator; must be able to talk directly with key business stakeholders, speaking in terms they understand - this means this person should have good business knowledge and be able to explain technical concepts without using complex, technical terms. The individual should then be able to define and architect an analytics solution to satisfy the core business need. What You’ll Be Working On- Gather and understand business requirements for multiple functional areas Design and build Data Visualizations for both structured and unstructured data. Be able to take a high level business need and define the right visualizations to support it Analyze data and create detailed reports utilizing Qliksense, Tableau, Oracle Business Intelligence Enterprise Edition or similar tools (OBIEE), and database query tools such as Toad Provide detailed development tasks and estimates Oversee the day-to-day work of assigned development resources during implementation Work with Oracle and PL/SQL, including the ability to write complex SQL queries to pull and analyze data Write and manage Windows and Unix shell scripts as needed to support solutions Data and Application Architecture and Modeling Establish and maintain standards for system and applications architecture, configuration and documentation. Develop standardized documentation and policies Leverage one or more of the following environments and tools such as Hadoop, Qliksense, Tableau, Couchbase, Cassandra to solve complex analytical problems Project management for break/fix and enhancements, using mature SDLC and best practices to ensure consistent high-quality deliverables Manage IT vendors to ensure timely and excellence delivery of services. Develop and maintain thorough functional, technical, and architecture documentation for all development and support activities What You’ll Need- Bachelor’s degree with a computer science focus or equivalent experience. Master’s preferred 10+ years of progressive related experience within an IT department 8+ years’ Experience with data modeling concepts and design best practices for Decision Support and Analytics systems Experience in application and data architecture with Oracle RDBMS, NoSQL, Big data technologies 8+ years of Oracle database (SQL, PL/SQL) experience or equivalent Demonstrable Experience in Data Visualization is highly desirable Experience in shell scripting desirable Experience with Business Intelligence and Reporting development (OBIEE, QlikSense, Tableau) Expertise with one or more of the following Big Data tools such as Hadoop, Spark, Couchbase, Cassandra Experience with Big Data technologies, Data Visualization for both structured and unstructured data Experience in the Data Management & Analytic platforms in Private Cloud, Hybrid Cloud, and On-Prem environments A broad understanding of all major technical platforms, technical architecture models; and enterprise architecture strategies Experience with gathering and analyzing business requirements Practical experience in building business and technical requirements. Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to meet common objectives through teamwork Excellent verbal, written communications and presentation skills with an emphasis on being able to present technical topics in an easy to understand way for non-technical customers. Strong partnering skills and a service leadership mindset are required Proven track record of providing effective team leadership Ability to multi-task and meet aggressive timelines May lead and direct the work of others A wide degree of creativity and lateral thinking is expected Experience using standard project management methodology a plus Experience implementing systems and processes, preferably in a restaurant or retail environment Additional Perks 1:30 release every Friday On site fitness gym Casual dress code- jeans every day! Endless supply of coffee, ice cream and donuts!

text:
Data Engineer
About Tulip Do you want to help transform manufacturing? We are building the best team in the industry to bring consumer-grade user experiences to a space dominated by ancient enterprise technology. Our platform enables our customers to create apps without code and to connect their apps to machines, sensors and smart tools. These augmented production lines would otherwise rely on paper to share information. We’re based in Somerville, MA and have raised $13m from NEA, Pitango, and other leading investors. Our customers include some of the largest manufacturers in the world across numerous verticals of the manufacturing industry. If you are looking to join a fast-growing, mission-driven company, and want to make a lasting impact on our organization and the manufacturing industry, we'd love to talk to you. The Job Our technologies bring the flexibility, speed, and intelligence that take our customers' processes and results to the next level; but for these impacts to be felt properly, our technologies need to be at least as reliable as the paper systems we're replacing. To make this happen, we need rock-solid technical infrastructure, and we need it in the face of some pretty unique operational challenges, from on-site deployments to unreliable network & power conditions that our customers, more than us, dictate. You You have experience developing large, production-ready applications. You can architect large systems that will grow and scale along with our users. You’re able to pick up new technologies and dive into large distributed systems. You love working with backend systems, but are able to move around the stack as needed. We don't require experience with any specific technologies, but we are currently transitioning our Meteor-based Node.js monolith to microservices written in Go. We store our data in MongoDB and Postgres and run everything on Kubernetes. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Even if you don't check every box, but see yourself contributing, please apply. Help us build an inclusive community that will transform manufacturing.

Technical Architect - Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery
Qualifications 5+ years of direct work experience in IT Business Continuity, Disaster Recovery and Emergency Management Demonstrable experience with BC/DR core concepts including BIA analysis, DR plan documentation, BC/DR exercises, emergency management communications Deep technical knowledge and expertise in backup and recovery technologies Experience in building, implementing and managing enterprise class backup and recovery environment with complex global networks Deep expertise in cloud computing technologies and experience in architecting BC/DR solutions in the cloud Strong problem structuring and analytical skills Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills Strong collaboration and people leadership skills Comfortable working with technical & business teams Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment Skills to communicate complex ideas effectively Ability to communicate effectively - both verbally and in writing Bachelor's degree, Master's degree preferred Who You'll Work With You’ll work in our Waltham, MA office as a member of our Unix, Storage, Backup and Data Center (USBD) engineering team focusing on backup/recovery and business continuity/disaster recovery. The USBD engineering team is part of T&D Operations and Reliability Engineering (ORE), an entity within McKinsey's worldwide IT organization, which provides and manages our global IT infrastructure and services. ORE team is a truly global team and you will be working with talented team members across the globe. What You'll Do You will be providing technical leadership and know-how for our global technical Business Continuity/Disaster Recovery (BC/DR) program. You will collaborate with different teams to develop, implement and manage our firm's BC/DR plans as well as the backup and recovery infrastructure. This position will also ensure that we follow and continue to maintain industry’s best practices and standards for backup/recovery and BC/DR. As BC/DR technical architect you will also be responsible for system restoration and recovery, leading business continuity planning and testing events, development of guidelines and standards, and development of training exercises and drills. You'll closely collaborate with different teams in integrating BC/DR into services and products, you'll be responsible for vendor management and have the opportunity to explore new technologies.

Where individuals look forward to arriving at work each day, are recognized and appreciated, and are allowed to move boundaries and take calculated risks for greater success. Data Architect
JOB SUMMARY The primary purpose of this position is to provide ownership of all reporting data. Ensuring the accurate ingesting and transformation of data into and amongst reporting databases. Working with other IT personnel, adhere to all data retention policies, providing information to decisions makers across the organization. JOB RESPONSIBILITIES 1\. Data Engineering & Transformation Responsible for design, development, and implementation of database applications and solutions for managing and integrating data between operational systems, data repositories, and reporting and analytical applications. This includes but is not limited to ETL, stored procedures, views, and functions. Continuously improve performance of source code using industry standard methodologies. Understand data model, data integration, and primary data sources in order to analyze results and identify key drivers of business performance. Identify, analyze, debug, and remedy issues with data pipelines. Create and propose technical design documentation which includes current and future functionality, database objects affected, specifications, and flows/diagrams to detail the proposed database and/or data integration implementation. Ability to self-learn a data integration tool/platform to potentially migrate existing code over. Works with diverse technologies including the integration between multi-tier platforms and systems to design and prepare detailed specifications and procedures, build (code), and implement automated solutions for new and existing systems. Work closely with other engineers to integrate databases with other applications Knowledge of integrating large volume data from internal and external systems. 2. Data Analysis & Reporting Collaborates with stakeholders and development team members to achieve business results. Experience with various ETL, metadata and reporting tools. Oversee business process reporting (production reports) to specific business units and functional teams within the organization, ensuring accuracy and effectiveness of reports.Create and update production and ad hoc reports as needed. Data Architect - Temporary (August 2018 - January 2019)
ABOUT UCARE At UCare, we deliver high-quality health coverage and services to help members of all ages maintain and improve their health. It's a big job that takes innovative ideas, strategic partnerships, and a commitment to doing the right thing. Above all, it takes a compassionate team that is dedicated to making a real difference in the lives of our members and our communities. WORKING AT UCARE Working at UCare is more than just a career; it's a mission. A mission that defines us as professionals, unites us as an organization, and shapes how we interact with our members and each other. Our values of integrity, community, quality, flexibility, and respect permeate every aspect of our organization – from who we are and how we act, to what we do and how we do it. We owe our continued success to our employees who proudly embody our mission and values in everything they do. DATA ARCHITECT – TEMPORARY (AUGUST 2018 – JANUARY 2019) Position Description This position will plan, document, coordinate, architect, and lead all activities related to Enterprise Data Architecture and Data Warehousing. Continued adherence to standards, principles, and Data Governance guidelines as required to meet the needs of the organization’s business requirements. This individual is also responsible for developing and maintaining a data architecture blueprint for the organization. The Data Architect will work with business subject matter experts and IS groups to document data attributes, translate business requirements into technical requirements to ensure appropriate controls and verification for enterprise level data integrity. Core skills include database architecture, data modeling (relational, dimensional, and hierarchical). Develop and maintain an Enterprise Data Model (EDM) to serve as both the strategic and tactical planning vehicles to manage the enterprise data warehouse. This effort involves working closely with business users. Collaborate with IS teams to ensure quality and compliance by Enterprise Data Architecture. Participate in data analysis/design reviews and conduct walkthroughs at various stages during the development life cycle. This includes providing data modeling expertise with diagrams of both relational and dimensional modeling techniques. Collaborate with the data warehouse team and the business partners in designing Data Marts. Emphasis on methodology, modeling, and governance. Define the IT design methodology, develop process to quickly incorporate model changes, and adhere to data governance best practices. Guide, educate, and mentor the Data Architecture Strategy directives, principles, & standards to individuals who play data-related roles (e.g. data analysts, ETL developers, report developers & systems analysts). Establish and maintain data standards, policies and architectures. Provide direction, guidance, and oversight for data quality controls. Identify opportunities for standardizing data descriptions, integration and archiving, and elimination of unnecessary redundancy. Capture and maintain metadata, creating business rules for the use of data. Other projects and duties as assigned. Education Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Information Technology preferred; demonstrated experience may be considered in lieu of degree. Required Experience Six or more years of direct experience as a Data Architect or Data Modeler with a strong data-centric background. Expertise designing and implementing Data Architectures, Modeling, Analysis and Profiling. Four or more years of Data Warehousing and Business Intelligence. Experience with relational database structures, theories, principles, and practices, Data Governance, Data Quality Management, Metadata Management, and Conceptual and Logical Data Design. Preferred Experience Experience working in healthcare. THE UCARE DIFFERENCE UCare is proud to be a recognized Star Tribune Top Workplace for the 7th consecutive year. As a part of our collaborative team, you'll experience the rewards that come with helping others and seeing the positive results of your hard work. We value and respect each individual's ideas and contributions, and give you the freedom to grow both personally and professionally. We are centrally located, and offer onsite education, equipment and wellness resources, a myriad of volunteer activities, and a number of other rewards. If you're looking for a welcoming environment that celebrates what you have to offer, helps you build on your strengths, and gives you the opportunity to truly make a difference, we invite you to apply. As an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer, we welcome and employ a diverse employee group committed to meeting the needs of UCare, our members, and the communities we serve.

text:
Senior Data Architect
Overview Fairview Health Services is looking for a Senior Data Architect for our corporate IT office in Minneapolis, MN. This is a full-time position working day hours, Monday thru Friday. Our Information Technology services include over 500 employees who work to proactively support the growth of the Fairview network, applications and infrastructure, while also partnering with end-users to ensure patient care quality and safety. The Senior Data Architect is primary responsible to design, deploy, manage and mature Fairview’s data architecture to enable the intended business architecture. Key functions include: understand business strategy and architecture, set data architecture principles, create data models to describe key data assets and their business value, develop roadmap for data and data technologies to enable implementation of intended business architecture and apply architecture principles and standards to broadly influence choice, timing, pace and maturation of various information technology platforms. As an integral part of Enterprise Architecture, this role is expected to foster effective relationships in Business and IT, contribute to the development of overall architecture practice and strategy, and support enterprise initiatives that promote data dexterity and stewardship at Fairview. Responsibilities/Job Description Develop target data architecture that enables intended business architecture and architecture vision, while addressing request for architecture work and stakeholder concerns. Identify candidate architecture roadmap components based upon gaps between baseline and target data architectures. Create data and information architecture maps, viewpoints and metadata to contribute to business capability framework for domain and enterprise models. Create and maintain data maps of internal and external sources of data, including descriptive business meaning of associated data, information about each source’s provenance from origination(s) to target(s), its use, timeliness, associated quality metrics, and details about applications or organizations that maintain data and the technologies in which it is stored, integrated, manipulated, analyzed, and consumed. Where possible, data documentation should include associated semantics including mapping to biomedical standards to adequately understand subtle differences in meaning and promote the reuse, interoperability, and effective analysis of data. Define integrative views of data that draws from across the enterprise to meet Business needs. Work with Business, business architects, data technology engineers, and application designers to identify and model integrative data views and determine service requirements attributes, including relative data quality, currency, availability, response times and data volumes with associated technology solutions and processes (from procurement to use/consumption). Coordinate work across IT teams and business partners (including stakeholders in the business where appropriate), to document data throughout the virtual enterprise including documentation of source and destination of each step, data currency and associated processes (e.g., data transformation aggregation, calculation or analysis, storage, consumption/use). Partner with IT functions and various Business areas to provide options and recommendations and assist in brokering internal agreements regarding use and sharing of data (including associated access controls for sensitive data) across systems and groups. Define and establish metadata standards and processes including business descriptions of the data, details of any calculations or summaries, descriptions of data sources, indications of quality and accuracy, and applicable biomedical standards and taxonomies. Define shared canonical view of data across data sources to centralize data transformations and data reuse across the enterprise. Define technical standards and guidelines for data technologies. Examples include processes and , and models of selected entities, objects and processes for architected data stores, technologies for extraction-transform-load processes, interfacing, Web-services, and data orchestration, analysis (including big data applications and high performance computing). Establish process standards to promote reuse and interoperability of existing data stores, applications, and platforms. As part of Enterprise Architecture, investigate emerging technologies and new releases to ensure standards are up-to-date, participate in proof-of-concept and other projects. Establish and define analytics solution and data technologies system standards (including solution tiers), and supporting technology processes for information assets (e.g., reports, dashboards, analyses). Evaluate the impact of projects on enterprise and data architecture and recommend solutions that align with target state architecture. Design cost effective, secure and reliable data technologies and analytic solutions that align with enterprise architecture. Identify, document and promulgate interoperability, reuse and mechanisms for harvesting additional data value with technologies and solutions. Provide templates and guides for applications teams in the process of application build and configuration to document and maintain associated metadata about application data and its dependencies. Establish process standards for application and business teams, if applicable, with decision-rights over application configuration and data processes to maintain documentation throughout the lifecycle of an application, particularly as part of enhancements, upgrades, or other changes. Develop and execute a communications program to articulate the benefit of Enterprise Architecture overall and data architecture across the enterprise. Establish appropriate forums in collaboration with Data Technologies and Analytics where appropriate for stakeholders to communicate requirements and priorities, provide input and discuss decisions. Support data stewards who educate the Business on the importance of data quality thought its entire lifecycle, principles and standards for creating data of high value and quality, data semantics and opportunities to improve data quality. Qualifications Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of experience, education and training TOGAF or other comparable architectural certification or required to obtain certification within 6 months of hire 8+ years’ IT experience (or a combination of healthcare and IT experience) 5+ years in data and analytics and/or technical support experience Preferred Qualifications Advanced degree in computer science, IT, architecture or health informatics TOGAF Other Required Skills Excellent communication skills to effectively interact with all levels of technology and business partners Excellent facilitation skills Experience delivering concurrent, large information management projects at all phases-from project definition through design and delivery. Solid understanding and applied expertise in solutions architecture designs and concepts, which include but are not limited to: SDLC Process, Security, high availability, recovery, performance, monitoring and operations design Public speaking experience in front of large groups and executives Experience working with vague requirements and/or within organizations that are non-structured Skills in data architecture, operations, or deployment methodologies and techniques including experience with formal architecture methodologies. Knowledge of biomedical and healthcare standards, master data management, data warehousing, data integration, analytics (including associated methodologies), and big data technologies (including high performance computing) Desired Skills Healthcare Industry specific knowledge that includes a working knowledge of industry standards and architectures Significant data technology and analytics experience including traditional platforms and more innovative technologies and environments with exposure to the entire data technology stack.

Data/BI Architect
Data/BI Architect ( Job Number: 182745 ) As a Big Data Technical / BI Architect you will be responsible for driving TCF’s Fraud & Risk data & BI architecture practice, including designing and solutioning of various operational and analytical systems. You will lead the strategy and architecture of creating and maintaining project and/or enterprise data models, integration and business analytics capabilities. You will help establish enrich IT Data Governance as a discipline at TCF. The objective of this role is to define common structures and patterns for teams to leverage when developing technical solutions, and support the creation of a set of standards to modernize and align TCF’s data & BI management practices. Leads Fraud & Risk Big Data & BI Architecture working sessions with appropriate stakeholders across the organization to create and maintain data modeling, data integration and BI capabilities. Ensures these models are kept current, are approved, are fit for purpose, and evangelized across the organization. Provides thought leadership and strategic direction to modernize TCF’s Fraud & Risk analytics environments leveraging Big Data technologies, everages thorough through obtaining in-depth understanding of business process and system processes to implement make recommendations and propose technical/non-technical solutions to meet business requirements. Works with the Application Development and Integration Services teams to implement Data & BI strategies and build data flows pipelines from on-premise and could-based platforms. Define, design and implement data access patterns for right-time/streaming workloads including data acquisition, storage, processing and analytics Supports TCF’s Data Governance practice through development of a set of Data Architecture / Data Management standards. Provides technical and strategic leadership in all Data & BI Architecture subject areas. Improves TCF’s Architecture practice and modernizes Data & BI Management capabilities. Supports Partners with project architects, enterprise architects, and solution architects across the organization for Data & BI Management and Data & BI Architecture capabilities – Provides guidance where appropriate. Performs software analysis, code analysis, requirements analysis, software review, system risk analysis, software reliability analysis, capacity planning, etc. Champions common data definitions, and data protection and security. Monitors, assesses, and understands data management capability developments and identifies opportunities for TCF architectural modernization. Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or other technical field or equivalent work experience 7+ years of experience with Data Architecture and Management. Full knowledge of Hadoop Architecture and HDFS is a must Hands-on experience in Big Data Hadoop, Spark, NoSQL like Cassandra, CouchDB, HBase etc., Database like SQL Server, MySQL etc., Kafka 3+ years hands on architectural and leadership experience in design and deployment of data management solutions (data modeling, database design, data warehouse, middleware, enterprise services, operational data stores, MDM, data quality tools, application development, front-end data collection, identity/access management, and governance mechanisms) within a large enterprise environment. Experience in architectural design and modeling and knowledge of data modeling and understanding of different data structures and their benefits and limitations under particular use cases Strong knowledge of Data Governance, Data Quality, Data Lifecycle Management and Privacy Principles. 3+ years of experience with agile or other rapid application development methods. Financial Services, or other regulated industry experience Proven analytical and problem solving skills. Strong design and coding skills Strong organizational, interpersonal and multitasking skills with ability to balance competing priorities. Excellent relationship building skills; ability to interface with a variety of stakeholders. Should have excellent relationship building skills, communication, presentation and negotiation skills. Should be assertive, able to resolve conflicts and gain consensus in a cross functional team of stakeholders Strong knowledge of Data Governance, Data Quality, Data Lifecycle Management and Privacy Principles Experience with agile or other rapid application development methods. Coach / mentor other team members as appropriate Why choose TCF? Established in 1923, TCF has maintained a strong foundation. TCF has over 340 branches in Minnesota, Illinois, Michigan, Colorado, Wisconsin, Indiana, Arizona and South Dakota, providing retail and commercial banking services. TCF also conducts commercial leasing, indirect auto finance, and equipment finance business in all 50 states, and commercial inventory finance business in all 50 states and Canada. Our Benefits TCF encourages open employee communications and promotes from within whenever possible. We offer competitive pay, a comprehensive benefits plan, and opportunities for career advancement. For more details on our benefits, click on the Employee Benefits link on our career page. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, or other status protected by applicable law. TCF is proud to be an affirmative action/equal opportunity employer. Minority/Female/Disabled/Veteran/Gender Identity/Sexual Orientation. Primary Location : USA-Minnesota-Plymouth-Us-Mn-Plymouth- 1405 Xenium Lane N Work Locations : Us-Mn-Plymouth- 1405 Xenium Lane N 55441

Evaluates reusability of current data for additional analyses. Conducts data cleaning to rid the system of old, unused, or duplicate data. General Dynamics Information Technology (GDIT) has recently been awarded a program and we are proactively seeking incumbent candidates for Software and Data Architect roles to include, but not limited to: Database Analysts, Databse Architects, PL/SQL Developers, etc. Current incumbents will receive priority in the interview process. Please submit your candidate profile and you will contacted accordingly. This program only accepts US citizens and/or Green Card Holders. text:
Solutions Architect - Big Data Consulting
Are you inspired by innovation, hard work and a passion for data? If so, this may be the ideal opportunity to leverage your background in Big Data and Software Engineering, Data Engineering or Data Analytics experience to design, develop and innovate big data solutions for a diverse set of clients. At phData, our proven success has skyrocketed the demand for our services, resulting in quality growth and an expanded presence at our company headquarters conveniently located in Downtown Minneapolis (COCO). As the world’s largest pure-play Big Data services firm, our team includes Apache committers, Spark experts and the most knowledgeable Scala development team in the industry. phData has earned the trust of customers by demonstrating our mastery of Hadoop services and our commitment to excellence. In addition to a phenomenal growth and learning opportunity, we offer competitive compensation and excellent perks including base salary, annual bonus, extensive training, paid Cloudera certifications - in addition to generous PTO and employee equity. As a Solution Architect on our Consulting Services Team, your responsibilities will include: Design, develop, and innovative Hadoop solutions; partner with our internal Infrastructure Architects and Data Engineers to build creative solutions to tough big data problems. Determine the project road map, select the best tools, assign tasks and priorities, and assume general project management oversight for performance, data integration, ecosystem integration, and security of big data solutions Work across a broad range of technologies – from infrastructure to applications – to ensure the ideal Hadoop solution is implemented and optimized Integrate data from a variety of data sources (data warehouse, data marts) utilizing on-prem or cloud-based data structures (AWS); determine new and existing data sources Design and implement streaming, data lake, and analytics big data solutions Create and direct testing strategies including unit, integration, and full end-to-end tests of data pipelines Select the right storage solution for a project - comparing Kudu, HBase, HDFS, and relational databases based on their strengths Utilize ETL processes to build data repositories; integrate data into Hadoop data lake using Sqoop (batch ingest), Kafka (streaming), Spark, Hive or Impala (transformation) Partner with our Managed Services team to design and install on prem or cloud based infrastructure including networking, virtual machines, containers, and software Determine and select best tools to ensure optimized data performance; perform Data Analysis utilizing Spark, Hive, and Impala Mentor and coach Developers and Data Engineers. Provide guidance with project creation, application structure, automation, code style, testing, and code reviews Qualifications 5+ years previous experience as a Software Engineer, Data Engineer or Data Analytics Expertise in core Hadoop technologies including HDFS, Hive and YARN. Deep experience in one or more ecosystem products/languages such as HBase, Spark, Impala, Solr, Kudu, etc Expert programming experience in Java, Scala, or other statically typed programming language Ability to learn new technologies in a quickly changing field Strong working knowledge of SQL and the ability to write, debug, and optimize distributed SQL queries Excellent communication skills including proven experience working with key stakeholders and customers Ability to translate “big picture” business requirements and use cases into a Hadoop solution, including ingestion of many data sources, ETL processing, data access and consumption, as well as custom analytics Experience scoping activities on large scale, complex technology infrastructure projects Customer relationship management including project escalations, and participating in executive steering meetings Keywords: MapReduce, HBase, Hive, Apache Spark, Java, Apache Kafka, Big Data, Spark, Solution Architecture, Cloudera, Apache Pig, Hadoop, NoSQL, Cloudera Impala, Scala, Python, Data Engineering, Big Data Analytics, Large Scale Data Analysis, ETL, Linux, Kudu

Office 365 Architect
Company Overview nVent is a $2.1 billion, high-performance electrical company with a dedicated team of 9,000 people and trusted brands such as CADDY, ERICO, HOFFMAN, RAYCHEM, SCHROFF and TRACER. Known for innovation, quality and reliability, our products connect and protect, consistently delivering value to industrial, commercial, residential, energy and infrastructure customers. While our name may be new, our products have set the standards for quality for more than a century. Today as nVent, we are focused and forward-looking, ready to build upon our legacy. The future is now. Job Summary Position Summary: The Office Productivity Solutions Engineer is responsible for designing, building, supporting reliable computing, communication and collaboration solutions for our end users. This role will require the ability to concurrently oversee multiple projects and support efforts. The vision for the role is to improve the productivity of employees and deliver solutions that are useful and easy to use. Duties and Responsibilities: Relationship Management: Build relationships with key IT and business clients, for End-User computing, collaboration, virtualized desktop and audio visual solutions Solution Alternatives & Cost Estimating: Deliver consultative design, solution alternative identification, cost estimating and feasibility services to support IT Business Partnering and provide our business clients information to enable them to make technology decisions Design & Build: Design, develop and deploy technology solutions and enhancements to meet funded business demand and documented business requirements, which fall within the scope of Office Productivity Solutions Work closely with other IT Engineering domains and IT Business Partners to define Enterprise-wide consistent solutions, aligned with business requirements resulting in delivery of business value-add solutions Provide support and expertise to IT Engineering domains and IT Support and Operations for solution implementation Delivery Collaboration: Partner with Business Stakeholders, IT Business Partners, PMO, Infrastructure/Ops/Support and other IT Engineering teams to deliver funded projects; work with IT Engineering peers and Business Stakeholders to ensure clear accountability for delivery of all scope elements, integration points and business process changes Ensure creation and maintenance of thorough documentation for all end user compute solutions, configurations and processes Partner with other IT Engineering domains to ensure compatibility and supportability of solutions on end-user devices/platforms Technical Architecture: Ensure compatibility and optimized integration between solutions in our landscape, within the funding constraints provided for each project Define and oversee the implementation of the architectural approach and methodology for defining client compute platforms including Windows, Mobile and Virtual Desktop Deliver Architecture High Level Designs which describe technical components, architecture concepts, best practices, and guidance via engagements with Pentair Electrical Application, Infrastructure, and Security teams Direct deployment solutions for enterprise wide rollouts and upgrades of client side operating systems and applications Set requirements for reporting and metrics within management systems (SCCM, ePO, etc.) related to end-user solutions, to enable strategic decision making Embedded Security: Partner with Cyber Security team to ensure all solutions are designed and delivered with robust Security embedded, in compliance with SANS / CIS Critical Security Controls Vulnerability Management: Ensure people, process, technology and data are aligned to provide awareness of and develop solutions to address security vulnerabilities in our existing and proposed technologies; ensure solutions are designed to enable ongoing patching and upgrades to maintain secure posture Compliance: Ensure relevant IT processes are designed and executed in compliance with relevant SOX / IT general controls; support data collection requirements for audits Risk and Life-cycle Management: Partner with service owners to monitor and manage life-cycle risk for all Office Productivity solutions and establish plans for remediating risks; work with IT leadership to budget and schedule remediation projects Consult with IT Operations to define standard images to be deployed to our different user segments Innovation and Technology Leadership: Partner with IT Business Partner team to understand business strategies and outlook, to focus innovation efforts Closely follow end user compute industry trends and new technologies Identify/implement new technologies that provide business value and minimize TCO in end user compute and collaboration. Organize Proof of Concept testing with support of skill teams Identify opportunities and strategy to move appropriate services to Software as a Service “SaaS” model of delivery such as Google, O365, other. Build the strategy for the endpoint environment, including emerging technology, new technical solutions, software and hardware roadmaps, etc. Application Rationalization: Participate in efforts to rationalize our application landscape, by inventorying existing solution landscape, integration points, solution utilization, life-cycle risk / outlook and challenges to be addressed in migrating / consolidating Ensure consistency of deployed solutions according to industry best practices Act as escalation point to review, analyze and approve new desktop software requests coming through IT service management processes from end-users, to determine if requested application should be added to our standard software catalog Vendor Management: Develop relationships with external service and technology providers, to provide opportunities to quickly extend resource capacity, skills and solution capabilities as business and internal IT projects are funded and approved, or to optimize support quality and/or cost Oversee vendor(s) delivering end user compute service such as desktop engineering, desktop management, virtual desktop infrastructure and audio visual/unified communications. This includes setting and monitoring compliance to vendor performance targets. Ensure vendor(s) services align with Pentair Electrical standards, with a long-term vision to enhance, align and deliver end user compute needs for Pentair Electrical business Budgeting: Lead budgeting and rate-setting efforts for Office Productivity Solutions Strategy & Planning: Participate in IT functional and business technology strategy and planning process, to develop roadmaps for technology innovation, rationalization and renovation Identify and deliver an end user compute roadmap and evolution requirements Contribute to enterprise, mobile and collaboration strategy Job Requirements & Skills Specific technology responsibilities and experience desired: Windows Desktop OS Office 365 (especially productivity apps, communication and collaboration) Virtual Desktop solutions Desktop and laptop hardware (Dell, Microsoft, Apple, etc.) Audio Visual and Conferencing technologies (including web and audio conferencing) Mobile devices, operating systems, mobile device management suites (iOS, Android) Familiarity with challenges related to global deployment (China, Russia, UAE, etc.) Desktop productivity suites (Microsoft Office, Adobe, Google G Suite) File sharing applications (OneDrive, Dropbox, Accellion, etc.) Familiarity with SaaS solutions and deployment/support for end-users Backup solutions for PCs / laptops Accessories for end-user audio, printing, cellular connectivity Chrome, Edge/IE, other browser technologies Skills and Experience Requirements: Bachelor’s Degree is required, preferably in Information Systems or related field and/or equivalent experience. 5+ years’ experience in hands-on solution and support delivery is required 5+ years’ experience in working directly with end-users in supporting desktop and mobile solutions Track record of delivering hardware and software solutions for a large global user base of around 10,000 people, including users in a manufacturing environment Strong systems knowledge along with knowledge of IT standards and methodologies Skills in proactive problem prevention and resolution and anticipates potential problems or short comings in systems design or business processes Ability to understand cross-functional interdependencies and devise solutions to meet broad corporate needs Additional Information EEO Statement nVent is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Sr. Mgr Big Data Architect - MN About Hitachi Consulting As Hitachi, Ltd.'s (NYSE: HIT) global consulting company, with operations in the United States, Europe and Asia, Hitachi Consulting is a recognized leader in delivering proven business and IT strategies and solutions to Global 2000 companies across many industries. With a balanced view of strategy, people, process and technology, we work with companies to understand their unique business needs, and to develop and implement practical business strategies and technology solutions. From business strategy development through application deployment, our consultants are committed to helping clients quickly realize measurable business value and achieve sustainable ROI. Its client base includes 35 percent of the Fortune 100 and 25 percent of the Global 100, along with many mid-market leaders.
